We analyze the structure of operators on easy vs. hard problems, revealing that reflective operators are more helpful on hard problems and harm performance on easy problems. Operator sequences are highly model-identifying: a classifier trained on operator distributions alone recovers the source model with macro-AUC, revealing that each model family has a distinctive reasoning fingerprint. Structural operator features predict within-problem answer correctness well above baselines. Classifiers built on these operators reach WP-AUC and on AIME specifically. ReasonOps further enables early quality estimation well before the trace completes: we predict at WP-AUC for only 50% of the trace. The ReasonOps pipeline is unsupervised and annotation-free, enabling deep insights into LLM reasoning traces as well as strong downstream results on model identification and correctness prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReasonOps，一种无监督、表达力强的方法，用于对思维链轨迹进行标注，通过聚类句子开头的3-token枢纽，揭示了7种跨模型、跨领域的通用推理算子（如回溯、推断、假设），并基于这些算子实现了模型识别和正确性预测。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型的思维链轨迹可长达数万token，但缺乏描述其内部结构的词汇。现有方法要么过于僵化，要么表达能力不足，无法跨领域和跨模型捕捉特征。
AI.method: ReasonOps方法：对句子开头的3-token枢纽进行无监督聚类，提取出7种重复出现的推理算子（回溯、推断、假设等语篇级操作），并用三个独立的LLM法官对算子进行分类验证。
AI.result: 分析了6个模型家族、12个推理LLM的44,662条轨迹，发现7种通用推理算子；算子分布可识别模型身份（macro-AUC），可预测答案正确性（WP-AUC），在仅50%轨迹时即可进行早期质量估计。
AI.conclusion: ReasonOps是一种无监督、无需标注的方法，能深入洞察LLM推理轨迹的结构，并在模型识别和正确性预测等下游任务上取得强结果。
idea_en: A method for unsupervised annotation of chain-of-thought reasoning traces using clustering of sentence-initial pivot tokens to derive universal reasoning operators.
A technique for identifying and categorizing discourse-level reasoning operators (e.g., backtracking, inferring, hypothesizing) from LLM chain-of-thought traces via 3-token pivot clustering.
A system for model fingerprinting that classifies the source LLM based solely on the distribution of extracted reasoning operators from its chain-of-thought traces.
A method for early quality estimation of reasoning traces that predicts answer correctness using only partial chain-of-thought data (50% of trace length).
An unsupervised pipeline for extracting structural operator features from reasoning traces to predict within-problem answer correctness with high AUC.
idea_ch: 一种基于句子开头枢纽token聚类、无监督标注思维链推理轨迹的方法，用于推导通用推理算子。
通过3-token枢纽聚类从LLM思维链轨迹中识别和分类语篇级推理算子（如回溯、推断、假设）的技术。
一种模型指纹识别系统，仅根据从思维链轨迹中提取的推理算子分布即可分类来源LLM。
一种推理轨迹早期质量估计方法，仅使用部分思维链数据（50%轨迹长度）即可预测答案正确性。
一种无监督的推理轨迹结构特征提取管线，用于以高AUC预测问题内的答案正确性。

title: GTA: Generating Long-Horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
comment: Published at Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
summary: Web agents, which couple language models with browsing and tool-use capabilities, show promise as open web assistants. Yet progress is increasingly limited by the lack of scalable, process-level supervision. Existing benchmarks are largely manually constructed, providing only coarse start-goal annotations without intermediate trajectories, while recent automatic generation efforts remain expensive, biased, and shallow. These limitations prevent reliable training and evaluation of agents that must generalize to realistic, multi-hop, cross-page tasks. We introduce a scalable framework, GTA, that integrates crawling, retrieval-based seeding, in-context generation, and automated quality control to produce realistic tasks paired with executable trajectories. This design decouples crawling from generation for greater efficiency, grounds tasks in the site graph to enforce compositionality, and ensures dense supervision through deterministic replays and systematic validation. We instantiate the pipeline on over 50 websites covering e-commerce, government, forums, and news, with multilingual and multi-hop coverage. The resulting benchmark reveals a significant human-agent performance gap and enables detailed diagnostics. Our contributions are three-fold: (i) formalizing multi-hop web-agent task generation, (ii) proposing an efficient and validated pipeline for automatic data creation, and (iii) releasing a dynamic benchmark with reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GTA框架，通过集成爬取、检索式种子生成、上下文生成和自动质量控制的流程，自动化构建多跳、跨页面的网络智能体任务基准，在50多个网站上验证了人类与智能体之间的显著性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有网络智能体基准大多依赖人工构建，仅提供粗糙的开始-目标注释而无中间轨迹；自动生成方法成本高、有偏差且浅层。缺乏可扩展的、过程级别的监督来训练和评估能泛化到真实多跳跨页面任务的智能体。
AI.method: GTA框架包含四个核心模块：爬取（crawling）、基于检索的种子生成（retrieval-based seeding）、上下文生成（in-context generation）和自动质量控制（automated quality control）。将爬取与生成解耦以提高效率，基于网站图（site graph）锚定任务以强制执行组合性，通过确定性回放和系统验证确保密集监督。
AI.result: 在超过50个涵盖电商、政府、论坛和新闻的网站上实例化了该流程，覆盖多语言和多跳场景。生成的基准测试揭示了显著的人类-智能体性能差距，并支持详细的诊断分析。
AI.conclusion: 贡献包括：(i) 形式化了多跳网络智能体任务生成；(ii) 提出了高效且经过验证的自动数据创建流程；(iii) 发布了具有可重复评估的动态基准。
idea_en: A decoupled crawling-and-generation framework for multi-hop web agent tasks, where crawling and task generation are separated to improve efficiency and scalability.
A retrieval-based seeding method that grounds task generation on site graph structure to enforce compositionality in multi-hop, cross-page tasks.
An automated quality control pipeline using deterministic replays and systematic validation to ensure dense process-level supervision without manual annotation.

A dynamic benchmark generation system that integrates real website data (crawled from 50+ sites across e-commerce, government, forums, news) with multi-language and multi-hop coverage for reproducible evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种解耦的爬取与生成框架，将网站爬取与任务生成分离，提高多跳网络智能体任务构建的效率和可扩展性。
一种基于检索的种子生成方法，利用网站图结构锚定任务，强制实现跨页面多跳任务的组合性。
一种自动质量控制流程，通过确定性回放和系统验证确保密集的过程级监督，无需人工标注。
一种动态基准生成系统，整合来自50多个电商、政府、论坛和新闻网站的真实数据，覆盖多语言和多跳场景，支持可重复评估。

title: BenchTrace: A Benchmark for Testing Reflection Ability and Controlled Evolution in LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve over time by reflecting on past failures, but existing evaluation is limited in two ways: it measures only task scores, leaving reflection quality unknown, and it relies on agents' own episode runs, offering no mechanism to target specific failure patterns. We present \textbf{BenchTrace}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolution ability in LLM agents. BenchTrace is built on a snapshot-reflection dataset of 1,821 annotated episodes spanning six diverse tasks, and comprises a \textbf{Reflection Evaluation} that probes failure identification through targeted QA tasks, and an \textbf{Evolution Evaluation} that tests whether past failure experience translates into avoidance behavior in a controlled self-evolution simulation. Building on BenchTrace, we propose \textbf{failure avoidance rate (FAR)}, a new evaluation metric measuring the fraction of test cases in which the agent successfully avoids the target failure instance. Experiments with Qwen3-32B and GPT-4.1 reveal that both models fall below a 30\% end-to-end pass rate on reflection evaluation, with diagnosis as the primary bottleneck. Evolution evaluation shows that self-evolution methods generally improve FAR over the non-evolving baseline, but agents forget early lessons as noise episodes accumulate, and agents fail to generalize their reflections beyond the specific context, causing negative transfer across task contexts. Our correlation analysis further reveals that only a fully correct reflection is strongly associated with higher FAR. BenchTrace exposes concrete limits of current self-evolution approaches and provides a controlled, model-agnostic framework for targeted evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出BenchTrace基准，用于评估LLM代理的自我进化能力，包含反思评估和进化评估两个维度，以及新的失败避免率(FAR)指标。实验发现当前模型反思准确率低（<30%），自我进化方法虽有改进但存在遗忘和负迁移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化代理评估仅测量任务分数，无法评估反思质量，且依赖代理自身运行轨迹，无法针对特定失败模式进行测试。
AI.method: 构建包含1,821个标注片段的快照-反思数据集，设计反思评估（通过QA任务探测失败识别能力）和进化评估（通过受控模拟测试失败规避行为），提出FAR指标。
AI.result: Qwen3-32B和GPT-4.1反思评估端到端通过率均低于30%，诊断是主要瓶颈；自我进化方法能提升FAR但存在遗忘和负迁移；仅完全正确的反思与高FAR强相关。
AI.conclusion: BenchTrace揭示了当前自我进化方法的局限性，提供了可控、模型无关的定向评估框架。
idea_en: A benchmark system (BenchTrace) for evaluating self-evolution ability of LLM agents using a snapshot-reflection dataset with annotated episodes.
A targeted Reflection Evaluation method that probes failure identification through specific QA tasks, decoupling reflection quality from task performance.
A controlled self-evolution simulation framework that tests whether past failure experience translates into avoidance behavior.
Failure Avoidance Rate (FAR) as a novel evaluation metric measuring the fraction of test cases where agent successfully avoids target failure.
A correlation analysis method that establishes relationship between reflection correctness and downstream failure avoidance performance.
idea_ch: 一种基于快照-反思数据集（含1,821个标注片段）的LLM代理自我进化能力评估基准系统BenchTrace
一种通过特定QA任务探测失败识别能力的反思评估方法，将反思质量与任务性能解耦
一种受控自我进化模拟框架，用于测试过去失败经验是否转化为规避行为
失败避免率(FAR)作为新型评估指标，衡量代理成功避免目标失败实例的测试用例比例
一种相关性分析方法，用于建立反思正确性与下游失败规避性能之间的关系

title: Tailoring the Curriculum: Student-Centered Reasoning Distillation via Dynamic Data-Model Compatibility
summary: Reasoning distillation transfers complex reasoning abilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller ones, yet its success depends on how well the training data align with the student model. This paper introduces the Data-Model Compatibility (DMC) metric, which can be used to assess the suitability of a dataset for reasoning distillation on a student model. DMC provides an assessment by jointly considering data quality, relative difficulty, and student capability. We validated the effectiveness of DMC from two perspectives: (1) DMC exhibits a strong correlation with reasoning distillation performance; and (2) using DMC as the criterion for data selection leads to improved reasoning distillation performance. Both findings are consistently demonstrated across multiple student models and tasks. Moreover, since the DMC of each dataset dynamically changes during training, our experiments demonstrate that dynamically selecting datasets based on DMC can further enhance performance.

AI.tldr: 提出数据-模型兼容性(DMC)指标，用于评估训练数据与学生模型在推理蒸馏中的匹配程度，并通过数据选择和动态调整提升蒸馏性能。
AI.motivation: 推理蒸馏成功与否高度依赖训练数据与学生模型的匹配程度，但现有方法缺乏有效的兼容性评估指标。
AI.method: 提出DMC指标，联合考虑数据质量、相对难度和学生能力三个维度；并基于DMC进行静态和动态数据选择。
AI.result: DMC与推理蒸馏性能高度相关；基于DMC的数据选择显著提升蒸馏效果；动态选择进一步优化性能。
AI.conclusion: DMC是一个有效的兼容性度量工具，可用于指导推理蒸馏中的数据选择策略。
idea_en: A Data-Model Compatibility (DMC) metric that jointly evaluates data quality, relative difficulty, and student capability to assess dataset suitability for reasoning distillation.
A data selection method for reasoning distillation that uses DMC as the criterion to filter training data, improving student model performance.
A dynamic data selection framework that adjusts the training dataset during distillation based on real-time changes in DMC values.
A system for automatically matching training datasets to student models in knowledge distillation by computing compatibility scores.
idea_ch: 一种数据-模型兼容性(DMC)度量指标，联合评估数据质量、相对难度和学生能力，用于判断数据集对推理蒸馏的适用性。
一种基于DMC作为筛选标准的推理蒸馏数据选择方法，通过过滤训练数据提升学生模型性能。
一种动态数据选择框架，根据蒸馏过程中DMC值的实时变化动态调整训练数据集。
一种通过计算兼容性分数自动匹配训练数据集与学生模型的知识蒸馏系统。

title: Rethinking Literature Search Evaluation: Deep Research Helps, and Human Citation Lists Are Not a Ground Truth
summary: We study large-scale literature search from two complementary angles: improving the retrieval pipeline, and stress-testing the human reference list as an evaluation target. First, we implement a Deep Research pipeline that processes the full query paper and expands the retrieved results breadth-first along their bibliographies, and show that it substantially outperforms vanilla API-only search, raising recall on RollingEval-Jun25 (a 250-paper literature-search benchmark) from below 20% to above 80%. Second, we use a neutral LLM-as-a-judge to determine if human references are sound ground truth for the task. We find significant limitations: only 51% of human citations are judged moderately relevant or higher, against 86--88% for the strongest AI-based re-rankers. We study this gap on the OpenAlex co-authorship graph, finding that humans are 2.5x more likely than the best AI re-rankers to cite a direct collaborator. Together, our results argue against single-axis literature-search evaluation: recall, topical-relevance scoring, ranked-list diversity, and a co-authorship-distance diagnostic each measure complementary properties of citation quality and should be reported jointly.

AI.tldr: 本文从两个互补角度研究大规模文献检索：一是改进检索管道，二是压力测试人工参考文献作为评估目标。结果表明，Deep Research管道显著优于纯API搜索，且仅51%的人类引用被判为中等相关或更高，而最强AI重排序器达86-88%，人类引用直接合作者的概率是AI的2.5倍。建议联合评估多个维度。
AI.motivation: 现有文献检索评估过度依赖人工引用列表作为"金标准"，但其可靠性未经充分检验；同时，传统API检索方法召回率较低，需要更高效的检索管道。
AI.method: 1) 构建Deep Research管道：处理完整查询论文，沿参考文献广度优先扩展检索结果。2) 使用中性LLM-as-a-judge评估人工引用与AI重排序结果的相关性。3) 在OpenAlex合著网络上分析引用偏差。
AI.result: Deep Research管道在RollingEval-Jun25基准上将召回率从低于20%提升至80%以上。仅51%的人类引用达到中等相关以上，而最强AI重排序器达86-88%。人类引用直接合作者的概率是AI的2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 文献检索评估不应仅依赖单一指标，应联合报告召回率、主题相关性评分、排序列表多样性和合著距离诊断等多个互补维度。
idea_en: A breadth-first bibliography expansion method for deep literature search that processes the full query paper and recursively expands along citation graphs, significantly improving recall.
A LLM-as-a-judge framework for evaluating citation relevance, providing neutral assessment of human reference list quality against AI-based re-rankers.
A multi-dimensional evaluation methodology for literature search combining recall, topical relevance, ranked-list diversity, and co-authorship distance diagnostics.
A co-authorship graph analysis method to detect citation bias, quantifying the over-citation of direct collaborators by human researchers compared to AI systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向深度文献搜索的广度优先参考文献扩展方法，处理完整查询论文并沿引用图递归扩展，显著提升召回率。
一种基于LLM作为裁判的引用相关性评估框架，提供对人工参考文献质量相对于AI重排序器的中性评估。
一种多维度文献检索评估方法，结合召回率、主题相关性、排序列表多样性和合著距离诊断等多个指标。
一种利用合著者图谱分析检测引用偏差的方法，量化人类研究者相比AI系统对直接合作者的过度引用现象。

title: Surfacing Isolated Learners with Outcome-Independent Mediation of Feedback between Teachers and Students Using AI
comment: Accepted to HAI-Agency Workshop on Orchestrating Human and AI Agency for Proactive and Reflective Learning
summary: AI-augmented classrooms generate rich teacher and student feedback before graded outcomes become available, yet these signals can be difficult to translate into timely instructional decisions. We propose an interpretable decision layer: a transparent mechanism that ranks course topics requiring attention without using grades or post-hoc outcome labels. The approach combines three signals: student learning difficulty prevalence, disagreement between learner self-reports and observed difficulties, and unresolved teacher concerns. The output is a ranked set of topic priorities with per-topic decision records explaining each ranking. In one graduate CS course offering ($n=5$ instructor interviews; $n=279$ survey responses), prioritized topics aligned with instructor concerns (top-5 overlap 3/5; Spearman $ρ=0.80$) and student-reported topic difficulty ($ρ=0.46$, $p=.048$). Multi-signal integration also surfaced learners not identified through individual signal sources alone (AUC $=0.96$ vs. $0.91$ for gap prevalence alone). Reflective thinking, help-seeking, and self-efficacy provided additional evidence that student behavioral signals align with learning-related constructs. While preliminary, these findings suggest that transparent coordination mechanisms may help support human-AI co-agency when feedback is incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的决策层机制，在无成绩或后验标签条件下，通过融合学生困难普遍性、自报告与观察困难的不一致性、以及教师未解决问题三类信号，对课程主题进行优先级排序，帮助教师在教学过程中及时做出决策。
AI.motivation: AI增强课堂产生大量师生反馈，但这些信号难以及时转化为教学决策。现有方法多依赖成绩或后验标签，无法在形成性阶段提供可操作的、透明的优先级建议。
AI.method: 提出一种可解释决策层，结合三类信号：1)学生学习困难普遍性；2)学习者自报告与观察困难之间的不一致性；3)教师未解决的关注问题。输出为按优先级排序的主题列表，附带每个主题的决策记录。
AI.result: 在一门研究生CS课程中（5次教师访谈，279份调查问卷），优先级主题与教师关注点高度一致（top-5重叠3/5；Spearman ρ=0.80），与学生报告的主题困难度相关（ρ=0.46, p=0.048）。多信号融合还发现了单一信号源无法识别出的学习者（AUC=0.96 vs 0.91）。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，透明的协调机制可以在反馈不完整的情况下支持人机协同决策，有助于实现人类与AI的共主体性（co-agency）。
idea_en: A transparent decision layer for ranking course topics requiring attention without using grades or post-hoc outcome labels, combining student learning difficulty prevalence, self-report vs. observed difficulty disagreement, and unresolved teacher concerns.
A per-topic decision record mechanism that explains each ranking decision, providing interpretable justifications for prioritized course topics in AI-augmented classrooms.

A multi-signal fusion method for identifying at-risk learners by integrating difficulty prevalence, self-report inconsistency, and teacher concerns, achieving higher AUC than using any single signal alone.
A human-AI co-agency coordination mechanism that operates under incomplete feedback conditions, enabling timely instructional decisions before graded outcomes are available.
idea_ch: 一种可解释的决策层机制，无需成绩或后验标签即可对需要关注的课程主题进行优先级排序，融合学生学习困难普遍性、自报告与观察困难的不一致性、以及教师未解决的关注问题。
一种按主题记录决策的机制，为每个优先级排序的主题提供可解释的决策说明，增强AI增强课堂中决策的透明度。
一种多信号融合方法，通过整合困难普遍性、自报告不一致性和教师关注点来识别有风险的学习者，其AUC高于任何单一信号源。
一种在反馈不完整条件下支持人机协同决策的协调机制，能够在成绩结果可用之前提供及时的教学干预建议。

title: DenseSteer: Steering Small Language Models towards Dense Math Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning abilities, while smaller models (<= 3B parameters) significantly underperform on multi-step reasoning tasks. Based on empirical analyses of the Qwen-2.5 model family on math reasoning benchmarks, we find that more proficient reasoning is associated with fewer reasoning steps but higher information density per step, a property we term Dense Reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we propose DenseSteer, a training-free inference-time steering framework that enhances small-model reasoning by modulating internal representations toward dense reasoning patterns. Experiments show that our method yields consistent accuracy improvements without increasing token-level Negative Log-Likelihood, highlighting dense reasoning as an effective structural approach to mathematical problem solving.

AI.tldr: 提出DenseSteer框架，通过推理阶段内部表征调控，让小模型（≤3B参数）模仿大模型的高密度推理模式，从而提升数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 小模型（≤3B参数）在多步推理任务上表现显著弱于大语言模型，现有方法多依赖训练或知识蒸馏，成本高且灵活性差。
AI.method: 提出DenseSteer，一种无需训练的推理时调控框架，通过调制内部表征，引导小模型向"密集推理"模式靠拢——即更少的推理步骤但每步更高的信息密度。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上取得一致的准确率提升，且不增加token级别的负对数似然，表明密集推理是一种有效的结构优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 密集推理（更少步骤、更高信息密度）是提升小模型数学推理能力的有效结构范式，基于表征调控的推理时方法无需额外训练即可实现性能提升。
idea_en: DenseSteer framework: A training-free inference-time steering method that modulates internal representations of small LLMs to induce dense reasoning patterns with fewer steps but higher information density per step.

Dense Reasoning metric: A novel quantitative measure characterizing reasoning quality based on step count and information density per reasoning step, enabling systematic evaluation of reasoning structures.
Representation modulation for reasoning: A technique to steer smaller models' internal hidden states toward reasoning patterns observed in larger, more capable models without modifying model weights.
idea_ch: DenseSteer框架：一种无需训练的推理时内部表征调控方法，通过引导小模型内部表征向密集推理模式靠拢（步数更少、每步信息密度更高），提升小模型数学推理能力。
密集推理度量方法：一种基于推理步数和每步信息密度来量化推理质量的新型评估指标，可用于系统评估推理结构的优劣。
推理表征调控技术：在不修改模型权重的前提下，通过调控小模型内部隐藏状态向大模型的推理模式靠拢的技术，实现零额外训练成本的推理能力迁移。

title: Provably Secure Agent Guardrail
summary: As large language models transition from bounded generative engines to agents with expansive execution privileges, AI going out of control precipitates a fundamental crisis in artificial intelligence security. Existing defense architectures heavily rely on empirical semantic guardrails and probabilistic large model adjudicators, mechanisms that fail to provide deterministic security lower bounds when facing complex semantic symbol decoupling attacks. To overcome this empirical semantic guardrail dilemma, this paper proposes a new security paradigm for agents based on the fundamental limitations of logical reasoning. Based on this paradigm, we further introduce an executable Proof-Constrained Action (ePCA) framework with a neural symbolic isolation architecture. This framework abandons semantic trust in natural language, forcing agents to losslessly formalize their intentions into first-order logical mathematical constraints before performing physical operations. Empirical evaluations of macroscopic and microscopic two-dimensional dynamic adversarial systems demonstrate that our formal verification mechanism achieves zero attack success rate and zero false positive rate across the evaluated scenarios, with extremely low computational latency. This research provides a conditional formal foundation under explicit system assumptions and an engineering paradigm for constructing the underlying defense foundation for future intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型作为智能体执行操作时的安全问题，本文提出了一种基于逻辑推理根本局限性的新安全范式，并实现了可执行证明约束动作（ePCA）框架，通过神经符号隔离架构将智能体意图无损形式化为一级逻辑数学约束，在二维动态对抗系统中实现零攻击成功率和零误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有安全防御架构依赖经验性语义护栏和概率性大模型裁决器，在面对复杂语义符号解耦攻击时无法提供确定性安全下界，存在"经验语义护栏困境"。
AI.method: 提出ePCA框架：采用神经符号隔离架构，放弃自然语言的语义信任，在智能体执行物理操作前，强制将其意图无损形式化为一级逻辑数学约束，通过形式化验证机制进行证明约束。
AI.result: 在宏观和微观二维动态对抗系统中，形式化验证机制实现了零攻击成功率、零误报率，且计算延迟极低。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为构建智能系统底层防御基础提供了条件化的形式化基础（在显式系统假设下）和工程范式。
idea_en: A neural-symbolic isolation architecture that forces LLM agents to losslessly formalize intentions into first-order logical constraints before execution
A Proof-Constrained Action (ePCA) framework that replaces semantic guardrails with formal verification mechanisms
A method for achieving deterministic security lower bounds in AI agents through mathematical constraint enforcement
A zero-overhead formal verification system that achieves 0% attack success rate and 0% false positive rate in dynamic adversarial environments
A conditional formal foundation for AI safety that operates under explicit system assumptions
idea_ch: 一种神经符号隔离架构，强制LLM智能体在执行前将意图无损形式化为一级逻辑约束
一种可执行证明约束动作（ePCA）框架，用形式化验证机制替代语义护栏
一种通过数学约束强制执行实现AI智能体确定性安全下界的方法
一种在动态对抗环境中实现零攻击成功率和零误报率的零开销形式化验证系统
一种在显式系统假设下运行的AI安全条件形式化基础

title: OpenClawBench: Benchmarking Process-side Anomalies in Real-world Agent Execution Trajectories
summary: Task success can hide process anomalies in real-world agent executions. An agent may pass the final task oracle while still accumulating unresolved ambiguity, unsafe external writes, ignored errors, weakly grounded commitments, or capability-boundary overcommitment. We study this mismatch as the Outcome-Process Gap and introduce OpenClawBench, a large-scale dataset for measuring and supervising process-side anomalies in real agent execution processes. OpenClawBench is built from BFCL-driven OpenClaw sessions produced by 6 source models and contains 31,264 annotated trajectories. It aligns task-oracle outcomes with structured process evidence. FullTax converts the aligned trajectories into structured anomaly supervision: binary labels, supporting evidence, onset/span localization, severity, recoverability, and a 5-class anomaly taxonomy. Using OpenClawBench, we make the Outcome-Process Gap measurable. Among 31,135 oracle-passing executions, 2,904 are still labeled process-anomalous under FullTax. These results show that success-only evaluation misses a concrete class of process-side failures in real agent executions. A LoRA-fine-tuned Gemma 3 12B detector trained on the high-confidence FullTax supervised pool reaches binary F1=0.729 on the cleaner-labels held-out test split. Together, OpenClawBench turns real agent execution logs into auditable and reusable supervision for studying, diagnosing, and operationally monitoring runtime agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenClawBench数据集和FullTax标注框架，揭示AI智能体执行过程中任务成功但过程异常（结果-过程鸿沟）的问题，并实现过程异常的检测与监督。
AI.motivation: 传统智能体评估仅关注最终任务是否成功（oracle-passing），忽略了执行过程中存在的歧义未解决、不安全外部写入、错误被忽略、承诺弱化、能力边界过度承诺等过程异常。这种结果-过程鸿沟导致成功导向评估遗漏大量过程侧故障。
AI.method: 基于BFCL驱动的OpenClaw会话构建数据集；提出FullTax标注框架将轨迹转换为结构化异常监督（二分类标签、支撑证据、起止定位、严重性、可恢复性、5类异常分类体系）；使用LoRA微调Gemma 3 12B检测器进行异常检测。
AI.result: OpenClawBench包含31,264条标注轨迹；31,135条通过oracle的执行中，2,904条被FullTax标注为过程异常；LoRA微调Gemma 3 12B在清洁标签测试集上达到F1=0.729。
AI.conclusion: 成功导向评估确实遗漏了大量过程侧故障，OpenClawBench将真实智能体执行日志转化为可审计、可复用的监督数据，用于研究、诊断和监控运行时智能体可靠性。
idea_en: A method for detecting process-side anomalies in AI agent executions by constructing structured anomaly supervision from aligned trajectory data, including binary labels, supporting evidence, onset/span localization, severity scoring, recoverability assessment, and a multi-class anomaly taxonomy.

A FullTax framework for converting agent execution trajectories into auditable structured anomaly annotations, enabling systematic identification of process anomalies such as unresolved ambiguity, unsafe external writes, ignored errors, weakly grounded commitments, and capability-boundary overcommitment.
A training approach using LoRA-fine-tuned large language models (e.g., Gemma 3 12B) as process anomaly detectors trained on high-confidence structured supervision pools from agent execution logs.
A system for outcome-process gap measurement that evaluates agent task success alongside structured process evidence, identifying oracle-passing executions that still contain process-side anomalies.
idea_ch: 一种AI智能体执行过程异常检测方法，通过对齐的轨迹数据构建结构化异常监督信息，包括二分类标签、支撑证据、起止定位、严重性评分、可恢复性评估及多类异常分类体系。
FullTax框架：将智能体执行轨迹转化为可审计的结构化异常标注，系统识别未解决歧义、不安全外部写入、忽略错误、弱化承诺、能力边界过度承诺等五类过程异常。
基于LoRA微调大语言模型（如Gemma 3 12B）作为过程异常检测器的训练方法，利用高置信度结构化监督池从智能体执行日志中学习异常模式。
一种结果-过程鸿沟测量系统，同时评估智能体任务成功性与结构化过程证据，识别通过最终任务oracle但存在过程侧异常的执行轨迹。

title: Harmonizing Real-Time Constraints and Long-Horizon Reasoning: An Asynchronous Agentic Framework for Dynamic Scheduling
summary: The Dynamic Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (DFJSP) necessitates a trade-off between instant reaction to stochastic disturbances and global optimization of production goals. Conventional priority rules are insufficiently flexible to handle complex disruptions, whereas learning-based approaches often compromise interpretability or fail to generalize across problem scales. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) offer advanced reasoning capabilities to bridge this gap, their substantial inference latency is incompatible with the millisecond-level decision cycles of industrial control systems. To resolve this conflict, we introduce RACE-Sched, an asynchronous agent-based framework that decouples policy execution from logical reasoning via a dual-stream architecture. The Reactive Stream executes low-latency symbolic heuristics to enable real-time dispatching, while the parallel Deliberative Stream leverages an LLM to synthesize, validate, and evolve these rules. Candidate rules undergo rigorous testing in a sandbox and are deployed via atomic updates, ensuring safety without blocking the control loop. Additionally, a semantic rule repository indexes validated heuristics for retrieval-based initialization which enhances transferability across problem scales. Extensive evaluations on GEN-Bench, MK-Bench, and JMS-Bench demonstrate that RACE-Sched outperforms leading Deep Reinforcement Learning and other LLM-based baselines. This approach harmonizes real-time constraints with long-horizon reasoning to achieve superior solution quality and robust adaptation to dynamic events.

AI.tldr: RACE-Sched提出了一种异步代理框架，通过双流架构（反应流执行低延迟符号启发式规则，深思流利用LLM合成和优化规则）来解决动态柔性作业车间调度问题中实时决策与全局优化的矛盾，在多个基准测试上优于DRL和其他LLM方法。
AI.motivation: DFJSP需要在即时响应随机扰动与全局生产目标优化之间进行权衡，传统优先规则灵活性不足，学习方法缺乏可解释性或泛化能力，LLM推理延迟无法满足毫秒级工业控制需求。
AI.method: 提出RACE-Sched异步代理框架，包含：1) 反应流：执行低延迟符号启发式规则进行实时调度；2) 深思流：并行使用LLM合成、验证和演化规则；3) 沙盒测试对新规则进行严格验证后通过原子更新部署；4) 语义规则库索引已验证的启发式规则用于检索初始化。
AI.result: 在GEN-Bench、MK-Bench和JMS-Bench上，RACE-Sched优于领先的深度强化学习方法和基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RACE-Sched通过解耦策略执行与逻辑推理，协调了实时约束与长期推理，实现了更优的解决方案质量和鲁棒适应动态事件的能力。
idea_en: Asynchronous dual-stream agent architecture that decouples policy execution from logical reasoning for real-time scheduling, enabling low-latency symbolic heuristic execution in a Reactive Stream while parallel Deliberative Stream uses LLM for rule synthesis.
Sandbox-based rule validation mechanism that rigorously tests candidate scheduling rules before atomic deployment, ensuring safety without blocking the real-time control loop.
Semantic rule repository with retrieval-based initialization that indexes validated heuristics, enabling transferability of scheduling knowledge across problem scales.
Atomic update mechanism for deploying evolved scheduling rules that does not interrupt the continuous control loop of industrial scheduling systems.
LLM-driven rule evolution system that synthesizes, validates, and iteratively improves symbolic scheduling heuristics while maintaining interpretability.
idea_ch: 异步双流代理架构：将策略执行与逻辑推理解耦，反应流执行低延迟符号启发式规则实现实时调度，深思流并行使用LLM进行规则合成与优化
沙盒规则验证机制：候选调度规则在沙盒环境中经过严格测试后通过原子更新部署，确保安全性且不阻塞实时控制回路
语义规则库与检索初始化：索引已验证的启发式规则，支持跨问题尺度的调度知识迁移
原子更新部署机制：在不中断工业调度系统连续控制回路的前提下，动态部署演化后的调度规则
LLM驱动的规则演化系统：利用大语言模型合成、验证并迭代改进可解释的符号调度启发式规则

title: When and How Human Curation Backfires: Preference Alignment under Multi-Model Self-Consuming Loop
summary: Foundation models are increasingly trained on synthetic data generated by prior model iterations rather than exclusively on real data. This self-consuming training paradigm can lead to model collapse, divergence, or bias amplification. Recent work (Ferbach et al., 2024) shows that incorporating human curation into the loop can steer a self-consuming model toward human-aligned behavior, but these analyses focus on a single, isolated model that solely consumes its own outputs. In practice, however, models often interact and train on input-output pairs produced by other models. This paper studies self-consuming training in the multi-model regime. We first formalize a framework for interacting self-consuming models and characterize when the resulting dynamical system converges to a stable point. We then examine how human curation of one model affects its own alignment (self-influence) and how such effects propagate to other models (cross-influence). Unlike isolated settings where human curation always enhances model alignment, we show that cross-model interactions can dampen or even invert this effect, ultimately degrading long-term alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模型自消费训练范式，发现模型间的交叉影响可能削弱甚至逆转人工干预带来的对齐效果，与单模型场景不同。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅关注单一模型自消费训练中人工干预的效果，但实际中模型常与其他模型交互并消费彼此生成的训练数据，因此需要研究多模型场景下的自消费训练动力学。
AI.method: 形式化了交互式自消费模型框架，刻画动态系统收敛到稳定点的条件，并分析人工干预对自身（自影响）及其他模型（交叉影响）的对齐效果。
AI.result: 与单模型场景不同，多模型交互中交叉影响可能削弱甚至逆转人工干预的正面效果，最终降低长期对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 多模型自消费训练中，模型间交互效应复杂，人工干预的效果不能简单从单模型场景推广，需考虑跨模型影响。
idea_en: A multi-model self-consuming training framework that formalizes interactions between models consuming each other's synthetic data outputs.
A method to characterize convergence conditions of dynamical systems in interacting self-consuming training regimes.
A cross-influence analysis technique to measure how human curation of one model affects alignment of other models in multi-model settings.
A system for detecting and mitigating alignment degradation caused by cross-model interactions in self-consuming training pipelines.
idea_ch: 一种多模型自消费训练框架，形式化描述了模型间互相消费对方合成数据输出的交互机制
一种刻画交互式自消费训练动态系统收敛条件的方法
一种交叉影响分析技术，用于测量多模型场景下人工干预一个模型对其他模型对齐效果的影响
一种检测和缓解自消费训练流程中因模型间交叉交互导致的对齐退化系统

title: Indexing the Unreadable: LLM-Native Recursive Construction and Search of Service Taxonomies
comment: Preprint. 8 pages main paper + appendix; 2 figures. Under submission to EMNLP 2026
summary: The era of the Internet of Agents (IoA) is taking shape: LLM agents are expected to fulfill user goals by orchestrating fast-growing populations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) endpoints, reusable skills, and other LLM-callable services. Yet LLMs face a structural mismatch with this regime: effective context is a scarce resource that does not scale with the number of services. Concatenating thousands of service descriptions into a prompt overflows the context window, and even when the window is large enough, models systematically under-attend to information in the middle of long inputs, the well-documented Lost-in-the-Middle phenomenon. This is fundamentally a question of context management for service discovery. To address this, we propose an LLM-native progressive-disclosure scheme and its concrete instantiation, A2X (Agent-to-Anything service discovery): an LLM-driven pipeline that automatically organizes the registered services into a hierarchical taxonomy and walks it layer by layer at query time, so that every LLM call sees only a small candidate set highly relevant to the user query. This decouples effective-context scarcity from registry size and significantly reduces token consumption while improving retrieval accuracy. Compared to full-context dumping, A2X achieves a 6.2-point Hit Rate gain at one-ninth the prompt-token cost; compared to the state-of-the-art open-source embedding-based baseline, A2X improves Hit Rate by more than 20 points.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM智能体在IoA场景下服务数量激增导致的上下文窗口溢出和Lost-in-the-Middle问题，提出A2X渐进式服务发现方案，通过LLM驱动的层次化分类树实现逐层缩小候选范围，以极低token成本显著提升检索命中率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需要编排大量MCP服务器、A2A端点、可复用技能等服务，但有效上下文是稀缺资源，无法随服务数量扩展。直接拼接数千个服务描述会导致上下文窗口溢出，即使窗口足够大，模型也会出现Lost-in-the-Middle现象，无法有效关注长输入中间部分的信息。
AI.method: 提出A2X（Agent-to-Anything service discovery）方案：一个LLM原生的渐进式信息揭示机制。核心思路是构建LLM驱动的管道，自动将注册服务组织成层次化分类树，在查询时逐层遍历，使得每次LLM调用只看到与用户查询高度相关的小规模候选集。
AI.result: 相比全上下文转储，A2X命中率提升6.2个百分点，提示词token成本降至九分之一；相比最先进的开源基于嵌入的基线，A2X命中率提升超过20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: A2X通过将有效上下文稀缺性与注册表规模解耦，显著降低token消耗同时提高检索精度，有效解决了IoA场景下服务发现的核心瓶颈。
idea_en: An LLM-native progressive-disclosure pipeline that automatically organizes registered services into a hierarchical taxonomy for efficient service discovery
A query-time layer-by-layer traversal mechanism that ensures each LLM call only sees a small candidate set highly relevant to the user query
A method to decouple effective-context scarcity from registry size, significantly reducing token consumption while improving retrieval accuracy
idea_ch: 一种LLM原生的渐进式信息揭示管道，自动将注册服务组织成层次化分类树以实现高效服务发现
一种查询时逐层遍历机制，确保每次LLM调用只看到与用户查询高度相关的小规模候选集
一种将有效上下文稀缺性与注册表规模解耦的方法，显著降低token消耗同时提高检索精度

title: CoHyDE: Iterative Co-Training of LLM Rewriter & Dense Encoder for Tool Retrieval
summary: Tool retrieval over large API catalogs is a core bottleneck for LLM agents: user queries arrive in colloquial, often underspecified language, while the catalog uses technical API vocabulary that no fixed encoder can bridge on its own. The two dominant training approaches, contrastive encoder fine-tuning and HyDE-style query expansion with a frozen LLM, address this problem from opposite ends and fail in complementary directions: the fine-tuned encoder excels when the query's surface form already matches the catalog but collapses when it does not, while zero-shot HyDE is more robust to underspecified queries yet generates catalog-unaware hypothetical descriptions that degrade retrieval when queries are well-formed. We introduce CoHyDE, an iterative procedure that trains the dense encoder and the LLM rewriter as a single co-evolving system: the encoder is retrained with InfoNCE on catalog-style hypothetical descriptions produced by the rewriter, and the rewriter is preference-aligned via DPO against the encoder's retrieval scores, with both sides warm-started on the tool catalog before the loop begins. On a ~10k tool subset of the ToolBench catalog, three rounds of CoHyDE improve over the strongest single-component baseline by +2.5 pp NDCG@5 on standard queries and +6.3 pp on held-out vague queries, with gains as large as +8 pp on the hardest vague tier. Ablations confirm that co-training is the key ingredient: using either component in isolation fails to match CoHyDE on both well-formed and vague queries, with losses of up to -8 pp on vague queries.

AI.tldr: CoHyDE是一种迭代训练方法，将密集编码器和LLM重写器作为协同演化系统共同训练，通过InfoNCE和DPO偏好对齐，在工具检索任务上相比单组件基线提升显著（标准查询+2.5 pp NDCG@5，模糊查询+6.3 pp）。
AI.motivation: 用户查询常使用口语化、不精确的语言，而API目录使用专业的技术词汇，单一编码器无法弥合这一语义鸿沟。现有方法（对比编码器微调和HyDE式查询扩展）分别在查询形式匹配或模糊查询场景下失效。
AI.method: 1) 编码器使用重写器生成的目录风格假设描述进行InfoNCE再训练；2) 重写器通过DPO基于编码器的检索分数进行偏好对齐；3) 两者在循环开始前基于工具目录进行热启动；4) 迭代执行三个轮次。
AI.result: 在ToolBench约10k工具子集上，CoHyDE在标准查询上NDCG@5提升+2.5 pp，在模糊查询上提升+6.3 pp，最难模糊查询层级提升高达+8 pp。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练（co-training）是关键要素，单独使用任一组件在标准查询和模糊查询上均无法匹敌CoHyDE的性能，模糊查询损失高达-8 pp。
idea_en: Co-evolutionary training framework for dense encoder and LLM rewriter in tool retrieval systems
Iterative preference alignment of query rewriter via DPO using encoder's retrieval scores as reward
InfoNCE retraining of dense encoder on catalog-style hypothetical descriptions generated by the rewriter
Warm-start strategy for both encoder and rewriter on tool catalog before co-training loop
idea_ch: 一种面向工具检索系统的密集编码器与LLM重写器协同演化训练框架
利用编码器检索分数作为奖励信号，通过DPO对查询重写器进行迭代偏好对齐的方法
在重写器生成的目录风格假设描述上对密集编码器进行InfoNCE再训练的技术
协同训练循环开始前在工具目录上对编码器和重写器进行热启动的策略

title: Diagnosing Harmful Continuation in Answer-Correct Long-CoT Training Traces
summary: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces are widely used as supervision for reasoning-oriented LLM SFT, yet answer-correct traces can still lead to markedly different fine-tuning outcomes. We study post-conclusion continuation in answer-correct long-CoT data: a continuation where the answer appears sufficiently supported, but the trace continues with additional reasoning that remains in the supervised target. To test its training effect, we use a delete-only editor to construct answer-preserving suffix removal and compare CoT-based SFT on the original and processed traces. We observe improved SFT outcomes after removing the editor-identified post-conclusion continuation, suggesting that this continuation is harmful to training in our setting. We therefore refer to this empirically supported phenomenon as harmful continuation. Beyond this intervention, we further characterize the removed post-conclusion continuation through uncertainty and hidden-state progress. We observe persistent local uncertainty together with weakened terminal-directional progress, forming an uncertainty--geometry mismatch. Finally, we instantiate Harmful Continuation Cut (HCC), a lightweight boundary proxy that approximates the editor-identified post-conclusion continuation boundary.

AI.tldr: 论文研究长思维链（CoT）数据中"结论后延续"（post-conclusion continuation）对SFT训练的负面影响，提出通过删除这种延续来改善微调效果，并设计了轻量级边界代理HCC来识别并裁剪有害延续。
AI.motivation: 长CoT轨迹中，即使答案正确的数据，不同的推理轨迹也会导致截然不同的微调效果。论文发现"结论后延续"（答案已充分支持后仍继续推理的部分）可能对训练有害，需要系统性研究这一现象并找到处理方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用仅删除操作的编辑器构建答案保持的后缀删除，对比原始与处理后的CoT轨迹的SFT效果。2) 通过不确定性和隐藏态进度刻画被删除的结论后延续，发现局部不确定性持续存在而终端方向进度减弱，形成"不确定性-几何不匹配"。3) 提出轻量级边界代理HCC（Harmful Continuation Cut）近似识别结论后延续的边界。
AI.result: 删除编辑者识别的结论后延续后，SFT效果显著提升，证实这种延续对训练有害。通过不确定性-几何不匹配特征刻画了这一现象。
AI.conclusion: 结论后延续是长CoT数据中一种有害的训练信号，通过HCC方法裁剪后可提升SFT效果，为推理导向的LLM训练数据优化提供了新思路。
idea_en: A method for improving LLM SFT by identifying and removing post-conclusion continuation in long chain-of-thought traces using a delete-only editor while preserving answer correctness.

A lightweight boundary proxy (HCC - Harmful Continuation Cut) that approximates the boundary where post-conclusion continuation begins in long CoT traces, enabling automated harmful continuation removal.

A training data optimization technique based on uncertainty-geometry mismatch detection, where persistent local uncertainty combined with weakened terminal-directional progress signals the presence of harmful continuation.
A delete-only editing approach for constructing answer-preserving suffix removal in reasoning traces, which selectively removes post-conclusion continuations without altering the original answer.
idea_ch: 一种通过仅删除编辑器识别并移除长思维链轨迹中结论后延续（post-conclusion continuation）的方法，在保留答案正确性的前提下改善LLM的SFT效果。
一种轻量级边界代理HCC（Harmful Continuation Cut），用于近似识别长CoT轨迹中结论后延续的起始边界，实现自动化有害延续裁剪。
一种基于不确定性-几何不匹配检测的训练数据优化技术，通过持续存在的局部不确定性与减弱的终端方向进度的组合特征，识别有害延续信号。
一种针对推理轨迹的仅删除式编辑方法，构建答案保留的后缀移除操作，选择性地去除结论后延续而不改变原始答案内容。

title: Entropy-KL Divergence-based Token Masking: A Novel Approach for Selective Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training paradigm for large language models. This paradigm provides a cold-start for RL exploration, avoiding the inefficiency of pure RL where on-policy sampling yields insufficient positive samples. However, in practice, existing approaches often use a small amount of data for SFT initialization compared to the RL phase, which can cause the model to fit the limited samples and shift away from its pre-trained distribution. This distribution shift impedes the model's ability to effectively explore during subsequent RL training. To address this challenge, we propose that in low-data regimes, SFT should prioritize activating task-relevant capabilities rather than memorizing specific content. Along this line, we propose EKSFT (Entropy-KL Selective Fine-Tuning), which selectively masks tokens that exhibit either high entropy or high KL divergence from a reference model. By excluding these high-uncertainty, distribution-shifting tokens from imitation, EKSFT injects task-specific knowledge while preserving the integrity of the model's pre-trained distribution. Empirical evaluations on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EKSFT consistently outperforms standard SFT. Further RL fine-tuning from the EKSFT model yields consistently better post-RL performance, indicating improved exploration for the RL stage. Our codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/MINE-USTC/EKSFT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EKSFT方法，通过选择性屏蔽高熵或高KL散度的token，在低数据量场景下进行有监督微调，保留预训练分布完整性，改善后续强化学习的探索效率。
AI.motivation: 在低数据量场景下，标准的SFT会使模型过拟合有限的样本，导致模型偏离预训练分布，阻碍后续RL阶段的有效探索。
AI.method: EKSFT方法选择性屏蔽那些相对于参考模型表现出高熵或高KL散度的token，排除这些高不确定性、导致分布偏移的token，从而在注入任务知识的同时保持预训练分布的完整性。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，EKSFT持续优于标准SFT，并且基于EKSFT模型进行的RL微调在RL后性能更好，表明改善了RL阶段的探索。
AI.conclusion: 在低数据量场景下，SFT应优先激活任务相关能力而非记忆特定内容，EKSFT为这一思路提供了有效实现。
idea_en: A selective token masking method for supervised fine-tuning that filters out high-entropy and high-KL divergence tokens to preserve pre-trained distribution integrity.
A two-stage fine-tuning framework where selective SFT initialization improves subsequent RL exploration efficiency in low-data regimes.
An entropy and KL divergence-based token selection mechanism that distinguishes between content memorization and capability activation during fine-tuning.
idea_ch: 一种用于有监督微调的选择性令牌屏蔽方法，通过过滤高熵和高KL散度的令牌来保持预训练分布的完整性。
一种两阶段微调框架，在低数据量场景下通过选择性SFT初始化改善后续RL探索效率。
一种基于熵和KL散度的令牌选择机制，在微调过程中区分内容记忆和能力激活。

title: Rubric-Guided Process Reward for Stepwise Model Routing
summary: Stepwise model routing improves the efficiency of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) by assigning each reasoning step to a suitable model. Recent methods formulate routing as a sequential decision process and train the router with reinforcement learning. However, although they model routing as a process, they still supervise the router with outcome rewards. Such rewards only reflect final answer correctness and fail to evaluate intermediate routing decisions, which can weaken performance and generalization. To address this gap, we propose RoRo, a rubric-guided process reward framework for stepwise model routing. RoRo first collects diverse routing trajectories and constructs preference pairs based on outcome, cost, and process quality. It then trains a Rubricor to generate a query-specific evaluation rubric and a Judge to score routing trajectories under this rubric through alternating optimization. The resulting process rewards are combined with outcome rewards to optimize the routing policy via GRPO. Experiments on five reasoning benchmarks under both same-family and cross-family settings show that RoRo consistently outperforms strong baselines and achieves better accuracy and cost trade-offs.

AI.tldr: RoRo提出了一种基于评分准则的过程奖励框架，用于逐步模型路由，通过构建偏好对、训练Rubricor生成查询特定评分准则以及Judge评分，结合结果奖励优化路由策略，在多个推理基准上取得了更优的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将模型路由建模为序列决策过程并用强化学习训练，但仅使用最终答案正确性作为结果奖励，无法评估中间路由决策的质量，导致性能和泛化能力受限。
AI.method: RoRo首先收集多样化的路由轨迹，基于结果、成本和过程质量构建偏好对；然后通过交替优化训练Rubricor生成查询特定的评估准则，以及Judge在此准则下对路由轨迹进行评分；最终将过程奖励与结果奖励结合，通过GRPO优化路由策略。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上，同族和跨族设置下，RoRo一致优于强基线方法，实现了更好的准确率与成本之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于评分准则的过程奖励框架能有效弥补结果奖励的不足，提升逐步模型路由的性能和泛化能力。
idea_en: Rubric-guided process reward framework for stepwise model routing (RoRo): a system that constructs preference pairs from diverse routing trajectories based on outcome, cost, and process quality, trains a Rubricor to generate query-specific evaluation rubrics, and trains a Judge to score routing trajectories under said rubrics via alternating optimization, then combines process rewards with outcome rewards to optimize routing policy via GRPO.

Alternating optimization method for training a rubric generator (Rubricor) and a trajectory Judge, where the Rubricor produces query-specific evaluation criteria and the Judge scores routing decisions accordingly, enabling process-level supervision for sequential model routing decisions.

Preference pair construction mechanism for stepwise model routing that jointly considers outcome correctness, monetary cost, and intermediate process quality to create more informative training signals for routing policy optimization.

Process reward combined with outcome reward for GRPO-based reinforcement learning optimization of model routing policies, addressing the limitation of outcome-only rewards in sequential routing decision tasks.
idea_ch: 基于评分准则的逐步模型路由过程奖励框架（RoRo）：收集多样化的路由轨迹，基于结果、成本和过程质量构建偏好对，通过交替优化训练Rubricor生成查询特定评估准则和Judge评分，结合过程奖励与结果奖励通过GRPO优化路由策略。
交替优化方法用于训练评分准则生成器（Rubricor）和轨迹评分器（Judge），Rubricor生成查询特定的评估标准，Judge据此对路由决策进行评分，实现对序列模型路由决策的过程级监督。
面向逐步模型路由的偏好对构建机制，综合考虑结果正确性、经济成本和中间过程质量，为路由策略优化提供更丰富的训练信号。
将过程奖励与结果奖励相结合，用于基于GRPO的强化学习路由策略优化，解决了序列路由决策任务中仅使用结果奖励的局限性。

title: ConMoE: Expert-Pool Consolidation via Prototype Reassignment for MoE Compression
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation but still require storing and serving all experts, making deployment memory-intensive. Existing post-training compression methods mainly shrink this cost by pruning experts or merging their weights. We formulate post-training MoE compression as expert-pool consolidation: retaining a smaller set of pretrained experts as reusable prototypes and deterministically remapping each original expert reference to one selected prototype. This view separates the reduced expert pool from the reuse structure that represents the original expert slots, and allows prototype sharing within local layer scopes while preserving the original router interface. We propose ConMoE, a train-free prototype remapping framework that selects retained experts using calibration-based contribution and replaceability signals, then redirects original expert calls to the selected prototypes without weight updates or post-compression fine-tuning. Experiments on three pretrained MoE language models show that ConMoE matches or outperforms strong pruning and merging baselines in several settings, achieving the best average score on deepseek-moe-16b-base at both 25% and 50% routed-expert reduction, while remaining competitive on Qwen3-30B-A3B and OLMoE-1B-7B-0125. Ablations indicate that deterministic reassignment is the most stable component, whereas broader cross-layer sharing and post-hoc weight fusion are model-dependent.

AI.tldr: ConMoE提出了一种无训练的MoE专家池合并方法，通过保留少量预训练专家作为可复用原型，并确定性重映射原始专家引用到选定原型，在不微调的情况下实现模型压缩。
AI.motivation: MoE语言模型虽然减少了单token计算量，但仍需存储和加载所有专家，导致部署时内存占用巨大。现有后训练压缩方法主要通过剪枝或合并权重来缩减成本，但存在性能损失或需要额外微调的问题。
AI.method: 将MoE后训练压缩视为专家池整合问题：保留一个更小的预训练专家集合作为可复用原型，通过校准数据的贡献度和可替换性信号选择保留哪些专家，然后确定性重映射每个原始专家引用到选定的原型，无需权重更新或后压缩微调。支持局部层级内的原型共享，同时保留原始路由接口。
AI.result: 在deepseek-moe-16b-base上，在25%和50%路由专家缩减设置下均取得最佳平均分；在Qwen3-30B-A3B和OLMoE-1B-7B-0125上也具有竞争力。消融实验表明确定性重映射是最稳定的组件，而跨层共享和后验权重融合则依赖具体模型。
AI.conclusion: ConMoE作为一种无训练的原型重映射框架，在多种MoE语言模型上实现了与强剪枝和合并基线相当或更优的性能，为MoE模型的高效部署提供了新的压缩范式。
idea_en: A train-free expert pool consolidation method that retains a smaller set of pretrained experts as reusable prototypes and deterministically remaps original expert references to selected prototypes without weight updates or fine-tuning.
A calibration-based contribution and replaceability signal selection mechanism to determine which experts to retain in the compressed MoE model.
A deterministic reassignment strategy for redirecting original expert calls to selected prototypes that preserves the original router interface.
A cross-layer prototype sharing scheme that allows prototype reuse within local layer scopes while maintaining model performance.
A post-hoc weight fusion method that can be optionally applied after prototype remapping for further compression improvement in a model-dependent manner.
idea_ch: 一种无训练的专家池整合方法，保留少量预训练专家作为可复用原型，并将原始专家引用确定性重映射到选定原型，无需权重更新或微调。
基于校准数据的贡献度和可替换性信号选择机制，用于确定在压缩后的MoE模型中保留哪些专家。
一种确定性重映射策略，将原始专家调用重定向到选定的原型，同时保持原始路由接口不变。
一种跨层原型共享方案，允许在局部层级范围内复用原型，同时保持模型性能。
一种后验权重融合方法，可在原型重映射后按需应用，以模型依赖的方式进一步改善压缩效果。

title: PassNet: Scaling Large Language Models for Graph Compiler Pass Generation
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PassNet
summary: Modern tensor compilers such as TorchInductor deliver substantial speedups on mainstream models, yet face a systematic performance ceiling on long-tail workloads -- our profiling shows that 43% of real-world subgraphs experience end-to-end slowdowns under default compilation. While LLMs offer a path toward automated optimization, existing efforts focus on standalone kernel generation. We argue that pass generation -- where LLMs author structured graph transformations that integrate directly into compiler pipelines -- is the more appropriate abstraction. We propose PassNet, the first large-scale ecosystem for LLM-based compiler pass generation, comprising: (1) PassNet-Dataset, over 18K unique computational graphs from 100K real-world models; and (2) PassBench, 200 curated long-tail fusible tasks (comprising 2,060 subgraphs in total) evaluated under the Error-aware Speedup Score (ES_t) -- a metric unifying correctness, stability, and performance -- with layered integrity defenses against systematic LLM exploitation. Experiments reveal that PassBench is both highly discriminative and genuinely unsaturated: the best frontier model trails TorchInductor by 37% in aggregate, yet on individual subgraphs LLMs achieve up to 3x speedup over the same compiler -- indicating that the bottleneck is consistency, not capability. Fine-tuning a small model on merely ~4K PassNet trajectories yields a 2.67x improvement approaching frontier-model performance, demonstrating substantial headroom and validating PassNet as live training infrastructure for advancing LLM-driven compiler optimization. All data, benchmarks, and tooling are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PassNet是一个大规模生态系统，用于基于LLM的编译器pass生成，通过让LLM编写结构化图变换来优化张量编译器，在长尾计算图上相比TorchInductor最高可提升3倍速度，但需解决一致性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有张量编译器（如TorchInductor）在主流模型上表现良好，但在长尾负载上存在系统性性能瓶颈——43%的真实子图在默认编译下出现端到端减速。现有LLM优化工作聚焦于独立内核生成，作者认为pass生成（LLM编写结构化图变换并集成到编译器流水线）是更合适的抽象。
AI.method: 构建PassNet生态系统：(1) PassNet-Dataset：从10万+真实模型中提取超过1.8万个独特计算图；(2) PassBench：200个精心挑选的长尾可融合任务（含2060个子图），使用错误感知加速分数（ES_t）评估，包含完整性防御机制防止LLM被系统性利用。
AI.result: PassBench具有高区分度且未饱和：最佳前沿模型比TorchInductor落后37%，但在单个子图上LLM可实现高达3倍加速。微调小模型仅用约4000个PassNet轨迹即可获得2.67倍提升，接近前沿模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈在于一致性而非能力，PassNet可作为推进LLM驱动编译器优化的实时训练基础设施。
idea_en: A method for LLM-based compiler pass generation that generates structured graph transformations integrable into existing compiler pipelines, distinct from standalone kernel generation approaches.

An Error-aware Speedup Score (ES_t) metric that jointly evaluates correctness, stability, and performance of compiler optimizations, with layered integrity defenses against systematic LLM exploitation.

A large-scale ecosystem (PassNet-Dataset) comprising over 18K unique computational graphs derived from 100K+ real-world models, serving as training infrastructure for LLM-driven compiler optimization.

A pass generation fine-tuning framework where small models trained on ~4K PassNet trajectories achieve near-frontier model performance (2.67x improvement), enabling practical deployment of LLM optimization in production compilers.
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM的编译器pass生成方法，生成可集成到现有编译器流水线中的结构化图变换，区别于独立的核生成方法。
一种错误感知加速分数（ES_t）指标，联合评估编译器优化的正确性、稳定性和性能，并包含分层完整性防御机制防止LLM被系统性利用。
一个大规模PassNet-Dataset生态系统，包含从10万+真实模型中提取的超过1.8万个独特计算图，作为LLM驱动的编译器优化的训练基础设施。
一种pass生成微调框架，在约4000个PassNet轨迹上训练的小模型即可达到接近前沿模型的性能（2.67倍提升），支持LLM优化在生产编译器中的实际部署。

title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
summary: We demonstrate that sparse autoencoders can extract interpretable features from Claude 3 Sonnet, a production-scale language model, addressing the open question of whether dictionary learning methods scale beyond small transformers. We trained sparse autoencoders with up to 34 million features on the model's middle layer residual stream, using scaling laws to guide hyperparameter selection. The resulting features are multilingual and multimodal (generalizing to images despite text-only training), respond to both concrete instances and abstract discussions of concepts, and can be used to steer model behavior in ways consistent with their interpretations. We find features corresponding to famous entities and locations, as well as more abstract concepts like sarcasm or errors in code. We also identify features relevant to ways in which language models might cause harm--including features representing deception, power-seeking, sycophancy, and bias--and show that these causally influence model outputs when manipulated. Additionally, we conduct analyses of feature interpretability, geometry, and computational function. However, significant limitations remain: our suite of features is incomplete, and we lack rigorous methods for evaluating whether our features faithfully capture model computations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明稀疏自编码器能从生产级语言模型Claude 3 Sonnet中提取可解释特征，通过训练高达3400万特征的自编码器，发现特征具有多语言、多模态、概念抽象性等特性，并能用于操控模型行为，但也存在特征不完整和评估方法不足等局限。
AI.motivation: 解决字典学习方法能否扩展到生产级大规模语言模型这一开放问题，探究是否能从大型语言模型中提取可解释且可控的潜在特征。
AI.method: 在Claude 3 Sonnet中间层残差流上训练高达3400万特征的稀疏自编码器，利用缩放定律指导超参数选择，并通过特征操纵实验验证因果影响。
AI.result: 提取的特征具有多语言和多模态能力（可泛化到图像），能响应具体实例和抽象概念；发现了与名人、地点、讽刺、代码错误等相关的特征；识别出与欺骗、权力追求、谄媚和偏见等潜在危害相关的特征，且操纵这些特征能因果性地影响模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏自编码器可成功应用于生产级语言模型提取可解释特征，但当前特征集不完整，缺乏严格评估特征是否忠实捕获模型计算的方法。
idea_en: Method for extracting interpretable features from large-scale language models using sparse autoencoders with up to 34 million features, guided by scaling laws for hyperparameter optimization.
Technique for multimodal feature extraction from text-only trained language models, enabling image generalization without explicit multimodal training.
System for identifying and causally manipulating model behavior features related to deception, power-seeking, sycophancy, and bias in language models.
Method for steering language model behavior by manipulating sparse autoencoder features while maintaining consistency with their semantic interpretations.
Approach for discovering abstract conceptual features (e.g., sarcasm, code errors) in transformer residual streams using dictionary learning.
idea_ch: 一种利用稀疏自编码器从生产级语言模型中提取可解释特征的方法，支持高达3400万特征规模，并利用缩放定律指导超参数优化。
一种从纯文本训练的语言模型中提取多模态特征的技术，无需显式多模态训练即可实现图像泛化能力。
一种识别并因果性操控语言模型中与欺骗、权力追求、谄媚和偏见等危害行为相关特征的系统。
一种通过操控稀疏自编码器特征来引导语言模型行为的方法，同时保持与语义解释的一致性。
一种利用字典学习在Transformer残差流中发现抽象概念特征（如讽刺、代码错误）的方法。

title: MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as scalable simulators for robot learning, yet current evaluations provide limited evidence that their predictions are reliable under the actions they condition on. Existing benchmarks largely emphasize visual fidelity, leaving unclear whether predicted futures are physically plausible, faithful to commanded actions, and calibrated to failure when actions should not succeed. We introduce \textsc{MiraBench}, a hierarchical benchmark that defines \emph{action-conditioned reliability} as a core evaluation target for robotic world models. MiraBench decomposes this target into three progressively demanding levels: \emph{Physics Adherence}, which evaluates reference-free physical consistency; \emph{Action-Following Fidelity}, which measures whether predictions respect task-relevant action inputs; and \emph{Optimism Bias Detection}, which probes the tendency to predict successful outcomes under failure-inducing actions. To support this evaluation, we curate a human-annotated corpus with over 16,000 judgments across tasks, failure categories, and leading world models. We evaluate 12 representative model configurations spanning vector-conditioned robotic world models, text-conditioned generative world models, open-weight systems, closed-source systems, and multiple model scales. Across this broad model landscape, MiraBench reveals three central findings: visual fidelity is a poor proxy for action fidelity; increasing model scale does not reliably improve action following; and optimism bias is pervasive across current systems. By shifting evaluation from appearance to action-conditioned reliability, MiraBench provides a diagnostic foundation for assessing and improving robotic world models as faithful simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiraBench，一个分层基准，用于评估机器人世界模型在动作条件下的可靠性，包括物理一致性、动作跟随保真度和乐观偏差检测三个层次。基于16,000+人工标注评估12种模型，发现视觉保真度不能代表动作保真度，模型规模扩大不改善动作跟随，且普遍存在乐观偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人世界模型评估大多关注视觉保真度，缺乏对动作条件下预测结果可靠性的系统评估，不清楚预测的未来是否物理上合理、是否忠实于输入动作、以及在动作本不该成功时是否校准了失败。
AI.method: 构建MiraBench分层基准，定义动作条件可靠性为三个递进层次：物理一致性（无参考的物理合理性）、动作跟随保真度（预测是否尊重任务相关动作输入）、乐观偏差检测（倾向预测失败动作下的成功结果）。收集16,000+人工标注数据，评估12种代表性模型配置。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：视觉保真度不能作为动作保真度的代理指标；增加模型规模并不能可靠地改善动作跟随能力；乐观偏差在当前系统中普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: MiraBench将评估从外观转向动作条件可靠性，为评估和改进机器人世界模型作为忠实模拟器提供了诊断基础。
idea_en: A hierarchical benchmark (MiraBench) for evaluating action-conditioned reliability of robotic world models, decomposing into Physics Adherence, Action-Following Fidelity, and Optimism Bias Detection levels.
A human-annotated evaluation corpus with over 16,000 judgments across tasks, failure categories, and world models for standardized reliability assessment.
A method for detecting optimism bias in world models by probing the tendency to predict successful outcomes under failure-inducing actions.
A reference-free physics adherence evaluation method for assessing physical consistency of world model predictions without ground-truth comparisons.
idea_ch: 一种用于评估机器人世界模型动作条件可靠性的分层基准MiraBench，包含物理一致性、动作跟随保真度和乐观偏差检测三个递进层次。
一种包含16,000+人工标注的判断语料库，覆盖多种任务、失败类别和世界模型，用于标准化可靠性评估。
一种检测世界模型乐观偏差的方法，通过探测模型在失败诱导动作下预测成功结果的倾向来评估。
一种无参考的物理一致性评估方法，无需真实值对比即可评估世界模型预测的物理合理性。

title: EvoMD-LLM: Learning the Language of Species Evolution in Reactive Molecular Dynamics
summary: While large language models (LLMs) excel at static scientific reasoning, they struggle to model the temporal structure of dynamic physical processes. We present EvoMD-LLM (Evolutionary Molecular Dynamics Large Language Model), a framework that reformulates species-level molecular dynamics as a symbolic temporal language modeling problem. Reactive MD trajectories are discretized into sequences of molecular events, where each token represents a chemical species augmented with its persistence duration, enabling standard autoregressive LLMs to learn compositional evolution over time through efficient fine-tuning. A key component of EvoMD-LLM is temporal scaffolding, which treats event duration as an explicit linguistic token and serves as a structured inductive bias, significantly reducing invalid or hallucinated molecular outputs compared to conventional sequence modeling approaches. We evaluate EvoMD-LLM on multiple temporal prediction tasks, achieving up to 66.14% accuracy and consistently outperforming sequential neural networks and language-based baselines. Beyond quantitative improvements, we qualitatively observe that the model is capable of generating interpretations for its own predictions by incorporating relevant chemical knowledge, even though it was not explicitly supervised with paired trajectory-explanation data. These results demonstrate that symbolic temporal language modeling provides an effective framework for grounding LLMs in dynamic physical simulations.

AI.tldr: EvoMD-LLM将分子动力学轨迹转化为符号化的时间语言建模问题，通过将分子事件序列化和持久时间编码为语言token，使LLM能学习动态物理过程的时序演化规律，在多项预测任务上超越基线模型，并具备自解释能力。
AI.motivation: LLM擅长静态科学推理，但难以建模动态物理过程的时间结构。现有方法无法有效捕捉分子反应轨迹中的时序演化规律。
AI.method: 将反应性分子动力学轨迹离散化为分子事件序列，每个token表示化学物种及其持续时间，通过时间脚手架（temporal scaffolding）将事件持续时间作为显式语言token，形成结构化归纳偏置，利用标准自回归LLM进行高效微调来学习组合演化。
AI.result: 在多个时间预测任务上达到66.14%的准确率，持续优于序列神经网络和基于语言模型的基线方法，且模型能生成自解释预测。
AI.conclusion: 符号化时间语言建模为将LLM应用于动态物理模拟提供了有效框架，能够在没有明确监督的情况下生成具备化学知识理解的解释。
idea_en: A method for reformulating molecular dynamics trajectories as symbolic temporal language by discretizing reactive MD trajectories into sequences of molecular events, where each token represents a chemical species augmented with its persistence duration.

A temporal scaffolding technique that treats event duration as an explicit linguistic token, serving as a structured inductive bias to reduce invalid or hallucinated molecular outputs in LLM-based sequence modeling.
A framework enabling autoregressive LLMs to learn compositional evolution of molecular systems over time through efficient fine-tuning on discretized symbolic temporal sequences.
A system for generating interpretable predictions of molecular dynamics by incorporating relevant chemical knowledge without explicit supervision with paired trajectory-explanation data.
A method for converting continuous molecular dynamics simulation data into discrete token sequences suitable for standard LLM processing while preserving temporal information.
idea_ch: 一种将分子动力学轨迹重新形式化为符号化时间语言的方法，通过将反应性MD轨迹离散化为分子事件序列，每个token代表一个化学物种及其持续时长。
一种时间脚手架技术，将事件持续时间作为显式语言token处理，作为结构化归纳偏置，减少基于LLM的序列建模中无效或幻觉分子输出的产生。
一种使标准自回归LLM能够通过高效微调在离散化符号时间序列上学习分子系统随时间组合演化的框架。
一种无需显式轨迹-解释配对数据监督，通过融合相关化学知识生成可解释分子动力学预测的系统。
一种将连续分子动力学模拟数据转换为适用于标准LLM处理的离散token序列并保留时间信息的方法。

title: Aligned but Fragile: Enhancing LLM Safety Robustness via Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary:
Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) aims to reduce harmful or unsafe behavior while preserving general utility. However, recent findings reveal that alignment effects can be fragile: lightweight post-alignment manipulations, such as parameter noise, activation noise, or quantization, can easily weaken the intended safety behavior. Prior efforts to improve robustness have primarily focused on data curation, modified alignment objectives, and safety-critical parameter identification, leaving the role of the optimizer itself largely unexplored.
  In this paper, we are the first to study the robustness of safety alignment from the perspective of the base optimizer. This optimizer-centric view naturally points to zeroth-order optimization, which provides a robustness-oriented signal by evaluating safety alignment under perturbations. Based on this insight, we propose a hybrid framework that first performs standard first-order safety alignment and then applies zeroth-order refinement to improve robustness. Both theoretically and empirically, we show that only a few zeroth-order refinement steps can enhance robustness while preserving safety alignment. We further improve the efficiency of zeroth-order refinement by exploiting its inherent perturbation-based evaluations to estimate layer-wise robustness sensitivity, enabling the refinement process to concentrate updates on robustness-critical layers with modest training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从优化器视角研究LLM安全对齐的鲁棒性，提出先用一阶优化进行安全对齐，再用零阶优化进行微调以增强鲁棒性，并通过扰动评估识别关键层，以较小代价提升安全对齐的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法在轻量级后处理操作（如参数噪声、激活噪声、量化）下容易失效，而以往提升鲁棒性的工作主要集中在数据、对齐目标和参数识别上，忽视了优化器本身的作用。
AI.method: 提出混合框架：先标准一阶安全对齐，再进行零阶优化微调。零阶优化通过评估扰动下的安全对齐表现提供鲁棒性导向信号。同时利用零阶优化中的扰动评估估计逐层鲁棒性敏感性，将更新集中在鲁棒性关键层上。
AI.result: 理论和实验表明，仅需少量零阶优化微调步骤即可增强鲁棒性，同时保持安全对齐效果。通过层敏感度分析进一步降低了训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 优化器选择对安全对齐鲁棒性有重要影响，零阶优化作为一种鲁棒性导向的优化方法，可在少量步骤内有效提升LLM安全对齐的抗干扰能力。
idea_en: A hybrid optimization framework for LLM safety alignment: first-order alignment followed by zeroth-order refinement to improve robustness against post-alignment perturbations.
A zeroth-order optimization method that uses perturbation-based evaluations to provide robustness-oriented signals for safety alignment.
A layer-wise robustness sensitivity estimation technique that leverages the inherent perturbation evaluations of zeroth-order optimization to identify and focus updates on robustness-critical layers.
A method to enhance LLM safety alignment robustness using only a few zeroth-order optimization steps, demonstrating efficiency in both theory and practice.
idea_ch: 一种混合优化框架：先进行一阶安全对齐，再进行零阶优化微调，以提升LLM安全对齐对后处理扰动的鲁棒性。
一种基于零阶优化的鲁棒性导向安全对齐方法，通过评估扰动下的安全对齐表现来提供优化信号。
一种利用零阶优化中扰动评估过程估计逐层鲁棒性敏感性的技术，能够识别安全关键层并聚焦更新。
一种仅需少量零阶优化步骤即可显著增强LLM安全对齐鲁棒性的高效方法。

title: Architecture-Sensitive Supervised Fine-Tuning for Screen-Conditioned Action Prediction: A PiSAR Benchmark
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. PiSAR corpus and fine-tuned weights are proprietary to AprioriLabs; methodology and recipe released
summary: We benchmark three supervised fine-tuned models against frontier zero-shot baselines on a 661-row held-out slice of PiSAR (Persona, intent, Screen, Action, Rationale), a 12,929-tuple corpus of screen-anchored behavioural rationales curated from public app-store reviews, Pew American Trends Panel demographics, and the OPeRA shopper traces. Every model, frontier or fine-tuned, is evaluated on the same 661-row slice with the same scoring pipeline. Two findings. First, frontier zero-shot baselines (Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) reach sem_sim 0.459 and 0.482 respectively; a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct reaches 0.783 and clears sem_sim >= 0.7 on 79% of rows, against 1-2% for either frontier baseline, a gap of 0.30 absolute on the same test set. Second, the same training data and recipe on Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT scores only 0.441, in the same band as the frontier zero-shot baselines rather than the fine-tuned Qwen. We read this as a recipe-vs-model mismatch: the reasoning-tuned high-parameter model resists displacement and would likely need either more data or a stronger fine-tuning method.

AI.tldr: 本文在PiSAR数据集上对比了微调模型与前沿零样本模型，发现微调Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的语义相似度(0.783)远超Claude Opus 4.7(0.459)和GPT-5.5(0.482)，而Gemma-4-26B在相同微调配方下仅得0.441，表明模型与微调方法存在不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿大模型在零样本场景下表现有限，本文探索通过监督微调是否能显著提升模型在屏幕锚定行为推理任务上的表现，并评估不同模型对同一微调配方的适配性差异。
AI.method: 使用PiSAR数据集(12,929条屏幕锚定行为理由元组)，保留661行作为测试集。对三种监督微调模型(Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT)与前沿零样本基线(Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5)进行对比评估，采用相同的打分管线。
AI.result: 微调后的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct达到0.783的sem_sim，79%的行达到sem_sim≥0.7；Claude Opus 4.7仅0.459，GPT-5.5仅0.482，仅1-2%的行达到sem_sim≥0.7。Gemma-4-26B微调后仅0.441，与零样本基线处于同一水平。
AI.conclusion: 监督微调能显著提升特定任务的语义匹配能力，但微调效果高度依赖于模型架构与微调配方的匹配度；推理调优的高参数模型对权重位移存在抵抗，需要更多数据或更强的微调方法。
idea_en: A method for screen-anchored behavioral rationale generation using fine-tuned vision-language models (e.g., Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct) that achieves semantic similarity scores above 0.7, significantly outperforming zero-shot frontier models.

A benchmark evaluation pipeline (PiSAR dataset) combining persona, intent, screen, action, and rationale annotations from app-store reviews, demographic data, and shopper traces for consistent model scoring.

A technique for identifying recipe-vs-model mismatch in fine-tuning, where reasoning-tuned high-parameter models resist weight displacement and require customized fine-tuning strategies or larger datasets.
A supervised fine-tuning approach for small-to-medium VLMs that closes a 0.30 absolute semantic similarity gap compared to frontier zero-shot baselines on behavioral rationale prediction tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于微调视觉语言模型(如Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct)的屏幕锚定行为理由生成方法，语义相似度超过0.7，显著优于前沿零样本模型
一种结合应用商店评论中人物角色、意图、屏幕、行动和理由标注的PiSAR基准评估管线，实现一致的模型评分
一种识别微调中配方-模型不匹配的技术，发现推理调优的高参数模型抵抗权重位移，需要定制化微调策略或更大数据集
一种中小型视觉语言模型的监督微调方法，在行为理由预测任务上相比前沿零样本基线缩小了0.30的绝对语义相似度差距

title: When Does Persona Prompting Actually Help? A Retrieval and Metric Analysis of Expert Role Injection in LLMs
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Submitted for peer review
summary: Persona prompting is widely used to steer large language models, yet its practical value remains unclear. Prior work often evaluates persona prompting using aggregate scores, making it difficult to determine whether expert-role prompting consistently improves response quality or instead changes responses along different quality dimensions. We study this question through a controlled comparison of four prompting conditions across 1,140 open-ended questions spanning 38 expert roles and six domains: no role prompt, a generic domain-expert prompt, embedding-based role retrieval, and a hybrid retrieval method combining embedding search with LLM-based role selection. Aggregate results show only small overall differences between conditions. However, metric-level analysis reveals a consistent tradeoff that aggregate averages obscure: role prompting systematically increases expertise depth while reducing clarity. These effects are highly conditional rather than universal. Role prompting performs best on advisory questions and in domains such as medicine and psychology, where structured expert framing and risk communication are intrinsically valuable. In contrast, baseline prompting performs better on conceptual and explanatory questions in finance, legal, science, and technology domains, where concise plain-language explanation is more important. We further show that hybrid retrieval significantly improves over embedding-only role selection, although better role retrieval does not eliminate the broader expertise-depth versus clarity tradeoff. Overall, our findings suggest that persona prompting primarily reshapes response characteristics rather than broadly improving capability, and that multi-metric evaluation is necessary for understanding its effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过控制实验发现，角色提示(persona prompting)并非普遍提升大模型回答质量，而是在“专业深度”和“清晰度”之间存在系统性的权衡——角色提示增加专业深度但降低清晰度，且效果高度依赖于具体领域和问题类型。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多使用聚合分数评估角色提示效果，无法区分它是"提升整体回答质量"还是"改变回答的不同质量维度"。作者希望揭示角色提示的真实影响机制。
AI.method: 对1140个开放式问题（涵盖38个专家角色、6个领域）进行四种提示条件的受控对比：无角色提示、通用领域专家提示、基于嵌入的角色检索、以及结合嵌入检索与LLM角色选择的混合方法。采用多维度指标（专业深度、清晰度等）而非单一聚合分数进行评估。
AI.result: 聚合结果显示各条件差异不大，但指标级分析揭示了稳定的权衡：角色提示系统性增加专业深度但同时降低清晰度。效果是条件性的——在咨询类问题和医学、心理学领域表现最好；在金融、法律、科学、技术领域的概念解释类问题中基线提示更优。混合检索优于纯嵌入检索，但无法消除专业深度-清晰度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 角色提示主要重塑回答特征而非广泛提升能力，需采用多指标评估才能全面理解其效果。更好的角色检索无法消除专业深度与清晰度的根本权衡。
idea_en: A hybrid retrieval method combining embedding-based role search with LLM-based role selection for persona prompting, which significantly outperforms embedding-only role selection.
A multi-metric evaluation framework for persona prompting that separately measures expertise depth and clarity dimensions, revealing tradeoffs hidden by aggregate scoring.
A systematic method for identifying optimal persona prompting conditions based on question type (advisory vs. conceptual/explanatory) and domain characteristics.
An adaptive persona prompting system that dynamically selects between role-based and baseline prompting depending on whether the query requires expert framing or plain-language explanation.
idea_ch: 一种结合嵌入检索与LLM角色选择的混合检索方法用于角色提示，显著优于纯嵌入角色选择。
一种针对角色提示的多指标评估框架，分别衡量专业深度和清晰度维度，揭示聚合评分所隐藏的权衡关系。
一种基于问题类型（咨询型vs.概念解释型）和领域特征确定最优角色提示条件的系统性方法。
一种自适应角色提示系统，根据查询需要专家框架还是简明语言解释，动态在角色提示和基线提示之间切换。

title: ReasonLight: A Multimodal Foundation Model-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Framework for Zero-Shot Traffic Signal Control
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise in traffic signal control (TSC). However, its reliance on predefined states limits responsiveness to observable open-world events that are absent from training data. IoT-enabled intersections provide heterogeneous observations from roadside sensors and cameras, creating opportunities to improve RL adaptability to such events. To this end, we propose ReasonLight, a multimodal foundation model-enhanced RL framework for zero-shot TSC. ReasonLight integrates three sources of information: structured traffic measurements, multi-view camera observations, and candidate phase decisions from a pre-trained RL controller. Given an RL-proposed phase, ReasonLight extracts visual semantics from multi-view images and aligns them with compact sensor-derived scene descriptions. This alignment enables a semantic-guided refinement module to either preserve or adjust the proposed action according to traffic rules and event semantics. To ensure operational reliability, refined actions are constrained by the set of available phases. Any invalid decision is rejected, and the system falls back to the original RL action. We evaluate ReasonLight on two types of rare events not seen during RL training: emergency vehicle priority and temporary traffic regulation. Experimental results show that ReasonLight achieves zero-shot adaptation without retraining. It reduces emergency vehicle waiting time by up to 88.7% compared with the RL-only backbone while preserving comparable routine traffic performance.

AI.tldr: ReasonLight是一个多模态基础模型增强的强化学习框架，用于交通信号控制的零样本适应。它整合结构化交通数据、多视角摄像头观测和RL候选相位决策，通过语义引导精炼模块调整RL动作以应对罕见事件，无需重新训练即可适应紧急车辆优先和临时交通管制等场景。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习在交通信号控制中依赖预定义状态，无法应对训练数据中未出现的开放世界事件（如紧急车辆通行、临时交通管制），而物联网路口提供的异构传感器和摄像头数据为提升RL适应性创造了机会。
AI.method: 提出ReasonLight框架，包括：(1) 多模态融合模块整合结构化交通测量、多视角摄像头图像和预训练RL控制器的候选相位决策；(2) 视觉语义提取与场景描述对齐机制；(3) 语义引导精炼模块根据交通规则和事件语义保持或调整RL提议动作；(4) 安全约束机制确保输出相位有效，无效决策回退至原始RL动作。
AI.result: 在两个未见过的罕见事件（紧急车辆优先、临时交通管制）上评估，ReasonLight实现零样本适应，紧急车辆等待时间最多降低88.7%，同时保持常规交通性能基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 多模态基础模型增强的RL框架能够有效处理开放世界中的罕见交通事件，无需重新训练模型，为现实世界中交通信号控制的可扩展部署提供了可行方案。
idea_en: Multimodal foundation model-enhanced RL framework for zero-shot traffic signal control that integrates structured traffic measurements, multi-view camera observations, and RL candidate phase decisions

Semantic-guided refinement module that aligns visual semantics from multi-view images with sensor-derived scene descriptions to preserve or adjust RL-proposed actions according to traffic rules and event semantics
Safety-constrained fallback mechanism that rejects invalid phase decisions and reverts to original RL action when refined actions are invalid
Cross-modal alignment technique for compact scene descriptions and multi-view visual semantics in traffic signal control context
idea_ch: 一种多模态基础模型增强的强化学习零样本交通信号控制框架，集成结构化交通测量、多视角摄像头观测和预训练RL控制器的候选相位决策
语义引导精炼模块，将从多视角图像中提取的视觉语义与传感器导出的场景描述对齐，根据交通规则和事件语义保持或调整RL提议的动作
安全约束的降级回退机制，当精炼动作无效时拒绝无效相位决策并回退到原始RL动作
面向交通信号控制场景的紧凑场景描述与多视角视觉语义的跨模态对齐技术

title: Towards Human-Like Interactive Speech Recognition With Agentic Correction and Semantic Evaluation
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) is a core component of human--computer interaction and an increasingly important front-end for LLM-based assistants and agents. However, most current ASR systems still follow a single-pass paradigm, which is poorly aligned with human communication, where misunderstandings are resolved through iterative clarification and refinement. This mismatch makes it difficult to correct meaning-critical errors once they occur. Meanwhile, token-level metrics such as WER or CER cannot adequately reflect such a problem. To address these limitations, we formulate \emph{Interactive ASR} as a multi-turn refinement task and propose \textbf{Agentic ASR}, a closed-loop framework that combines a single-pass ASR front-end with semantic correction, intent routing, and reasoning-based editing. We further introduce the \textbf{Sentence-level Semantic Error Rate} ($S^2ER$), an LLM-based semantic evaluation metric, together with an \textbf{Interactive Simulation System} for scalable and reproducible benchmarking. Experiments on multilingual, named-entity-intensive, and code-switching benchmarks show that iterative interaction consistently reduces semantic errors, with much larger gains in $S^2ER$ than in conventional token-level metrics. Human--AI alignment and ablation studies further validate the reliability of the semantic judge and the robustness of the proposed framework. The code is available at: https://interactiveasr.github.io/ and the live demo is available at https://i-asr.sjtuxlance.com/

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic ASR框架，将交互式ASR建模为多轮精炼任务，结合单轮ASR前端与语义校正、意图路由和基于推理的编辑，并引入句子级语义错误率(S²ER)评估指标及交互模拟系统，显著降低语义错误。
AI.motivation: 当前ASR系统多为单轮处理范式，无法像人类对话那样通过迭代澄清和精炼来纠正语义关键错误，且传统token级指标(WER/CER)无法反映语义层面的问题。
AI.method: 提出Agentic ASR闭环框架，将单轮ASR前端与语义校正、意图路由和基于推理的编辑相结合；引入LLM驱动的S²ER语义评估指标；构建可扩展可复现的交互模拟系统。
AI.result: 在多语言、命名实体密集和代码混合基准测试中，迭代交互持续减少语义错误，S²ER提升显著优于传统token级指标指标；人机对齐和消融研究验证了语义评估器的可靠性和框架的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 交互式ASR的多轮精炼范式能有效解决单轮ASR难以纠正语义关键错误的问题，S²ER是比WER/CER更符合语义需求的评估指标。
idea_en: A closed-loop Agentic ASR framework integrating single-pass ASR with semantic correction, intent routing, and reasoning-based editing for multi-turn iterative refinement.
Sentence-level Semantic Error Rate (S²ER) - an LLM-based semantic evaluation metric for ASR that measures semantic errors beyond token-level accuracy.
An Interactive Simulation System for scalable and reproducible benchmarking of multi-turn interactive ASR systems.
idea_ch: 一种将单轮ASR前端与语义校正、意图路由和基于推理的编辑相结合的闭环Agentic ASR框架，实现多轮迭代精炼的语音识别。
句子级语义错误率(S²ER)——基于LLM的语义评估指标，从语义层面衡量ASR错误，超越传统token级指标。
一种用于多轮交互式ASR系统可扩展和可复现基准测试的交互模拟系统。

title: CrystalXRD-Bench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for XRD Peak Indexing Across Diverse Crystalline Materials
summary: Miller-index identification from powder XRD patterns requires capabilities untested by existing multimodal benchmarks: the model must read a narrow peak location from a rendered scientific curve and then connect that observation to multi-step crystallographic reasoning. We introduce CrystalXRD-Bench, a 250-sample benchmark built from 10 public crystallographic databases for a single task: recover the full set of HKLs contributing to the highest-intensity peak in an XRD pattern. Each sample pairs the rendered XRD image with the source CIF text and chemical formula, so visual extraction errors and reasoning errors can be examined side by side. We evaluate seven vision-language models. The best Jaccard score is 0.5888 (GPT-5.4) with an exact-match rate of 37.6%, yet six of seven models remain below Jaccard 0.50; the task is far from solved. Error patterns vary systematically: double-peak cases are especially brittle, recall-heavy models gain coverage by over-predicting HKLs, and access to CIF text does not close the gap in crystallographic calculation. Alongside model rankings, the benchmark identifies the conditions under which current VLMs fail on quantitative scientific figures. All data and evaluation code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CrystalXRD-Bench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型从粉末XRD图谱中识别Miller指数能力的基准测试，包含250个样本，发现即使最好的模型(GPT-5.4)Jaccard分数仅为0.5888，精确匹配率仅37.6%，任务远未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基准无法测试模型从渲染科学曲线中读取窄峰位置并进行多步晶体学推理的能力，需要专门的基准来评估VLM在定量科学图表上的表现。
AI.method: 从10个公共晶体学数据库构建250个样本，每个样本包含渲染XRD图像、源CIF文本和化学式，要求模型恢复最高强度峰对应的完整HKL集合，使用Jaccard分数和精确匹配率评估7个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: GPT-5.4表现最佳(Jaccard 0.5888, 精确匹配37.6%)，其余6个模型Jaccard均低于0.50；双峰情况尤为脆弱，高召回模型通过过度预测HKL来提升覆盖率，CIF文本访问未能弥补晶体学计算差距。
AI.conclusion: 该任务远未解决，基准揭示了当前VLM在定量科学图表上的失败条件，将公开所有数据和评估代码。
idea_en: A method for automated Miller-index identification from powder XRD patterns using vision-language models with multi-step crystallographic reasoning
A benchmark construction technique for pairing rendered XRD images with source CIF text and chemical formulas to evaluate visual extraction and reasoning errors separately
A systematic error analysis framework for identifying failure conditions of VLMs on quantitative scientific figures, including double-peak brittleness and HKL over-prediction patterns
idea_ch: 一种利用视觉语言模型结合多步晶体学推理从粉末XRD图谱中自动识别Miller指数的方法
一种将渲染XRD图像与源CIF文本及化学式配对的基准构建技术，可分别评估视觉提取错误和推理错误
一种系统性的错误分析框架，用于识别VLM在定量科学图表上的失败条件，包括双峰脆弱性和HKL过度预测模式

title: VitalAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Reactive and Proactive Physiological Monitoring over Wearable Health Data
