We view world knowledge as a latent world graph and each IS task as search within a latent task graph, where effective steps should make graph progress toward the answer node. Based on this prior, we propose Graph-Distance Contribution Reward (GDCR), a step-level process reward that scores newly-retrieved and newly-cited entities by their distance to the answer node in a training-time Entity-Relation (ER) graph. We further propose Step Advantage Policy Optimization (SAPO), which converts GDCR into step-level advantages and combines them with trajectory-level outcome advantages. Experiments on four challenging benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图距离贡献的步骤级奖励（GDCR）和步骤优势策略优化（SAPO），用于智能体搜索任务中评估每一步的行为贡献，无需昂贵的树采样。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，轨迹级结果奖励无法量化单步行为贡献，而现有的步骤级奖励方法依赖昂贵的树采样，效率低。
AI.method: 将世界知识视为潜在的世界图，每个信息搜索任务视为在潜在任务图中搜索。提出GDCR，通过训练时构建的实体关系图，衡量新检索和新引用的实体到答案节点的距离来作为步骤级奖励。进一步提出SAPO，将GDCR转化为步骤级优势，并与轨迹级结果优势结合进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的基准测试上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于图距离的步骤级过程奖励方法可有效评估搜索中的每一步贡献，避免昂贵树采样，提升智能体搜索性能。
idea_en: A step-level process reward method (GDCR) that uses the distance between entities in a latent Entity-Relation graph and the answer node to score newly-retrieved and newly-cited entities during training.

A step advantage policy optimization method (SAPO) that converts graph-distance-based step rewards into step-level advantages and combines them with trajectory-level outcome advantages for policy learning.
A training-time Entity-Relation (ER) graph construction method that represents world knowledge as a latent graph for evaluating step contributions in information search tasks.
A graph-progress-based reward mechanism that treats each information search step as making progress toward the answer node in a latent task graph.
idea_ch: 一种基于图距离的步骤级过程奖励方法（GDCR），通过在训练时构建的实体关系图中，衡量新检索和新引用的实体到答案节点的距离来打分。
一种步骤优势策略优化方法（SAPO），将基于图距离的步骤奖励转化为步骤级优势，并与轨迹级结果优势相结合进行策略学习。
一种训练时实体关系（ER）图构建方法，将世界知识表示为潜在图结构，用于评估信息搜索任务中每一步的贡献。
一种基于图进度的奖励机制，将每个信息搜索步骤视为在潜在任务图中向答案节点推进的过程。

title: BitTP: The Lightweight Trajectory Prediction Model with BitLLM for Edge-Devices
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted as a findings paper at CVPR 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures
summary: Trajectory prediction is a fundamental task for autonomous systems, requiring complex reasoning about multi-agent interactions and intents. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adopted for this task, as they provide strong contextual reasoning and interpretable, language-based trajectory representations. However, these LLM-based predictors are extremely memory- and compute-intensive, making them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices such as on-board computers in autonomous robots. To bridge this gap, we propose BitTP, which converts an LLM-based trajectory predictor into a lightweight bitlinear architecture. We demonstrate that weight-only quantization to 1.58-bit (BitTP-Weight) is optimal. Crucially, activations must remain in full precision, as quantizing them leads to severe degradation and instability in spatio-temporal reasoning. Empirically, BitTP-Weight not only preserves but improves prediction quality over the full-precision (BF16) LLM baseline, reducing ADE by 14.29% and FDE by 20.97% on average, while simultaneously reducing memory usage and inference latency relative to other quantization methods. These results demonstrate that carefully designed quantization acts as an effective regularizer, enabling the practical deployment of sophisticated LLM-based reasoning on edge devices. Code is available at: https://github.com/MintCat98/BitTP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BitTP，将基于LLM的轨迹预测器通过1.58-bit权重量化转换为轻量级架构，在保持甚至提升预测质量的同时大幅降低内存和计算开销，适用于边缘设备部署。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的轨迹预测器虽然性能优秀，但内存和计算开销极大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备（如自动驾驶车载计算机）上，亟需轻量化方案。
AI.method: BitTP通过对LLM轨迹预测器进行仅权重1.58-bit量化（BitTP-Weight），保持激活值为全精度，避免时空推理退化，从而将模型压缩为轻量级bitlinear架构。
AI.result: 相比全精度BF16基线，BitTP-Weight平均降低ADE 14.29%、FDE 20.97%，同时显著减少内存使用和推理延迟，优于其他量化方法。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的权重量化可作为有效正则化器，在压缩模型的同时提升预测质量，使LLM推理能力可实际部署于边缘设备。
idea_en: A method for deploying LLM-based trajectory predictors on edge devices by applying 1.58-bit weight-only quantization while keeping activations in full precision, forming a lightweight bitlinear architecture.
A trajectory prediction system using LLMs with bitlinear weight quantization (1.58-bit) that improves prediction accuracy (ADE/FDE) while reducing memory and inference latency for autonomous robots.

A selective quantization technique for LLM-based spatio-temporal reasoning models where only weights are quantized to 1.58-bit and activations remain unquantized to prevent degradation in multi-agent interaction understanding.

A regularization method through extreme weight quantization (1.58-bit) that enhances the generalization of LLM-based trajectory predictors, achieving better prediction quality than full-precision counterparts.
idea_ch: 一种基于1.58-bit仅权重量化的LLM轨迹预测器轻量化方法，保持激活值为全精度，构建bitlinear架构实现边缘设备部署。
一种针对自主机器人轨迹预测的选择性量化技术，仅对LLM权重进行1.58-bit量化，激活值保留全精度，避免时空推理性能退化。
一种利用极端权重量化（1.58-bit）对LLM轨迹预测器进行正则化的方法，在模型压缩的同时提升预测精度（降低ADE和FDE）。
一种面向资源受限边缘计算的LLM轨迹预测部署方案，通过bitlinear架构显著降低内存占用和推理延迟，且不牺牲预测质量。

title: NaRA: Noise-Aware LoRA for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive generative paradigm. Given the prohibitive computational cost of full fine-tuning, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the standard approach. However, existing PEFT methods (e.g., LoRA), originally tailored for autoregressive models, rely on static parameters that are agnostic to the noise level. Consequently, they ignore the intrinsic dynamics of the diffusion process, where input distributions and generation difficulty shift significantly along the denoising trajectory, rendering them suboptimal for dLLMs. To address this, we propose Noise-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (NaRA), which introduces a low-rank core matrix generated by a lightweight, globally shared hypernetwork conditioned on the noise level. This design enables the update matrices to vary continuously along the diffusion process while keeping parameter and latency overhead negligible. We provide a theoretical justification for the proposed NaRA framework and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements over noise-agnostic baselines across commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, and code generation benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/generaldi/NaRA.

AI.tldr: 提出NaRA方法，通过轻量级超网络根据噪声水平动态生成低秩核心矩阵，实现扩散语言模型的参数高效微调，在常识推理、数学推理和代码生成等任务上优于传统噪声无关方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的PEFT方法（如LoRA）专为自回归模型设计，使用静态参数，忽略了扩散过程中输入分布和生成难度随去噪轨迹显著变化的固有动态特性，导致在扩散语言模型中性能欠佳。
AI.method: 提出噪声感知低秩自适应（NaRA），引入一个低秩核心矩阵，该矩阵由轻量级、全局共享的超网络根据噪声水平（时间步）动态生成，使更新矩阵沿扩散过程连续变化，同时保持参数和延迟开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在常识推理、数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，NaRA一致优于噪声无关的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: NaRA通过噪声感知的动态低秩适配有效捕获了扩散过程的时序动态特性，为dLLM提供了一种更优的PEFT方案。
idea_en: A noise-aware low-rank adaptation (NaRA) method for diffusion language models, where a lightweight hypernetwork generates low-rank core matrices conditioned on the noise level (diffusion timestep), enabling the adaptation parameters to dynamically vary along the denoising trajectory.

A globally shared hypernetwork architecture that maps the noise level (time step) to low-rank update matrices, allowing continuous parameter variation across the diffusion process while keeping total parameter count and inference latency negligible.

A parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework specifically designed for diffusion-based generative models, incorporating the intrinsic dynamics of the diffusion process (shifting input distributions and generation difficulty) into the adaptation parameter generation mechanism.
idea_ch: 一种面向扩散语言模型的噪声感知低秩自适应方法（NaRA），通过轻量级超网络根据噪声水平（扩散时间步）动态生成低秩核心矩阵，使适配参数沿去噪轨迹动态变化。
一种全局共享的超网络架构，将噪声水平（时间步）映射为低秩更新矩阵，实现参数在扩散过程中连续变化，同时保持总参数量和推理延迟可忽略。
一种专为扩散生成模型设计的参数高效微调框架，将扩散过程的固有动态特性（输入分布和生成难度变化）融入适配参数生成机制中。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Transfer Learning for Cross-Building Energy Forecasting: Toward Robust and Scalable District-Level Energy Management
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at BALANCES'26 (6th ACM International Workshop on Big Data and Machine Learning for Smart Buildings and Cities), Banff, Alberta, Canada, June 22, 2026. This is the author's accepted manuscript; final published version DOI will be activated after June 22, 2026
summary: Scaling data-driven energy forecasting to district level requires models that can be re-used across buildings with minimal target-domain data and honest uncertainty estimates. We present an uncertainty-aware transfer learning (TL) framework for cross-building energy forecasting based on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), evaluated on a newly released high-resolution real sub-meter dataset: an educational building at Aalborg University, Denmark (source) and the multi-typology NEST building at EMPA, Switzerland (target). We introduce the Transfer Robustness Index (TRI), an architecture-agnostic metric for quantifying generalization quality across domain gaps. A four-strategy layer-freezing ablation shows that Probe-Only fine-tuning, updating only 455 output-layer parameters out of 806K, achieves the best transfer quality (TRI = 3,097), outperforming full fine-tuning and suggesting that TFT encoders learn transferable temporal representations. Monte Carlo Dropout yields a prediction interval coverage probability of 93.2%, close to the nominal 95% target. A data-scarcity analysis further shows monotonic improvement with increasing target-domain data, providing practical guidance for district energy deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间融合变换器(TFT)的不确定性感知迁移学习框架，用于跨建筑能量预测，并在丹麦奥尔堡大学教育建筑(源域)和瑞士EMPA多类型NEST建筑(目标域)数据集上验证。提出了迁移鲁棒性指数(TRI)量化泛化质量，发现仅微调0.056%参数(455/806K)的Probe-Only策略效果最佳，MC Dropout实现了93.2%的预测区间覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 将数据驱动的能量预测扩展到区域级，需要模型能在极少目标域数据下跨建筑复用，并给出诚实的预测不确定性估计。
AI.method: 基于Temporal Fusion Transformer构建迁移学习框架；提出TRI指标量化迁移鲁棒性；采用四种层冻结微调策略(Probe-Only/Partial/Full/Last-N)进行分析；使用MC Dropout进行不确定性量化。
AI.result: Probe-Only微调(仅更新455/806K参数)取得最佳迁移质量(TRI=3,097)；MC Dropout预测区间覆盖率达93.2%(接近95%名义目标)；数据稀缺分析显示随目标域数据增加呈单调改善。
AI.conclusion: TFT编码器可学习可迁移的时间表征，极少量参数微调即可实现高效跨建筑能量预测，为区域级能量预测部署提供了实用指导。
idea_en: Uncertainty-aware transfer learning framework based on Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) for cross-building energy forecasting, enabling model reuse with minimal target-domain data.
Transfer Robustness Index (TRI): an architecture-agnostic metric for quantifying generalization quality across domain gaps in transfer learning scenarios.

Probe-Only fine-tuning strategy that updates only 0.056% of total parameters (455 out of 806K) while achieving superior transfer performance, demonstrating that TFT encoders learn transferable temporal representations.
Four-strategy layer-freezing ablation analysis method for systematically evaluating transfer learning effectiveness in time-series forecasting models.
Combined application of Monte Carlo Dropout with transfer learning for providing prediction interval coverage probability (93.2%) close to nominal 95% target in cross-building energy prediction.
idea_ch: 基于时间融合变换器(TFT)的不确定性感知跨建筑能量预测迁移学习框架，能够在极少目标域数据下复用模型
迁移鲁棒性指数(TRI)：一种与架构无关的量化迁移学习跨域泛化质量的新型评估指标
Probe-Only微调策略：仅更新总参数0.056%(455/806K)即可实现最优迁移性能，揭示TFT编码器学习到可迁移时间表征
四策略层冻结消融分析方法：系统评估时间序列预测模型中迁移学习效果的方法论
蒙特卡洛Dropout与迁移学习结合方法：在跨建筑能量预测中实现接近名义95%目标(实际93.2%)的预测区间覆盖概率

title: Citation-Closure Retrieval and Per-Rule Attribution for Real-World Regulatory Compliance Question Answering
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for regulatory compliance demands rigorous traceability via comprehensive citations across multi-tiered authority structures. Unlike traditional multi-hop or legal QA, this task requires structured procedural lookups and evidence-set closure rather than entity resolution or case-law reasoning. Existing RAG systems struggle here due to flattened citation edges, fragmented retrieval expansions, and fragile post-hoc attribution. We formalize Regulatory Compliance QA with RegOps-Bench, a novel benchmark featuring an Operational Knowledge Graph derived from complex national R\&D regulations. To address these bottlenecks, we propose RefWalk, a unified framework driven by a shared topic anchor. RefWalk traverses cross-document citations, fuses multi-view candidates via max-based aggregation, and enforces per-rule attribution to explicitly map claims to sources. We establish a strong baseline with substantial improvements in retrieval recall and citation accuracy. Finally, a contrastive evaluation on a U.S. health compliance dataset (HIPAA) reveals that existing systems exhibit saturation on flat-structure rules, underscoring the need for RegOps-Bench. Our code is available at https://github.com/yeongjoonJu/RefWalk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RegOps-Bench基准和RefWalk框架，用于解决大语言模型在法规合规问答中的精确引用和溯源问题，通过操作知识图谱实现跨文档引用遍历和多视角证据聚合。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在处理法规合规问答时存在扁平化引用边、碎片化检索扩展和脆弱的归因机制，无法满足多层权威结构下的严格可追溯性要求。
AI.method: 提出RefWalk框架，基于共享主题锚点进行跨文档引用遍历，采用基于最大值的多视角候选融合，并强制执行逐规则归因以明确将声明映射到来源。
AI.result: 在检索召回率和引用准确性方面取得了显著改进，并在HIPAA数据集上的对比评估揭示了现有系统在扁平结构规则上的饱和问题。
AI.conclusion: RegOps-Bench和RefWalk为法规合规QA提供了新的基准和有效方法，揭示了现有系统的局限性，并推动了结构化程序查找和证据集闭包方向的发展。
idea_en: A method for regulatory compliance QA using an Operational Knowledge Graph derived from multi-tiered national R&D regulations, enabling structured procedural lookups and evidence-set closure.
A unified framework (RefWalk) that traverses cross-document citations using a shared topic anchor, fusing multi-view candidates via max-based aggregation for enhanced retrieval.
A per-rule attribution mechanism that explicitly maps claims to their source citations across documents, ensuring traceability in multi-tiered regulatory hierarchies.
A benchmark (RegOps-Bench) for evaluating LLMs on regulatory compliance tasks, featuring structured citation requirements and complex authority structures.
A contrastive evaluation methodology that identifies saturation effects in flat-structure rule processing for existing RAG systems.
idea_ch: 基于多层国家研发法规的操作知识图谱构建方法，用于法规合规问答的结构化程序查找和证据集闭包
基于共享主题锚点的跨文档引用遍历框架RefWalk，采用最大聚合融合多视角候选证据
逐规则归因机制，将模型声明显式映射到多文档中的来源引用，确保法规溯源的完整性
面向大语言模型法规合规评估的RegOps-Bench基准，包含结构化引用约束和复杂权限层级
对比评估方法用于检测现有RAG系统在扁平结构规则处理中的饱和效应

title: Why Specialist Models Still Matter: A Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Paradigm for Medical Artificial Intelligence
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 12 pages main text, 16 pages appendix
summary: The impressive performance of generalist large language models (LLMs) such as GPT and Claude in healthcare raises a critical question: will domain-specific medical specialist models become obsolete? We argue that the future of medical artificial intelligence (AI) lies not in building monolithic medical foundation models, nor in replacing human expertise, but in orchestrating collaboration among generalist LLMs, domain-specific specialist models, and clinicians. We propose HetMedAgent, a heterogeneous medical multi-agent framework that enables conflict-aware evidence fusion, uncertainty-based clinician intervention triggering, and adaptive threshold calibration. Experiments on three real-world clinical decision-making tasks demonstrate that the synergy between generalist LLMs and domain-specific specialist models significantly outperforms using either type of model alone, validating the irreplaceable value of specialist models in modality-specific analysis. HetMedAgent represents a shift from building medical LLMs or foundation models to multi-agent collaboration, achieving a balance between general reasoning capabilities and domain-specific precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetMedAgent，一个异构医疗多智能体框架，通过协调通用大语言模型、领域专用模型和临床医生的协作，在三项真实临床决策任务中证明其性能显著优于单一模型，为医疗AI从构建单一基础模型转向多智能体协作提供了新方向。
AI.motivation: 探索通用大语言模型（如GPT、Claude）在医疗领域的应用边界，论证领域专用医疗模型并未过时，并提出一种融合通用与专用模型优势的协作框架。
AI.method: 提出HetMedAgent异构医疗多智能体框架，包含三个核心机制：(1) 冲突感知证据融合（conflict-aware evidence fusion），(2) 基于不确定性的临床医生干预触发（uncertainty-based clinician intervention triggering），(3) 自适应阈值校准（adaptive threshold calibration）。
AI.result: 在三项真实临床决策任务上，通用LLM与领域专用模型的协同显著优于单独使用任一类型模型，验证了专用模型在模态特定分析中的不可替代价值。
AI.conclusion: 医疗AI的未来不在于构建单一的全能医疗基础模型，也不在于取代人类专家，而在于实现通用LLM、领域专用模型和临床医生之间的协同协作。
idea_en: A heterogeneous medical multi-agent framework (HetMedAgent) that orchestrates collaboration between generalist LLMs, domain-specific specialist models, and clinicians for clinical decision-making.
A conflict-aware evidence fusion mechanism that intelligently reconciles conflicting outputs from heterogeneous AI models (generalist vs specialist) in medical contexts.
An uncertainty-based clinician intervention triggering mechanism that dynamically determines when human expert input is needed based on model confidence levels.
An adaptive threshold calibration method that automatically adjusts decision thresholds for optimal balance between AI autonomy and human oversight in clinical workflows.
idea_ch: 一种异构医疗多智能体框架（HetMedAgent），协调通用大语言模型、领域专用模型和临床医生之间的协作以支持临床决策
一种冲突感知证据融合机制，智能协调异构AI模型（通用型vs专用型）在医疗场景中的冲突输出
一种基于不确定性的临床医生干预触发机制，根据模型置信度动态判断何时需要人类专家介入
一种自适应阈值校准方法，自动调整决策阈值以在临床工作流中实现AI自主与人类监督之间的最佳平衡

title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文在CBraMod骨干网络下基准测试五种位置编码策略，发现其在运动想象和情绪识别任务上表现各异，无统一最优方案，球形位置编码(SPE)擅长运动想象，非对称条件位置编码(ACPE)跨任务更稳定。
AI.motivation: EEG解码模型在不同任务、受试者和数据集间泛化能力差，Transformer需明确位置信息，但EEG电极空间分布的特殊性使得如何编码电极位置成为关键问题，目前缺乏系统性对比研究。
AI.method: 以CBraMod为骨干网络，在运动想象分类和情绪识别两个任务上，对五种位置编码策略（含SPE、ACPE等）进行线性探测和微调协议下的基准测试。
AI.result: 没有单一策略在所有任务上一致最优。SPE在运动想象任务上表现优异，但在情绪识别上效果差；ACPE在跨任务表现上更一致稳定。
AI.conclusion: 最优位置编码策略具有任务依赖性，不存在适用于所有EEG解码场景的通用解决方案。
idea_en: A positional encoding method for EEG transformers that adaptively learns electrode spatial relationships using spherical harmonic representations of scalp electrode coordinates.
An asymmetric conditional positional encoding (ACPE) mechanism for EEG transformers that dynamically adjusts position encoding based on task-specific brain activity patterns.
A task-adaptive positional encoding selection framework for EEG foundation models that automatically selects the optimal encoding strategy based on the downstream task characteristics.
A hybrid positional encoding system combining spherical and learned embeddings for EEG transformers with task-specific weighting.
idea_ch: 一种基于球面谐波表示的EEG电极坐标编码方法，利用头皮电极的空间球面分布特性进行自适应位置编码。
一种非对称条件位置编码(ACPE)机制，根据特定任务的大脑活动模式动态调整EEG Transformer中的位置编码。
一种面向EEG基础模型的任务自适应位置编码选择框架，根据下游任务特征自动选择最优编码策略。
一种结合球面编码与可学习嵌入的混合位置编码系统，具有任务特定权重调节功能。

title: LFQ: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization for Boosting the Generation Quality of Low-Bit Quantized LLMs
summary: As large language models continue to scale, low-bit weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical solution to their memory-efficient deployment. Although block-wise PTQ is capable of matching the full-precision (FP) baseline on basic language modeling and understanding, its quality is degraded for generative tasks -- especially at longer responses and extended chains of thought, which is critical in boosting task accuracy. We attribute this shortfall to two factors: (i) the omission of the unembedding layer (the LM head) in block-wise optimization and (ii) the reliance on the mean squared error (MSE) objective. Both factors cause the token probability distribution of the quantized model to misalign with that of the FP model, yielding notable accuracy drops on text generation benchmarks. To rectify the discrepancy, we introduce Logit-aware Final-block Quantization (LFQ), a simple yet effective enhancement to block-wise PTQ that quantizes the final Transformer block by minimizing the cross-entropy between the logits of the FP model and those of its quantized counterpart. By aligning token probabilities at the logit level in the final block, LFQ consistently improves the accuracy of complex generation tasks over state-of-the-art block-wise PTQ across diverse model families, while maintaining parity with FP baselines on language modeling and understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LFQ（Logit-aware Final-block Quantization），一种改进块级低比特后训练量化（PTQ）的方法，通过优化最终Transformer块的交叉熵损失来对齐量化模型与全精度模型的logit概率分布，从而提升生成任务（尤其长回复和长链推理）的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有块级PTQ在基础语言建模和理解任务上表现良好，但在生成任务（尤其是长回复、长链推理）上质量下降。作者归因于两个因素：(i) 块级优化忽略了unembedding层（LM head）；(ii) 依赖MSE损失函数。两者导致量化模型的token概率分布与全精度模型不对齐，在文本生成基准上产生显著准确率下降。
AI.method: 提出LFQ（Logit-aware Final-block Quantization），一种对块级PTQ的简单而有效的增强方法：量化最终Transformer块时，最小化全精度模型logits与量化模型logits之间的交叉熵损失，从而在最终块的logit层面对齐token概率。
AI.result: LFQ在多个模型系列上持续优于最先进的块级PTQ方法，在复杂生成任务上提升准确率，同时在语言建模和理解任务上保持与全精度基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过logit层面的交叉熵对齐而非MSE损失，并关注最终块的量化，可以显著改善低比特量化模型在生成任务上的表现，弥补块级PTQ在长文本生成和链式推理方面的质量差距。
idea_en: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization (LFQ): A method that quantizes only the final Transformer block by minimizing cross-entropy loss between FP model logits and quantized model logits, improving generative task accuracy.
Unembedding-aware block-wise PTQ: Enhancing post-training quantization by incorporating the LM head (unembedding layer) into the optimization objective to align token probability distributions.

Cross-entropy based block-wise quantization: Replacing traditional MSE loss with cross-entropy loss in block-wise PTQ for better token probability alignment between full-precision and quantized models.

Logit-level alignment for generative quantization: A quantization technique that focuses on aligning logit outputs at the final block level to preserve generative capabilities of LLMs under low-bit weight-only quantization.
idea_ch: 基于Logit感知的最终块量化（LFQ）：通过最小化全精度模型logits与量化模型logits之间的交叉熵损失来量化最终Transformer块，提升生成任务准确率。
Unembedding层感知的块级PTQ：将LM head（unembedding层）纳入优化目标，改进后训练量化中token概率分布的对齐。
基于交叉熵的块级量化损失函数：在块级PTQ中用交叉熵损失替代传统MSE损失，实现量化模型与全精度模型更好的token概率对齐。
面向生成任务的logit层面对齐量化技术：在最终块级别对齐logit输出，在低比特权重量化下保持大语言模型的生成能力。

title: From XXLTraffic to EvoXXLTraffic: Scaling Traffic Forecasting to Sensor-Evolving Networks
summary: Existing traffic forecasting benchmarks assume a fixed sensor set, but real road-sensor networks grow continuously as the road network changes year by year. We introduce the XXLTraffic dataset family, which spans up to 27 years of California PeMS and Transport for NSW data. The fixed-sensor subsets of XXLTraffic support extremely long forecasting with multi-year gaps and standard hourly / daily long-horizon forecasting. We extend it to EvoXXLTraffic, a sensor-evolving reorganization that exposes per-year active sensors, yearly traffic-flow matrices, and yearly graph snapshots across nine PeMS districts, with growth ratios ranging from +305% to over +10,000%. We define a yearly streaming forecasting protocol on EvoXXLTraffic in which each calendar year is a continual task, and benchmark a wide range of representative baselines drawn from static spatio-temporal GNNs, naïve online schemes, evolving-graph continual methods, and retrieval / test-time methods. We find that our ultra-large evolutionary dataset better reflects the real world, and many state-of-the-art (SOTA) results no longer work. Our dataset complements existing benchmarks by enabling more realistic forecasting under ultra-long evolutionary road networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了XXLTraffic数据集系列（涵盖27年加州PeMS和NSW交通数据），并扩展为EvoXXLTraffic——一个传感器不断演化的数据集，反映真实路网中传感器逐年增长（增长率高达+10,000%以上）。作者定义了年度流式预测协议，发现许多现有SOTA方法在超长演化路网下失效。
AI.motivation: 现有交通预测基准假设传感器集固定不变，但真实路网传感器逐年持续增长，现有方法无法处理这种演化场景。
AI.method: 构建XXLTraffic数据集（27年数据），扩展为EvoXXLTraffic（按年展示活跃传感器、流量矩阵和图快照）。定义年度流式预测协议，将每个日历年度作为连续任务，评测静态时空GNN、在线方案、演化图持续方法及检索/测试时方法等多种基线。
AI.result: 超长演化数据集更反映真实世界，许多现有SOTA方法在演化路网场景下不再有效。
AI.conclusion: EvoXXLTraffic数据集补充了现有基准，支持在超长演化路网下进行更现实的预测研究。
idea_en: A method for constructing sensor-evolving traffic datasets that reorganize per-year active sensors, yearly traffic-flow matrices, and yearly graph snapshots for streaming forecasting over multi-year gaps.
A yearly streaming forecasting protocol that treats each calendar year as a continual task, enabling benchmarking of evolving-graph continual learning methods on ultra-long traffic networks.

A benchmark framework for evaluating spatio-temporal GNNs, online schemes, evolving-graph continual methods, and retrieval/test-time methods under sensor growth ratios ranging from +305% to over +10,000%.
idea_ch: 一种构建传感器演化交通数据集的方法，按年重组活跃传感器、年度交通流量矩阵和年度图快照，支持多年间隔的流式预测。
一种年度流式预测协议，将每个日历年度视为连续任务，能够在超长交通网络上对演化图持续学习方法进行基准测试。
一种基准测试框架，用于在传感器增长率从+305%到超过+10,000%的条件下评估时空GNN、在线方案、演化图持续方法及检索/测试时方法。

title: Croissant Tasks: A Metadata Format for Reproducible Machine Learning Evaluations
summary: Reproducibility is fundamental to the scientific method, yet remains a critical challenge in machine learning. Contributing factors include underspecified execution details and brittle software environments. Human-centric remedies, such as checklists and manual verification, help but require intensive effort and fail to scale. To address this, we introduce Croissant Tasks: a declarative, machine-actionable metadata format that abstracts low-level implementation details into high-level specifications. This format enables conceptual reproducibility: verifying claims via independent, agent-generated implementations rather than brittle source code replication. We contribute: (1) the Croissant Tasks specification, formally decoupling task problem from solution; (2) an automated LLM pipeline that retrofits existing benchmarks into this format; and (3) empirical validation showing autonomous agents can ingest these specifications to generate functional, accurate reproduction pipelines from scratch. We envision this format as a new foundation for automated and conceptual reproducibility in machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Croissant Tasks格式，通过声明式、机器可执行的元数据格式将任务问题与解决方案解耦，利用LLM自动化管道将现有基准转化为该格式，实现概念可复现性而非脆弱的源码复现。
AI.motivation: 机器学习中存在严重的可复现性危机，主要源于执行细节规范不足和软件环境脆弱性。人工方法（如检查清单）虽有效但难以规模化。
AI.method: (1) 设计Croissant Tasks规范，将任务问题与解决方案正式解耦；(2) 构建自动化LLM管道，将现有基准转化为该声明式元数据格式；(3) 通过自治智能体从零生成功能完整的复现管道进行实证验证。
AI.result: 自治智能体能够读取Croissant Tasks格式的规范，从零生成功能准确的可复现管道。
AI.conclusion: Croissant Tasks格式可作为机器学习中自动化和概念可复现性的新基础。
idea_en: A declarative, machine-actionable metadata format (Croissant Tasks) for abstracting low-level implementation details into high-level specifications, enabling conceptual reproducibility.
An automated LLM pipeline that retrofits existing benchmarks into the Croissant Tasks declarative format without manual intervention.
A decoupled architecture separating task problem definition from solution implementation, allowing autonomous agents to generate independent reproduction pipelines from scratch.
A system for conceptual reproducibility where claims are verified via independent, agent-generated implementations rather than brittle source code replication.
idea_ch: 一种声明式、机器可执行的元数据格式（Croissant Tasks），将低级实现细节抽象为高级规范，实现概念可复现性。
一种自动化LLM管道，能够将现有基准测试集自动改造为Croissant Tasks声明式格式，无需人工干预。
一种任务问题与解决方案实现解耦的架构设计，允许自治智能体从零生成独立的复现管道。
一种基于概念可复现性的验证系统，通过独立、智能体生成的实现来验证科学声明，而非脆弱的源码复制。

title: Certified Policy Optimisation for Nested Causal Bandits via PAC-Bayes Risk
summary: Critical sequential decisions are rarely single-timescale: a strategic decision causally shapes the context in which every subsequent tactical choice is made; standard bandit and reinforcement-learning theory does not capture this causal coupling between timescales. We formalise the problem class as Nested Contextual Causal Bandits (NCCBs), a hierarchical SCM where each level's action sets the next level's context distribution, and propose Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS), which draws one mechanism-factorised belief per episode and acts recursively under it. Our main theoretical result is a causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound that certifies any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime, answering the deployment question: can we trust this agent here, and at what risk? Experiments on a hierarchical SCM show that, against a matched RFF-GP joint regression on the same function class, the factorised SCM-mechanism posterior transfers significantly better zero-shot under exogenous distribution shifts, the recursive meta-to-inner commit significantly dominates the joint-commit alternative in distribution, and the certificate significantly contracts as offline data accumulates. Combining these results, we establish progressive certified handover, a safe-deployment method: each timescale flips from a legacy controller to NCTS when gains can be certified, independently of the others.

AI.tldr: 本文提出嵌套上下文因果赌博机（NCCBs）框架，将分层因果结构引入序列决策，并设计嵌套因果汤普森采样（NCTS）算法，通过因果PAC-Bayesian超额风险界实现离线、任意时间的策略认证，支持分层安全部署的渐进式认证移交。
AI.motivation: 标准赌博机和强化学习理论忽略了战略决策与战术决策之间的因果耦合——战略决策因果性地塑造了后续战术决策的上下文环境。现有方法无法捕捉这种跨时间尺度的因果依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出NCCBs框架（层次化结构因果模型，每层动作设置下一层的上下文分布），以及NCTS算法（每轮抽取一个机制因子化的信念，在其下递归行动）。理论上，推导了因果PAC-Bayesian超额风险界，仅凭历史数据即可认证任意候选部署策略（离线、任意时间）。
AI.result: 在层次化SCM实验中：NCTS的因子化SCM机制后验在外生分布偏移下零样本迁移显著优于RFF-GP联合回归；递归的元到内层承诺显著优于联合承诺；认证边界随离线数据积累显著收缩。结合以上结果，建立了渐进式认证移交的安全部署方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将因果结构与分层时间尺度结合，提供了可认证的离线安全部署方案，能够回答"能否在此处信任该代理，风险多大"的关键问题。
idea_en: Nested Contextual Causal Bandits (NCCBs): A hierarchical SCM framework where each level's action sets the context distribution for the next level, capturing causal coupling across timescales in sequential decision-making.

Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS): An algorithm that draws one mechanism-factorised belief per episode and acts recursively, enabling factorised posterior updates for hierarchical causal structures.
Causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound: A theoretical certificate that evaluates any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime, quantifying deployment risk.

Progressive Certified Handover: A safe-deployment method where each timescale independently flips from a legacy controller to NCTS only when gains can be certified, enabling staged safety verification.
idea_ch: 嵌套上下文因果赌博机（NCCBs）：一种层次化结构因果模型框架，每层动作设定下一层的上下文分布，捕获跨时间尺度的因果耦合关系。
嵌套因果汤普森采样（NCTS）：每轮抽取一个机制因子化信念并递归行动的算法，支持层次化因果结构下的因子化后验更新。
因果PAC-Bayesian超额风险界：一种理论认证方法，仅基于历史数据即可离线、任意时间地评估任意候选部署策略，量化部署风险。
渐进式认证移交方法：各时间尺度独立地从传统控制器切换到NCTS，仅当收益可被认证时才进行切换，实现分阶段安全验证的部署策略。

title: SkillsInjector: Dynamic Skill Context Construction for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents now draw on growing skill libraries to handle complex tasks. However, injecting more skills does not always improve task completion and can even degrade it. Existing methods still treat skill injection as a static step, selecting skills with fixed criteria, fixing the budget in advance, and leaving descriptions unchanged. We argue that this static treatment can undermine the utility of skills, because which skills are exposed, how many are included, and how they are presented all affect downstream performance. We propose SkillsInjector, a two-stage adaptive method that jointly addresses these decisions. First, a context planner learns execution-grounded skill preferences and admits an adaptive number of skills for each task. A set-aware renderer then tailors how selected descriptions are presented relative to their co-injected neighbors. Across tau2-bench, SkillsBench, and ALFWorld, SkillsInjector achieves the highest score, improving over the strongest baseline by 3.9, 6.1, and 7.3 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies show that skill selection, adaptive budgeting, and set-aware rendering each contribute to the gain. These results show that skill-augmented agents benefit from optimizing the injected context itself. Code will be released upon publication

AI.tldr: SkillsInjector提出了一种两阶段自适应方法，通过上下文规划器学习技能偏好并自适应调整技能数量，再通过集合感知渲染器优化技能描述呈现方式，从而提升LLM代理的任务完成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将技能注入视为静态步骤，使用固定标准选择技能、预先设定预算、不加修改地保留描述。这种静态处理会削弱技能效用，因为技能数量、选择和呈现方式都会影响下游性能。
AI.method: SkillsInjector包含两个阶段：1) 上下文规划器（Context Planner）学习执行基础的技能偏好，为每个任务自适应确定技能数量；2) 集合感知渲染器（Set-aware Renderer）根据共注入的近邻技能，定制化调整所选技能描述的呈现方式。
AI.result: 在tau2-bench、SkillsBench和ALFWorld三个基准上，SkillsInjector均取得最高分数，相比最强基线分别提升3.9、6.1和7.3个百分点。消融研究表明技能选择、自适应预算和集合感知渲染各自贡献了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 技能增强型代理可以通过优化注入上下文本身来获得性能提升，即动态选择技能、自适应调整技能数量并优化技能描述呈现方式均能显著改善任务完成效果。
idea_en: A two-stage adaptive skill injection method comprising: (1) a context planner that learns execution-grounded skill preferences and adaptively determines the number of skills per task; (2) a set-aware renderer that tailors skill descriptions based on co-injected neighboring skills.

An adaptive skill budgeting mechanism that dynamically determines how many skills to inject for each task based on learned execution-grounded preferences, rather than using a fixed predetermined budget.

A set-aware rendering technique for skill descriptions that modifies how each selected skill description is presented based on the presence and content of co-injected neighboring skills in the context.
A context optimization framework for LLM agents that jointly optimizes skill selection, skill quantity (budget), and skill presentation format as interdependent decisions.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段自适应技能注入方法：第一阶段通过上下文规划器学习基于执行的技能偏好并自适应确定每任务的技能数量；第二阶段通过集合感知渲染器根据共注入的近邻技能来定制化调整技能描述的呈现方式。
一种自适应技能预算机制：基于学习到的执行基础偏好，动态决定每个任务应注入多少技能，而非使用固定的预设预算。
一种集合感知的技能描述渲染技术：根据上下文中共注入的近邻技能的存在和内容，修改每个选中技能描述的呈现方式，避免描述间的干扰或冗余。
一种LLM代理的上下文联合优化框架：将技能选择、技能数量（预算）和技能呈现格式作为相互依赖的决策进行协同优化，而非独立处理。

title: MEMENTO: Leveraging Web as a Learning Signal for Low-Data Domains
summary: Real-world tasks often lack large labeled datasets, motivating extensive work on learning in low-data regimes. However, existing approaches such as few-shot prompting, instruction tuning, and synthetic data generation, continue to treat labeled or pseudo-labeled data as the primary learning signal. In contrast, human practitioners acquire expertise through repeated, self-directed interaction with the open web, progressively refining both domain knowledge and search strategies. We propose MEMENTO, a framework that treats the web as a learning signal rather than a stateless retrieval interface. MEMENTO operates at two levels: within each session, it conducts iterative web exploration via an Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET) that decomposes tasks into evolving questions and reflects on intermediate findings; across sessions, it accumulates experience through dual-channel memory, separating declarative knowledge (facts) from procedural knowledge (search strategies). This design enables agents to learn reusable research strategies and domain expertise from trajectories of web interaction without additional model training. We evaluate MEMENTO on two low-data professional domains: sales automation and legal research. Our empirical results show consistent improvements in performance over ReAct based baselines (+25.6% on sales automation and 36.5% on legal research), demonstrating that the web can serve as a scalable learning source for acquiring task-specific expertise in data-scarce settings.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO提出将网页作为学习信号而非无状态检索接口，通过自适应探索树（AET）进行会话内迭代探索，并通过双通道记忆（陈述性知识+程序性知识）跨会话积累经验，在低数据专业领域（销售自动化、法律研究）显著超越ReAct基线。
AI.motivation: 现有低数据学习方法（少样本提示、指令微调、合成数据生成）仍将标注/伪标注数据作为主要学习信号，缺乏人类通过反复、自定向地与开放网络交互来获取专业知识的能力。
AI.method: 提出MEMENTO框架：1）会话内通过自适应探索树（AET）将任务分解为演进问题并进行迭代网页探索与反思；2）跨会话通过双通道记忆系统分离陈述性知识（事实）和程序性知识（搜索策略），无需额外模型训练即可从网页交互轨迹中学习可复用的研究策略与领域专业知识。
AI.result: 在销售自动化领域提升25.6%，在法律研究领域提升36.5%，均优于ReAct基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 网页可作为数据稀缺场景下获取任务特定专业知识的可扩展学习源，双通道记忆机制有效分离事实知识与搜索策略，提升了跨会话的知识复用能力。
idea_en: Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET): A method that decomposes complex web-based tasks into dynamically evolving sub-questions and conducts iterative exploration with reflection on intermediate findings within a single session.

Dual-channel memory for web agents: A system that separates declarative knowledge (facts) from procedural knowledge (search strategies) to accumulate reusable research strategies and domain expertise across multiple web interaction sessions.

Web-as-learning-signal paradigm: A framework that treats the open web not as a stateless retrieval interface but as a dynamic learning signal source, enabling agents to acquire task-specific expertise without additional model training.
idea_ch: 自适应探索树（AET）：一种将复杂网页任务分解为动态演进的子问题，并在单次会话中通过迭代探索和中间结果反思来完成任务的方法。
双通道记忆系统：将陈述性知识（事实性信息）与程序性知识（搜索策略）分离存储，使智能体能够在多次网页交互会话间积累并复用可泛化的研究策略和领域专业知识。
网页即学习信号的范式：将开放网页视为动态学习信号源而非无状态检索接口，使智能体无需额外模型训练即可从网页交互轨迹中获取任务特定专业知识。

title: SAAS: Self-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Over-Search Mitigation in Agentic Search
summary: Agentic search enables LLMs to solve complex multi-hop questions through iterative reasoning and external search. Despite the effectiveness, these systems often suffer from a critical limitation in practice: agents fail to recognize their own knowledge boundaries, blindly triggering searches when internal knowledge suffices and failing to terminate search even when adequate evidence has been collected. The lack of self-awareness leads to severe \textbf{over-search}, incurring substantial inference latency and prohibitive computational cost. To this end, we propose SAAS, a novel RL framework designed to cultivate dynamic self-awareness that precisely regulates search behavior without compromising accuracy. SAAS introduces three key components: (i) a search boundary modeling mechanism, which identifies the search boundary under the evolving policy by contrasting search-disabled and search-enabled rollouts; (ii) a boundary-aware reward module, which translates this boundary awareness into trajectory-level penalties, suppressing unnecessary and redundant searches; and (iii) a stage-wise optimization strategy, which leverages a sequential curriculum to prioritize reasoning over search regularization, thereby avoiding reward hacking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAAS substantially reduces over-search, while maintaining accuracy. Our code is anonymously released at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/SAAS.

AI.tldr: SAAS是一个强化学习框架，通过动态自我感知能力精准调节搜索行为，在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著减少LLM agentic search中的过度搜索问题。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic search系统缺乏自我感知能力，无法识别自身知识边界，导致盲目触发搜索或无法及时终止搜索，造成严重的过度搜索（over-search），带来高推理延迟和计算成本。
AI.method: SAAS框架包含三个核心组件：(i) 搜索边界建模机制，通过对比启用/禁用搜索的rollouts来识别当前策略下的搜索边界；(ii) 边界感知奖励模块，将边界意识转化为轨迹级惩罚，抑制不必要和冗余搜索；(iii) 分阶段优化策略，通过顺序课程优先推理再正则化搜索，避免奖励作弊。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SAAS显著减少了过度搜索，同时保持了搜索准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化学习培养动态自我感知能力是解决LLM agentic search中过度搜索问题的有效方法，SAAS在不牺牲准确性的前提下实现了计算成本的大幅降低。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning framework that cultivates dynamic self-awareness in LLM agents to recognize their own knowledge boundaries and regulate search behavior accordingly
A search boundary modeling mechanism that identifies the optimal search boundary under evolving policy by contrasting search-disabled and search-enabled rollouts
A boundary-aware reward module that translates boundary awareness into trajectory-level penalties to suppress unnecessary and redundant searches
A stage-wise optimization strategy with sequential curriculum learning that prioritizes reasoning over search regularization to avoid reward hacking
idea_ch: 一种基于强化学习的动态自我感知培养框架，使LLM agent能够识别自身知识边界并精确调节搜索行为
通过对比启用/禁用搜索的轨迹rollouts来识别当前策略下最优搜索边界的建模机制
将边界感知转化为轨迹级惩罚信号的边界感知奖励模块，用于抑制不必要和冗余搜索
采用顺序课程学习的分阶段优化策略，优先推理训练再引入搜索正则化，防止奖励作弊

title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
summary: Modern open-world agents such as OpenClaw exhibit powerful cross-environment execution capabilities yet introduce broad new safety risk sources. Meanwhile, advanced frontier AI models drastically lower attack barriers, rendering current agent alignment frameworks inadequate for real-world deployment. To tackle these emerging threats, we propose a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework. Specifically, we update the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios. We further build a taxonomy-guided data engine with influence-function purification to train lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 variants (0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters) using only around 1k samples, achieving comparable performance with leading closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4). Based on AgentDoG 1.5, we construct a highly efficient agentic safety SFT and RL training environment, which reduces deployment overhead in Docker-level environments by two orders of magnitude. Finally, we deploy AgentDoG 1.5 as a training-free online guardrail for real-time safety moderation. Extensive experimental results indicate that AgentDoG 1.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in diverse and complex interactive agentic scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

AI.tldr: 提出面向开放世界智能体的轻量级安全对齐框架AgentDoG 1.5，通过更新安全分类体系、基于影响函数纯化的数据引擎、高效SFT/RL训练环境，实现仅用约1k样本训练小模型即可达到闭源大模型的安全检测性能，并可作为免训练在线护栏部署。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体安全对齐框架不足以应对开放世界智能体（如OpenClaw）和前沿AI模型带来的新型安全风险，且攻击门槛大幅降低，亟需轻量、可扩展的安全对齐方案。
AI.method: 1) 更新智能体安全分类体系以覆盖Codex和OpenClaw执行场景的新风险；2) 构建基于影响函数纯化的数据引擎，用约1k样本训练AgentDoG 1.5（0.8B-8B参数）；3) 构建高效的智能体安全SFT和RL训练环境，将Docker级部署开销降低两个数量级；4) 部署为免训练在线安全护栏。
AI.result: AgentDoG 1.5在多样且复杂的交互式智能体场景中达到SOTA性能，与GPT-5.4等领先闭源模型性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级安全对齐框架可有效解决开放世界智能体的安全风险，小模型经精心训练可媲美大模型，且所有模型和数据集均已开源。
idea_en: Influence-function purification based data engine for agent safety training data selection, enabling effective model alignment with only ~1k samples
Updated agent safety taxonomy specifically covering emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios for open-world agents
Lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 models (0.8B-8B) trained via safety SFT and RL that achieves comparable performance to GPT-5.4 for safety moderation
Training-free online guardrail deployment architecture for real-time agent safety moderation with Docker-level overhead reduced by two orders of magnitude
Highly efficient agentic safety training environment that dramatically reduces deployment computational cost via optimized SFT and RL pipeline
idea_ch: 基于影响函数纯化的数据引擎，仅需约1k样本即可高效筛选训练数据实现智能体安全对齐
面向Codex和OpenClaw执行场景的更新版智能体安全分类体系，覆盖开放世界新型风险

title: PRAIB: Peer Review AI Benchmark of Behaviour of LLM-Assisted Reviewing
summary: The growing number of submitted papers has motivated the exploration of Large Language Models (LLMs) as a means to support and augment the peer review process, particularly in terms of improving its speed and scalability. Yet, it remains unknown whether LLMs engage with scientific manuscripts in the same manner as human reviewers, or whether they merely produce review-looking text. To address this, we introduce the Peer Review AI Benchmark (PRAIB), a novel framework comprising thoroughly defined metrics that measure review specificity, style, and behavior of engagement. To complement the PRAIB framework, we conduct a large-scale empirical study leveraging a dataset of 11,000 reviews generated by five proprietary and open-source models for 1,000 ICLR and NeurIPS papers. Spanning the 2021--2025 period, these machine-generated reviews are compared against original human feedback across diverse prompting strategies to identify systematic behavioral divergences. Our analysis reveals that the generated reviews diverge significantly from feedback provided by human reviewers: LLM ratings are less variable, positively biased, and overconfident, and their cross-reference patterns are model-dependent and distinct from human norms. Furthermore, when evaluated through PRAIB, we observe that LLMs tend to generate longer, more complex reviews, yet frequently overlook the atomic weaknesses noted by human reviewers. By characterizing where and how LLMs reviewing behavior departs from human norms, PRAIB provides the community with a diagnostic tool for identifying which aspects of the review process LLMs can reliably support today and which require further development before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRAIB框架，用于衡量LLM生成的同行评审与人类评审之间的差异。通过对11000条机器评审的分析，发现LLM评审存在评分偏差小、正向偏见、过度自信、交叉引用模式异于人类、忽略细粒度缺陷等问题。
AI.motivation: 随着论文提交量增长，LLM被用于辅助同行评审，但LLM是否真正像人类一样审稿还是只是生成“看似评审”的文本尚不清楚，因此需要系统性评估工具。
AI.method: 提出PRAIB框架，包含评审特异性、风格和参与行为等多维度指标；利用5种模型对1000篇论文生成11000条评审，与人类评审进行对比分析。
AI.result: LLM评审与人类评审存在显著差异：评分更集中、正向偏倚且过度自信；交叉引用模式依赖模型且不同于人类；评审更长更复杂但常忽略人类关注的原子级弱点。
AI.conclusion: PRAIB可作为诊断工具，识别LLM在审稿流程中哪些环节可可靠支持、哪些环节仍需改进，为LLM辅助同行评审的合理部署提供指导。
idea_en: A Peer Review AI Benchmark (PRAIB) framework with defined metrics for measuring review specificity, style, and behavioral engagement of LLM-generated peer reviews.
A systematic methodology for detecting systematic behavioral divergences between LLM-generated and human peer reviews using large-scale datasets across multiple prompting strategies.
A diagnostic tool that identifies which aspects of the peer review process LLMs can reliably support and which require further development before deployment.
idea_ch: 一种同行评审AI基准（PRAIB）框架，包含定义好的评审特异性、风格和参与行为指标，用于衡量LLM生成的同行评审质量。
一种系统性检测方法，利用大规模数据集和多提示策略，识别LLM生成评审与人类评审之间的系统性行为差异。
一种诊断工具，能够识别LLM在同行评审流程中哪些环节可以可靠支持、哪些环节仍需改进，为LLM辅助审稿的合理部署提供指导。

title: Harnessing non-adversarial robustness in large language models
summary: The work presents an approach for addressing the challenge of robustness in Large Language Models (LLMs) to alterations and potential errors caused by semantically similar but textually different prompts. Recent works have shown that these kinds of prompt variations can significantly impact the performance of LLMs on tasks. The central question is: can LLMs' robustness to semantically-neutral prompt alterations be acquired without expensive retraining of the entire model? We address this question both theoretically and through experiments. Our theoretical analysis reveals a crucial factor impacting model robustness - a systematic expected shift or perturbation-induced bias in neural network module outputs. Motivated by this analysis, we show that robustness can be achieved via a simple fine-tuning process: debiasing for robustness. We identify conditions when debiasing helps and when it does not, and demonstrate, through both theory and extensive experiments, that debiasing for robustness may indeed be a quick and efficient tool to enhance robustness and provide certification against random prompt perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过去偏置（debiasing）微调来增强大语言模型（LLMs）对语义相似但文本不同提示的鲁棒性的方法，避免了昂贵的全模型重训练。
AI.motivation: LLMs对语义相似但文本不同的提示存在显著性能波动，而现有方法需要昂贵重训练。作者试图寻找一种高效、低成本的鲁棒性增强方案。
AI.method: 理论分析揭示了神经网络模块输出中存在由扰动引起的系统性偏差（perturbation-induced bias），进而提出"去偏置微调"（debiasing for robustness）方法，通过简单的微调过程消除该偏差以提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 通过理论和实验证明，去偏置微调在特定条件下能有效提升LLMs对随机提示扰动的鲁棒性，并能提供可认证的鲁棒性保证。
AI.conclusion: 去偏置微调是一种快速、高效的工具，能在不需要全模型重训练的前提下增强LLMs对提示扰动的鲁棒性，并给出了其有效/无效的条件边界。
idea_en: A debiasing fine-tuning method that removes perturbation-induced bias from neural network module outputs to enhance LLM robustness against semantically-equivalent prompt variations without full model retraining.
A theoretical framework identifying conditions under which debiasing helps or does not help for robustness against prompt perturbations in LLMs.
A certification mechanism for robustness against random prompt perturbations achieved through the proposed debiasing fine-tuning process.
idea_ch: 一种去偏置微调方法，通过消除神经网络模块输出中的扰动诱导偏差，在不进行全模型重训练的情况下增强LLM对语义等价提示变体的鲁棒性。
一种理论框架，用于识别去偏置方法在LLM提示扰动鲁棒性中有效和无效的条件边界。
一种通过提出的去偏置微调过程实现的、针对随机提示扰动的鲁棒性认证机制。

title: Quantifying and Optimizing Simplicity via Polynomial Representations
summary: Deep networks often exhibit a preference for "simple" solutions, and such a simplicity bias is widely believed to play a key role in generalization. Yet a broadly applicable, quantitative measure of simplicity remains elusive. We introduce polynomial representations as a distribution-aware, low-dimensional surrogate for neural functions: we approximate a network's predictive behavior along data-dependent interpolation paths using orthogonal polynomial bases, yielding a compact functional representation. We show that the effective degree of this representation serves as a practical simplicity metric that is predictive of generalization across tasks and architectures, and consistently outperforms existing generalization proxies such as sharpness. Finally, polynomial representations naturally yield a differentiable simplicity regularizer, which consistently improves generalization in image and text classification, fine-tuning contrastive vision-language models, and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多项式表示作为神经网络函数的低维代理，通过正交多项式基沿数据依赖插值路径近似网络预测行为，得到有效度作为简单性度量，可预测泛化性并优于锐度等现有指标，同时可作为可微正则化器提升各类任务的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 深度网络倾向于"简单"解，这种简单性偏差被认为对泛化至关重要，但缺乏广泛适用的定量简单性度量。
AI.method: 提出多项式表示方法：沿数据依赖插值路径使用正交多项式基近似网络预测行为，得到紧凑的函数表示，以该表示的有效度作为简单性度量。
AI.result: 该简单性度量能预测跨任务和架构的泛化性能，一致优于锐度等现有泛化代理指标；其可微形式作为正则化器能在图像分类、文本分类、对比视觉-语言模型微调和强化学习中持续提升泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多项式表示提供了一种分布感知、低维的神经网络函数代理，其有效度是实用的泛化预测指标，且对应的可微正则化器能有效提升多种任务的泛化性能。
idea_en: A method for measuring neural network simplicity using polynomial representations, where orthogonal polynomial bases approximate network predictions along data-dependent interpolation paths to derive an effective degree as a simplicity metric.

A differentiable simplicity regularizer derived from polynomial representations that improves generalization in image classification, text classification, fine-tuning of contrastive vision-language models, and reinforcement learning.
A distribution-aware, low-dimensional surrogate for neural functions using polynomial representations that serves as a generalization predictor outperforming existing proxies such as sharpness.
idea_ch: 一种基于多项式表示的神经网络简单性度量方法：沿数据依赖插值路径使用正交多项式基近似网络预测行为，提取有效度作为简单性指标
一种由多项式表示导出的可微简单性正则化器，可应用于图像分类、文本分类、对比视觉-语言模型微调和强化学习等多种任务中提升泛化性能
一种分布感知的神经网络函数低维代理表示方法，利用多项式表示作为泛化预测指标，性能优于锐度等现有泛化代理指标

title: OptSkills: Learning Generalizable Optimization Skills from Problem Archetypes via Cluster-Based Distillation
summary: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically formulate and solve optimization problems from natural language has emerged as an efficient paradigm for automated optimization. However, existing methods still exhibit limited generalization: they are sensitive to superficial narrative variations, reuse experience mainly at the case level, and struggle to adapt to shifted or emerging problem types. We propose OptSkills, an archetype-centric skill learning and reasoning agent system for optimization modeling and solving. To improve robust generalization, our system clusters problems by their underlying archetypes rather than surface narratives. To improve in-distribution generalization, it explores diverse modeling paradigms and solver configurations within each cluster, then distills successful trajectories into reusable workflow-level skills. To improve out-of-distribution generalization, it refines existing skills or expands the skill library using newly obtained trajectories. Our system achieves a state-of-the-art micro-averaged accuracy of 68.27% on datasets encompassing diverse problem types and scenarios. In addition, on MIPLIB-NL, a highly challenging large-scale and high-dimensional benchmark, it achieves 26.91% accuracy, outperforming DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking by 4.53%. After skill learning on Nano-CO, it reaches 72.79% on the OOD NLCO benchmark. Code and skills are available at https://github.com/fujiwaranoM0kou/OptSkills.

AI.tldr: 提出OptSkills系统，通过以原型（archetype）为中心的技能学习与推理，提升LLM从自然语言自动建模求解优化问题的泛化能力，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动优化方法对表面叙述变化敏感，经验复用局限于案例级别，难以适应转移或新兴问题类型，泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 1）按底层原型（而非表面叙述）聚类问题；2）在每个簇内探索多种建模范式和求解器配置，将成功轨迹蒸馏为可复用的工作流级技能；3）利用新获得的轨迹细化和扩展现有技能库，以应对分布外（OOD）场景。
AI.result: 在多种问题类型的数据集上微平均准确率68.27%；在MIPLIB-NL上达26.91%，超越DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 4.53%；在Nano-CO上学习技能后，OOD NLCO基准达72.79%。
AI.conclusion: 基于原型的技能学习策略能显著提升LLM在优化建模与求解中的泛化鲁棒性、分布内和分布外泛化能力。
idea_en: Archetype-centric problem clustering method that groups optimization problems by underlying mathematical archetypes rather than surface natural language narratives, improving LLM generalization across varied problem descriptions.

Workflow-level skill distillation technique that explores diverse modeling paradigms and solver configurations within each problem cluster and distills successful solution trajectories into reusable skills.
Dynamic skill library expansion mechanism that refines existing skills or adds new skills based on newly obtained trajectories, enabling adaptation to out-of-distribution optimization problems.
End-to-end LLM agent system architecture for automatic optimization modeling and solving that integrates archetype clustering, skill learning, and skill-based reasoning in a unified pipeline.
idea_ch: 基于原型的优化问题聚类方法：按底层数学原型而非表面自然语言叙述对问题聚类，提升LLM在不同问题描述下的泛化能力
工作流级技能蒸馏技术：在每个问题簇内探索多种建模范式和求解器配置，将成功求解轨迹蒸馏为可复用的工作流技能
动态技能库扩展机制：基于新获得的求解轨迹对现有技能进行细化或向技能库添加新技能，适应分布外优化问题
端到端LLM智能体系统架构：将原型聚类、技能学习和基于技能的推理集成在统一流水线中，实现自动优化建模与求解

title: OmniMatBench: A Human-Calibrated Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Across 19 Materials Science Subfields
summary: As multimodal language models play an increasingly important role in scientific research, materials science offers a critical testbed due to its interdisciplinary, multimodal, and application-driven nature. However, existing materials benchmarks mainly focus on property prediction, knowledge QA, or characterization understanding, leaving the broader reasoning process from materials knowledge to application underexplored. To fill this gap, we present OmniMatBench, a human-calibrated multimodal reasoning benchmark for materials science. OmniMatBench contains 3,171 expert-curated QA and calculation problems across 19 materials-science subfields, spanning fundamental materials knowledge, structural and engineering materials, materials processing and manufacturing, and functional and applied materials. We evaluate 13 open-source and closed-source MLLMs and find that the best model achieves only a 0.372 overall score, revealing a substantial gap in current materials-science reasoning. Further analysis shows strong variation across subfields, fixed reasoning heuristics, uneven materials knowledge, and limited high-level knowledge application under formula-, retrieval-, and code-assisted settings. OmniMatBench provides crucial insights into the capabilities and limitations of current MLLMs and establishes a foundation for reliable AI assistants in materials-science research.

AI.tldr: 提出了OmniMatBench，一个材料科学领域的人工校准多模态推理基准，包含3,171个专家策划的QA和计算问题，覆盖19个子领域。评估13个MLLM模型，最佳模型仅得0.372分，揭示当前模型在材料科学推理方面的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有材料科学基准主要关注性质预测、知识问答或表征理解，缺乏从材料知识到应用的完整推理过程评估。
AI.method: 构建OmniMatBench基准，包含3,171个专家策划的QA和计算问题，覆盖19个材料科学子领域，涉及基础材料知识、结构/工程材料、材料加工与制造、功能与应用材料四大类别。
AI.result: 最佳模型(闭源)仅得0.372分；各子领域表现差异大；模型存在固定推理启发式、知识分布不均、高级知识应用能力有限等问题。
AI.conclusion: OmniMatBench揭示了当前MLLMs在材料科学推理中的重大能力差距，为构建可靠的AI辅助材料科学研究奠定了基础。
idea_en: A multimodal reasoning benchmark system for materials science with human-calibrated expert-curated QA and calculation problems across multiple subfields
A method for evaluating MLLMs' reasoning capabilities in materials science using formula-assisted, retrieval-assisted, and code-assisted settings
A framework for identifying fixed reasoning heuristics and uneven knowledge distribution in AI models applied to materials science
idea_ch: 一种面向材料科学的多模态推理基准系统，包含经专家校准和策划的跨多个子领域的问答与计算问题
一种利用公式辅助、检索辅助和代码辅助设置来评估MLLM在材料科学中推理能力的方法
一种识别AI模型在材料科学应用中固定推理启发式和知识分布不均的评估框架

title: Moment-KV: Momentum-Based Decode-Time KV Cache Compression for Long Generation
summary: Key-Value (KV) cache remains a major bottleneck for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in long-generation tasks. Prior work often applies uniform compression across both prefill and decoding caches, but compressing the prefill cache degrades performance by corrupting critical context. While preserving the prefill cache is essential, decoding-phase compression remains underexplored, with existing methods relying on rigid recency windows or instantaneous attention. Our analysis of attention dynamics reveals strong temporal patterns: critical tokens receive sustained attention over long horizons, while local reasoning involves short-lived bursts. Static heuristics fail to capture this behavior, leading to premature eviction of important tokens or retention of stale ones. We propose Moment-KV, a decoding-time KV cache compression method based on momentum-driven temporal attention aggregation. Our method models token importance as a continuously evolving state, where attention is aggregated with decay, capturing both long-term influence and recent relevance. Experiments show that Moment-KV significantly improves generation fidelity in long-generation tasks (2.3-3.2 %) while maintaining decoding latency.

AI.tldr: Moment-KV是一种基于动量驱动的时间注意力聚合的KV缓存压缩方法，在解码阶段通过建模token重要性的连续演化状态来提升长文本生成质量，同时保持解码延迟。
AI.motivation: KV缓存是LLM长生成任务的主要瓶颈，现有方法对预填充和解码缓存进行统一压缩会损害性能，而解码阶段压缩尚缺乏有效方法。
AI.method: 提出Moment-KV，一种基于动量驱动的时间注意力聚合方法，将token重要性建模为连续演化状态，通过衰减机制聚合注意力，同时捕捉长期影响和近期相关性。
AI.result: 在长文本生成任务中生成保真度提升2.3-3.2%，同时保持解码延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过动量驱动的时间注意力聚合，Moment-KV有效解决了解码阶段KV缓存压缩中重要token过早驱逐和过期token保留的问题。
idea_en: A momentum-driven temporal attention aggregation method for KV cache compression during decoding phase
A dynamic token importance modeling approach that treats token significance as a continuously evolving state with decay
A decoding-time KV cache compression system that distinguishes between long-term influence and recent relevance via temporal attention patterns
A method for selective prefill cache preservation combined with momentum-based decoding cache compression
idea_ch: 一种基于动量驱动的时间注意力聚合的解码阶段KV缓存压缩方法
将token重要性建模为连续演化状态并引入衰减机制的动态重要性评估方法
通过时间注意力模式区分长期影响和近期相关性的解码阶段KV缓存压缩系统

title: Redundant or Necessary? A Benchmark for Detecting Redundant Steps in Agent Trajectories
summary: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, existing evaluation protocols primarily focus on task success, overlooking a critical aspect of agent behavior: execution efficiency. In practice, agent trajectories often contain redundant steps that consume substantial resources while contributing little to task completion. In this work, we propose and formulate a new research area: \textbf{redundant step detection} for agent trajectories. To support this initiative, we introduce \textbf{RedundancyBench}, a new benchmark that contains diverse tasks with carefully annotated trajectories, where each step is labeled according to its contribution to task completion. Using RedundancyBench, we develop and evaluate 3 representative methods to answer whether a step within trajectory is redundant or necessary. Our results show that even the best-performing method achieves only 24.88\% score in detecting redundant steps, while some methods perform worse than random guessing. These results highlight the task's complexity and the need for further research in this area. \footnote{Code and dataset in this paper are both available in \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RedundancyBench}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RedundancyBench}.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出冗余步骤检测这一新研究方向，并构建了RedundancyBench基准数据集，用于评估LLM智能体执行轨迹中的冗余步骤。实验表明，即使最优方法也仅达到24.88%的检测准确率，揭示了该任务的挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估协议主要关注任务成功率，忽略了执行效率问题。智能体轨迹中常存在大量冗余步骤，消耗计算资源但对任务完成贡献甚微，亟需系统化的冗余检测方法。
AI.method: 构建RedundancyBench基准，包含多样化任务及精细标注的轨迹数据，每个步骤按贡献度标记为冗余或必要。开发并评估3种代表性方法进行冗余步骤检测。
AI.result: 最佳方法在冗余步骤检测上仅达24.88%得分，部分方法表现甚至差于随机猜测，表明任务复杂度高。
AI.conclusion: 冗余步骤检测是一个极具挑战性的新研究方向，现有方法效果有限，亟需进一步研究。
idea_en: Method for detecting redundant steps in LLM agent trajectories by annotating each step's contribution to task completion and training a classifier to distinguish necessary vs redundant actions.
RedundancyBench: A benchmark system for evaluating redundant step detection in multi-step reasoning agents with fine-grained step-level annotations.
Automatic redundant step pruning mechanism for LLM-based agents that identifies and removes low-contribution steps to improve execution efficiency without compromising task success.
idea_ch: 一种基于贡献度标注的LLM智能体轨迹冗余步骤检测方法，通过为每个步骤标注对任务完成的贡献值，训练分类器区分必要步骤与冗余步骤。
RedundancyBench基准测试系统：用于评估多步推理智能体中冗余步骤检测能力的标准化数据集，包含细粒度步骤级标注。
一种面向LLM智能体的自动冗余步骤剪枝机制，通过识别并移除低贡献步骤来提高执行效率，同时保证任务成功率不受影响。

title: On the Geometry of Games and their Solvers
summary: A central challenge in game theory and learning systems such as GANs is understanding which algorithms can efficiently compute equilibria across the heterogeneous landscape of games. Equilibrium computation is typically studied solver by solver and game class by game class, yielding strong local guarantees but a fragmented view of solver behaviour. Existing discrete taxonomies often provide an incomplete account of where algorithms succeed. We study this problem through a solver-game map linking games to effective solver dynamics. Classical theory identifies isolated regions of this map but provides limited insight into intermediate or overlapping regimes, suggesting that solvability is governed by latent structural properties defining a continuous solver-aligned geometry of games. We formalise this perspective through structure-aware solver synthesis. A learned structure recogniser maps each game to a low-dimensional solver-aligned representation, and a policy maps this representation to effective primitive mechanisms, adapting solver behaviour across regimes. This reveals regions where particular solver dynamics are effective and where mixtures of primitives are required rather than a single dominant solver. A bounded residual acts as a local corrector and diagnostic signal for incomplete solver bases or representations. The framework yields both an adaptive solver and an analytical lens: games with similar optimisation dynamics cluster together, revealing continuous regions of algorithmic validity and overlapping solver behaviour. Empirically, we show that fixed primitives exhibit systematic regime mismatch, while the learned representation organises game space into a structured cartography aligned with solver behaviour. These results suggest viewing equilibrium computation as the joint problem of learning solver mechanisms and mapping the geometry of solvability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构感知的求解器综合框架，通过学习一个低维的求解器对齐表示来映射博弈空间，从而将均衡计算视为求解器机制学习与可解性几何映射的联合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈均衡计算方法采用逐个求解器、逐类博弈的研究方式，导致对求解器行为的碎片化理解，缺乏统一的视角来理解算法在不同博弈类型中的有效性和失效模式。
AI.method: 提出结构感知的求解器综合框架：1) 学习结构识别器将博弈映射到低维求解器对齐表示；2) 策略网络将该表示映射到有效的原始机制组合；3) 边界残差作为局部修正器和诊断信号，用于不完整求解器基或表示的补偿。
AI.result: 固定原始机制存在系统性的"机制失配"问题，而学习到的表示将博弈空间组织成与求解器行为对齐的结构化地图，揭示了连续区域的算法有效性和重叠的求解器行为。
AI.conclusion: 将均衡计算重新定义为求解器机制学习与可解性几何映射的联合问题，为理解博弈求解提供了统一的分析视角和自适应求解方法。
idea_en: A structure-aware solver synthesis framework that maps games to a low-dimensional solver-aligned representation space, enabling continuous characterization of solver effectiveness across different game types.
A learned structure recognizer that automatically maps any game to its solver-aligned representation without manual feature engineering.
A policy network that adaptively selects and combines primitive solver mechanisms based on the game's position in the solver-aligned geometry.
A bounded residual corrector mechanism that compensates for incomplete solver bases or representation limitations, serving as both a local fixer and diagnostic signal.
A solver-game cartography method that organizes game space into structured regions with continuous algorithmic validity, revealing overlapping solver behaviors.
idea_ch: 一种结构感知的求解器综合框架，将博弈映射到低维求解器对齐表示空间，实现不同博弈类型中求解器有效性的连续表征
一种学习型结构识别器，无需手动特征工程即可自动将任意博弈映射到其求解器对齐表示
一种策略网络，基于博弈在求解器对齐几何中的位置自适应选择并组合原始求解器机制
一种有界残差校正器机制，用于补偿不完整求解器基或表示局限，同时作为局部修正和诊断信号
一种求解器-博弈地图方法，将博弈空间组织为具有连续算法有效性的结构化区域，揭示求解器行为的重叠模式

title: Toward AI Systems That Understand Self and Others: A Multi-Phase Inference Framework for Human Cognitive Diversity and World-Model Alignment
summary: Mutual misunderstanding in contemporary society does not arise merely because people hold different opinions or values. Even under the same observations, different subjects may form different inferential targets, state representations, prediction errors, and update priorities. This paper proposes a multi-phase inference framework and defines its core internal mechanism as the Multi-Phase Inference Mechanism (MIM). MIM formalizes how heterogeneous world models arise through a phase-formation space, a foregrounding field, subject-specific profile states, and alignment maps between state representations. On this basis, the paper reframes world-model alignment as the problem of making heterogeneous representations mutually processable, rather than forcing agreement or convergence to a single value system. It further connects this formalism to philosophical disagreements, cognitive typology, social fragmentation, and AI alignment. The aim is to provide a constructive vocabulary for AI systems that can help humans understand self and others by making differences in meaning, value, and prediction error visible, comparable, and transformable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多阶段推理框架（MIM），形式化解释不同主体如何基于相同观察产生异质世界模型，并将对齐问题重构为异构表征的互操作性，而非强制趋同。
AI.motivation: 当代社会误解不仅源于不同观点，更源于不同主体对相同观察形成不同推理目标、状态表征、预测误差和更新优先级。现有对齐方法强制趋同或共识，忽略了认知异质性的根本来源。
AI.method: 构建多阶段推理机制（MIM），包括：阶段形成空间（phase-formation space）、前景化场（foregrounding field）、主体特定剖面状态（subject-specific profile states）、状态表征间的对齐映射（alignment maps）。
AI.result: MIM形式化描述了异质世界模型的产生机制，将世界模型对齐重新定义为异构表征的互操作性（mutual processability），而非价值趋同。
AI.conclusion: 为AI系统提供了一套建设性词汇，帮助人类理解自我与他人，使意义、价值和预测误差的差异可视化、可比较、可转化，并连接哲学分歧、认知类型学、社会碎片化和AI对齐问题。
idea_en: Multi-Phase Inference Mechanism (MIM) for formalizing heterogeneous world model generation through phase-formation space, foregrounding field, and subject-specific profile states.
Alignment map method for establishing interoperability between heterogeneous state representations without forcing value convergence.
Foregrounding field technique that dynamically selects which inferential targets are prioritized by different subjects under identical observations.
Subject-specific profile state representation that encodes individualized prediction errors and update priorities for personalized inference.
Framework for making differences in meaning, value, and prediction error visible, comparable, and transformable between AI and human agents.
idea_ch: 多阶段推理机制（MIM）：通过阶段形成空间、前景化场和主体特定剖面状态形式化异质世界模型的生成过程
对齐映射方法：在异构状态表征之间建立互操作性，无需强制价值趋同即可实现跨主体理解
前景化场技术：动态选择不同主体在相同观察条件下优先关注的推理目标，解释认知差异的根源
主体特定剖面状态表示：编码个体化预测误差和更新优先级，实现个性化推理与自适应学习
差异可视化与可转化框架：使AI与人类之间在意义、价值和预测误差上的差异变得可见、可比较、可转化

title: It`s All About Speed: AI`s Impact on Workflow in Music Production
comment: Audio Engineering Society Conference Paper - Presented at the AES International Conference on Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence for Audio 2025 - September 8-10, London, UK
summary: In this paper, we present the results of an ethnographic study into the impact of AI and automated tools on music production workflow. Focusing specifically on professional participants who identified as recording engineers, mixers, and producers, we discuss their usage of common AI and automated software, as well as their sentiments on the proliferation of these tools. We discuss tensions that may be created between users and automated tools in key areas such as the need for speed and efficiency, controllability, and maintaining creative agency, and how these tensions may be alleviated through tool design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过民族志研究，探讨了AI和自动化工具对音乐制作工作流程的影响，重点关注录音工程师、混音师和制作人的使用体验与态度，以及工具设计如何缓解用户与自动化之间的张力。
AI.motivation: 了解AI和自动化工具在音乐制作中的实际影响，以及专业用户在使用这些工具时面临的挑战和需求，为改进工具设计提供依据。
AI.method: 采用民族志研究方法，聚焦于录音工程师、混音师和制作人等专业参与者，分析他们对AI和自动化软件的使用情况及其态度。
AI.result: 发现了用户与自动化工具之间在速度/效率、可控性和创作自主性等关键领域存在的张力，并提出了通过工具设计缓解这些张力的方向。
AI.conclusion: AI和自动化工具虽然在提升效率方面有价值，但需要在设计中更好地平衡用户对速度、可控性和创作自主性的需求，以减少用户与工具之间的冲突。
idea_en: A user-controllable AI music production tool that allows granular adjustment of automation levels for different workflow stages while preserving creative agency.
A speed-efficiency balancing interface for AI mixing tools that provides real-time transparency into automated decisions and user override options.
An interactive AI assistant for recording engineers that dynamically adapts its level of autonomy based on user preference and task complexity.
idea_ch: 一种用户可控的AI音乐制作工具，允许针对不同工作流阶段精细调整自动化程度，同时保留创作自主权。
一种面向AI混音工具的速度-效率平衡界面，可实时透明展示自动决策并提供用户覆盖选项。
一种面向录音工程师的交互式AI助手，能够根据用户偏好和任务复杂度动态调整其自主程度。

title: Make LLM Learn to Synthesize from Streaming Experiences through Feedback
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted for synthetic data generation, significantly reducing annotation costs. However, most existing studies treat synthesis as a set of isolated tasks and overlook a more fundamental question: whether a model can learn to synthesize by accumulating experience from past tasks and transferring it to future ones. In this work, we introduce StreamSynth, a new setting in which synthesis tasks arrive sequentially and experience from historical tasks provides informative signals for future synthesis. To address this setting, we propose SynLearner, a general framework that enables synthesis models to acquire reusable synthesis experience over a task stream. Instead of generating data independently for each task, SynLearner encourages the model to explore diverse synthesis patterns, learn from feedback, and balance sample quality with set-level diversity as tasks evolve. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SynLearner effectively leverages experience from earlier tasks to improve synthesis performance on later ones, exhibiting consistent cross-task transferability. These findings provide evidence for the feasibility of StreamSynth and highlight synthetic data generation as an experience-driven process that can benefit from task streams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StreamSynth新范式，让合成数据生成模型在任务流中积累经验并迁移到未来任务，提出SynLearner框架实现跨任务可迁移的合成学习。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将合成数据生成视为孤立任务，忽略了模型能否从过去任务中积累经验并迁移到未来任务这一根本问题。
AI.method: 提出SynLearner框架：1) 探索多样化合成模式；2) 从反馈中学习；3) 在任务演进中平衡样本质量与集合级多样性。
AI.result: 实验表明SynLearner有效利用早期任务经验提升后期任务合成性能，展现出一致的跨任务可转移性。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据生成可以是一个经验驱动过程，能够从任务流中获益。
idea_en: A method for sequential synthetic data generation where a model accumulates reusable synthesis experience from historical tasks and transfers it to future tasks in a task stream.
A framework (SynLearner) that enables synthesis models to explore diverse synthesis patterns, learn from feedback, and balance sample quality with set-level diversity across sequential tasks.
A cross-task transferability mechanism for synthetic data generation that leverages experience from earlier tasks to improve synthesis performance on later tasks.
idea_ch: 一种序列化合成数据生成方法，模型在任务流中从历史任务积累可复用的合成经验并将其迁移到未来任务。
一种名为SynLearner的框架，使合成模型能够在序列任务中探索多样化合成模式、从反馈中学习，并平衡样本质量与集合级多样性。
一种用于合成数据生成的跨任务可迁移机制，利用早期任务的经验来提升后续任务的合成性能。

title: MuPHI: Learning Implicit Multimodal Harm Reasoning via Semantically Grounded Reward Optimization
summary: Understanding how harm emerges from interaction between otherwise benign image-text pairs requires intent-aware cross-modal reasoning beyond surface-level features. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) excel at literal reasoning over perceptual cues but often fail to derive harmful semantics that rely on implicit, context-dependent reasoning. To evaluate VLMs on compositional harm detection and reasoning, we introduce Multimodal Pragmatic Harm Interpretation (MuPHI), a dataset containing image-text pairs where harm is encoded in subtle multimodal cues. MuPHI spans diverse harm categories and includes annotated harm rationales for assessing VLM reasoning chains. To improve both detection and reasoning in VLMs, we propose MuPHIRM, a reasoning-augmented training framework which learns joint semantics by optimizing multi-perspective rewards. MuPHIRM improves both harm detection and reasoning quality of VLMs while demonstrating superior out-of-distribution robustness compared to both trained and inference-time baselines. Our findings suggest that reasoning-oriented reward optimization offers a promising direction towards building multimodal systems that generalize beyond benchmark-specific shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MuPHI数据集和MuPHIRM框架，用于评估和提升视觉语言模型在多模态隐含危害检测与推理中的能力，通过多视角奖励优化实现更好的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型擅长基于表面特征的字面推理，但在理解跨模态交互中隐含、依赖上下文的危害语义方面表现不佳，需要能够进行意图感知的跨模态推理。
AI.method: 构建MuPHI数据集（包含图像-文本对、危害类别标注和推理链注释）；提出MuPHIRM推理增强训练框架，通过多视角奖励优化学习联合语义。
AI.result: MuPHIRM在危害检测和推理质量上均优于现有方法和基线，且在分布外场景下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 面向推理的奖励优化是构建超越基准捷径、实现更泛化的多模态系统的有效方向。
idea_en: A multi-perspective reward optimization framework (MuPHIRM) for training vision-language models that learns joint semantics by simultaneously optimizing multiple reward signals, enabling detection of harmful content embedded across benign-looking image-text pairs.

A multimodal pragmatic harm interpretation dataset (MuPHI) comprising image-text pairs where harm is encoded in subtle, context-dependent multimodal cues, with annotated harm rationales serving as ground truth for evaluating reasoning chains of VLMs.

A compositional harm detection and reasoning method that combines perceptual feature extraction with implicit cross-modal reasoning, going beyond surface-level cues to capture intent-aware harmful semantics.
idea_ch: 一种多视角奖励优化训练框架（MuPHIRM），通过同时优化多个奖励信号来学习联合语义，使视觉语言模型能够检测看似良性的图像-文本对中潜藏的危害内容。
一种多模态语用危害解释数据集（MuPHI），包含通过微妙、依赖上下文的跨模态线索编码危害信息的图像-文本对，并带有注释的危害推理链，用于评估VLM的推理过程。
一种组合式危害检测与推理方法，结合感知特征提取与隐式跨模态推理，超越表面线索以捕捉意图感知的危害语义。

title: Formalizing Mathematics at Scale
summary: We present AutoformBot, a multi-agent system for building an Autoformalized Textbook Library At Scale (Atlas) in Lean 4. AutoformBot orchestrates thousands of LLM agents, equipped with formal verification tools, dependency-aware task scheduling, and collaborative version control, to translate informal textbook prose into machine-checked definitions and proofs. We apply our methods to a corpus of 26 open-access textbooks spanning analysis, algebra, topology, combinatorics, and probability, producing Atlas: a verified library of over 45,000 Lean 4 declarations and 500 thousand lines of code. We release two artifacts: (i) AutoformBot, the open-source multi-agent framework; and (ii) Atlas, the resulting formal library. Our results suggest that autoformalizing the core content of graduate-level mathematics at scale is now economically and technically feasible. This opens the door to the automated verification of both human- and machine-generated mathematics at a research level.

AI.tldr: AutoformBot是一个多智能体系统，利用数千个LLM代理、形式化验证工具和依赖感知任务调度，在Lean 4中自动化地将26本研究生级教科书（45,000+声明，50万行代码）形式化为机器可验证的定理库Atlas。
AI.motivation: 当前手工形式化数学证明成本极高且速度缓慢，无法覆盖大规模教科书内容。需要一种自动化方案来实现大规模教科书内容的形式化验证。
AI.method: 采用多智能体系统AutoformBot，集成数千个LLM代理，配备形式化验证工具、依赖感知任务调度和协同版本控制，实现从自然语言教科书到Lean 4代码的自动化翻译。
AI.result: 成功形式化了26本开放教科书，覆盖分析、代数、拓扑、组合学和概率论，生成了包含45,000+ Lean 4声明和50万行代码的Atlas库。
AI.conclusion: 大规模自动化形式化研究生级数学核心内容在经济和技术上都是可行的，为人造和机器生成的数学研究的自动化验证开辟了道路。
idea_en: A multi-agent system architecture that orchestrates thousands of LLM agents with formal verification tools for automated theorem proving at scale
Dependency-aware task scheduling method for automatically decomposing and parallelizing formalization of textbook content
Collaborative version control framework integrating formal verification feedback into LLM-driven code generation pipeline
Automated pipeline converting natural language mathematical prose to machine-checked Lean 4 definitions and proofs
idea_ch: 一种协调数千个LLM代理与形式化验证工具的多智能体系统架构，用于大规模自动定理证明
基于依赖感知的任务调度方法，自动分解和并行化教科书内容的形式化过程
协同版本控制框架，将形式化验证反馈集成到LLM驱动的代码生成流水线中
将自然语言数学文本自动转换为机器可验证的Lean 4定义和证明的自动化流水线

title: Meta-Programming for Linear-time Temporal Answer Set Programming
summary: The development of temporal extensions of Answer Set Programming (ASP) has led to the emergence of non-monotonic linear-time (TEL), dynamic (DEL), and metric (MEL) temporal equilibrium logics. However, the inherent rigidity of highly optimized ASP systems often hinders the rapid exploration and implementation of alternative logical designs. In this work, we propose a flexible meta-programming framework that operationalizes the semantics of varied temporal logics through a unified, declarative framework. Our approach extends standard ASP meta-programming by augmenting clingo's theory grammar with formal type specifications and nesting capabilities. To ensure semantic correctness, we introduce a transformation pipeline that protects nested modalities from stable-model-based simplifications during grounding. We demonstrate the extensibility of our framework by implementing meta-encodings for TEL, MEL, and DEL. We provide a comprehensive account of TEL and highlight the key features for managing the interval constraints of MEL and the Fischer-Ladner closure in DEL. Finally, we introduce the metasp system, a versatile tool that encapsulates this workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种灵活的元编程框架，通过扩展clingo的理论语法，统一实现了多种时间逻辑（TEL、MEL、DEL）的语义，并开发了metasp系统作为封装工具。
AI.motivation: 高度优化的ASP系统（如clingo）在支持不同时间逻辑设计时缺乏灵活性，难以快速探索和实现替代逻辑设计。
AI.method: 扩展标准ASP元编程，通过为clingo的理论语法增加形式化类型规范和嵌套能力；引入转换管道保护嵌套模态在接地过程中免受稳定模型简化影响；为TEL、MEL、DEL分别实现元编码。
AI.result: 成功实现了一个统一的元编程框架，能够灵活表达TEL、MEL和DEL的语义，并开发了metasp系统验证了该工作流的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的元编程框架为探索和实现不同时间逻辑设计提供了灵活高效的替代方案，降低了系统实现的门槛。
idea_en: A meta-programming framework for ASP that operationalizes temporal, dynamic, and metric temporal equilibrium logics through a unified declarative approach by extending clingo's theory grammar with formal type specifications and nesting capabilities.
A transformation pipeline that protects nested modalities from stable-model-based simplifications during grounding, ensuring semantic correctness in temporal ASP meta-encodings.
The metasp system: a versatile tool that encapsulates the meta-programming workflow for non-monotonic linear-time (TEL), dynamic (DEL), and metric (MEL) temporal equilibrium logics.
idea_ch: 一种扩展clingo理论语法、增加形式化类型规范和嵌套能力的ASP元编程框架，用于统一声明式实现时间、动态和度量时间均衡逻辑。
一种转换管道方法，在接地过程中保护嵌套模态免受稳定模型简化影响，确保时间ASP元编码的语义正确性。
metasp系统：一种封装了非单调线性时间(TEL)、动态(DEL)和度量时间(MEL)均衡逻辑元编程工作流的多功能工具。

title: Compass: Navigating Global Marine Lead Data Integration through Expert-Guided LLM Agent
summary: Marine lead (Pb) and its isotopes are critical tracers for ocean circulation and anthropogenic pollution, yet in-situ observations remain costly and sparse. While vast historical records exist, they lie buried within the unstructured content of academic papers, creating "data silos" inaccessible to comprehensive analysis. Manual extraction is unscalable, while general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) lack the necessary domain-specific knowledge, leading to hallucinations and scientifically invalid outputs. To address this, we introduce an expert-guided adaptation approach that enables LLMs to perform rigorous scientific data extraction without fine-tuning.
