We operationalize this approach through Compass, an LLM agent framework enhanced by a Knowledge Tree co-designed with marine scientists, which decomposes complex tasks into verifiable steps, guiding the agent's reasoning to ensure scientific validity. Deploying Compass across a corpus of over 230,000 relevant open-access papers, we successfully extract 3,751 previously unincorporated Pb records. This effort establishes the largest integrated marine Pb database to date. Beyond standard metrics, Compass demonstrates superior reliability through multi-layered validation, achieving 92% accuracy as confirmed through expert manual verification. The newly integrated data expand coverage in previously under-sampled regions such as the East China Sea and the Southern Ocean, providing an enriched data foundation for future scientific discoveries. We release an interactive visualization platform to facilitate open scientific access. Our work demonstrates that expert-guided agents can effectively bridge the gap between general-purpose LLMs and high-stakes scientific domains, enabling scalable data discovery in geosciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种专家引导的LLM智能体框架Compass，通过知识树分解复杂任务，从23万篇海洋学论文中提取了3751条历史铅同位素数据，构建了最大的海洋铅数据库，准确率达92%。
AI.motivation: 海洋铅及其同位素是重要的海洋环流和人为污染示踪剂，但实地观测成本高、数据稀疏。大量历史数据埋藏在学术论文的非结构化文本中形成"数据孤岛"，手动提取不可扩展，通用大语言模型因缺乏领域知识而产生幻觉和无效输出。
AI.method: 提出专家引导的LLM适配方法Compass框架：1) 与海洋科学家共同设计知识树(Knowledge Tree)，将复杂数据提取任务分解为可验证的子步骤；2) 利用知识树引导LLM智能体的推理过程，确保科学有效性；3) 无需微调即可进行严格的科学数据提取；4) 多层验证机制确保数据质量。
AI.result: 从23万篇开放获取论文中成功提取了3751条此前未纳入数据库的铅记录，建立了迄今为止最大的综合海洋铅数据库；经专家人工验证准确率达92%；新数据集扩展了东海、南大洋等先前采样不足区域的覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: 专家引导的智能体方法能够有效弥合通用大语言模型与高风险科学领域之间的鸿沟，实现地球科学领域的数据可扩展发现。同时发布了交互式可视化平台以促进开放科学访问。
idea_en: An expert-guided LLM agent framework (Compass) enhanced by a Knowledge Tree that decomposes complex scientific data extraction tasks into verifiable reasoning steps for domain-specific accuracy.
A method for extracting structured scientific data from unstructured academic paper corpus using LLMs without fine-tuning, guided by domain-expert co-designed knowledge structures.
A multi-layered validation pipeline for LLM-extracted scientific data achieving 92% expert-verified accuracy in marine geochemistry data extraction.
An interactive visualization platform for integrated marine lead isotope database enabling open scientific access and exploration.
A Knowledge Tree co-design methodology where domain scientists and AI engineers collaboratively structure domain knowledge to guide LLM reasoning in high-stakes scientific domains.
idea_ch: 一种基于知识树增强的专家引导型LLM智能体框架Compass，将复杂科学数据提取任务分解为可验证的推理步骤，确保领域特异性准确度。
一种无需微调即可利用LLM从非结构化学术论文语料中提取结构化科学数据的方法，由领域专家共同设计知识结构引导提取过程。
针对LLM提取科学数据的多层验证流水线，在海洋地球化学数据提取中实现92%的专家验证准确率。
用于综合海洋铅同位素数据库的交互式可视化平台，促进开放科学访问和探索。
一种知识树协同设计方法，领域科学家与AI工程师共同构建领域知识结构以引导LLM在高风险科学领域的推理过程。

title: Accelerating Constrained Decoding with Token Space Compression
comment: 13 pages; 5 figures; under review at EMNLP 2026
summary: To guarantee that an LLM's outputs conform to a specified structure, context-free grammar (CFG) decoding engines force the selection of next tokens that produce strings that conform to a given CFG. While current CFG-constrained decoding engines are highly optimized, the inherent costs arising from the massive per-step search space -- i.e. the entire token vocabulary -- result in intractably high overhead for more complex CFGs: precisely the situation where CFG engines are most useful. In this paper, we introduce CFGzip, an offline technique for compressing the token search space, which massively reduces CFG engine overhead. In experiments, we report latency reduction of up to two orders of magnitude when CFGzip is used with a SoTA grammar engine, yielding an up to 7.5x speedup in total constrained generation time: with CFGzip, constrained decoding is now feasible at scale for complex CFGs.

AI.tldr: 提出CFGzip离线压缩技术，通过压缩令牌搜索空间大幅降低CFG约束解码的延迟，实现最高两个数量级的耗时减少和7.5倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有CFG约束解码引擎面对复杂CFG时，由于每一步需要在整个词表空间中搜索，导致开销巨大，限制了复杂CFG的大规模应用。
AI.method: 提出CFGzip，一种离线压缩令牌搜索空间的技术，通过预处理减少解码时每一步需要考虑的候选令牌数量。
AI.result: 配合最先进的语法引擎使用时，延迟降低最高达两个数量级，总约束生成时间加速最高7.5倍。
AI.conclusion: CFGzip使复杂CFG的约束解码在大规模场景下变得可行。
idea_en: Offline compression technique for token search space in CFG-constrained LLM decoding, reducing per-step vocabulary to only valid tokens
Method to pre-compute and cache valid token subsets for each grammar state before runtime decoding
Integration of compressed search space with existing CFG decoding engines to achieve order-of-magnitude speedup
idea_ch: 一种用于CFG约束LLM解码的离线令牌搜索空间压缩技术，将每步搜索的词表缩减为仅包含合法令牌
在运行时解码之前，预先计算并缓存每个语法状态对应的合法令牌子集的方法
将压缩后的搜索空间与现有CFG解码引擎集成，实现数量级加速的方案

title: Cookie-Bench: Continuous On-screen Key Interaction Evaluation for Web Generation
summary: Front-end web code has become a core product surface for every frontier LLM release, yet evaluating these interactive applications at development speed remains costly because human-judged leaderboards like Arena do not scale. Existing automated proxies typically lean on reference implementations, test suites, or rigid checklists, and tend to miss the reasoned synthesis a human reviewer performs over a live session. We articulate a new evaluation regime that is simultaneously reference-free, autonomously driven, and holistically reasoned, and instantiate it through two artifacts. \textbf{\dataname} is an 11-domain, 54-leaf, 1,000-query WebDev benchmark spanning both static-presentation and interactive-application tasks, balanced across three difficulty tiers and three target-language groups, with briefs rewritten to resist recall from circulated prompts. \textbf{\framename}, grounded in Flavell's metacognitive monitoring, separates evidence accumulation from judgment across three stages: Static Perception forms a first impression from passive observation; Agent-Driven Interaction explores the application autonomously while capturing continuous screen video, audio, and per-step screenshots; Dynamic Scoring issues holistic functionality and aesthetics verdicts with structured failure attribution only after the evidence chain is complete. On \dataname, \framename aligns closely with expert human ratings while surfacing substantial headroom across 13 frontier LLMs on interactive web generation. \noindenthttps://anonymous.4open.science/r/Cookie-3CE/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个无参考、自主驱动、整体推理的Web前端代码评估框架，包含WebDev基准数据集和基于元认知监控的三阶段评估方法，能更好地对齐人类专家评分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成的Web前端代码评估依赖人工排行榜（如Arena）成本高，而自动化代理通常需要参考实现、测试套件或固定检查表，缺乏人类评审者在实时会话中的推理综合能力。
AI.method: 提出了WebDev基准数据集（11个领域、54个叶子节点、1000个查询）和基于Flavell元认知监控的评估框架，包含静态感知、智能体驱动交互、动态评分三个阶段，将证据收集与评判分离。
AI.result: 该评估框架与人类专家评分高度一致，并揭示了13个前沿LLM在交互式Web生成方面的显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无参考、自主驱动的评估范式能够以开发速度有效评估LLM生成的Web前端代码，弥补了人工评估和现有自动化代理之间的差距。
idea_en: A metacognitive monitoring-based three-stage evaluation framework for LLM-generated web code that separates evidence accumulation from judgment, including static perception, agent-driven autonomous interaction, and dynamic holistic scoring.
A reference-free evaluation method that uses autonomous agent exploration to capture continuous screen video, audio, and per-step screenshots for holistic functionality and aesthetics assessment.
A WebDev benchmark dataset with 11 domains and 1,000 queries, featuring rewritten briefs to resist recall from circulated prompts, balanced across difficulty tiers and target languages.
A structured failure attribution mechanism that issues holistic functionality and aesthetics verdicts only after a complete evidence chain is established.
idea_ch: 基于元认知监控的三阶段Web代码评估框架，将证据收集与评判分离，包括静态感知（第一印象）、智能体自主驱动交互（持续屏幕视频/音频/截图捕获）和动态整体评分。
无参考的自动化评估方法，通过自主智能体探索Web应用，捕获连续屏幕视频、音频和每步截图，进行整体功能和美学评判。
包含11个领域、1000个查询的WebDev基准数据集，使用重写的需求描述以防止模型从公开提示中记忆，并在难度层级和目标语言组间均衡分布。
结构化失败归因机制，仅在完整证据链建立后才发布整体功能和美学判定结果。

title: KairosAgent: Agentic Time Series Forecasting with Fused Semantic Reasoning
summary: Cross-domain multimodal time series forecasting is a challenging task, requiring models to integrate precise numerical comprehension, cross-domain semantic understanding, and effective multimodal fusion. Existing approaches either build Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) from scratch or leverage pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs). However, TSFMs often overlook semantic understanding and lack the ability to perform future-oriented semantic reasoning, and LLMs struggle with numerical comprehension and accurate quantitative forecasting. To overcome these limitations, we propose KairosAgent, a novel agentic framework for multimodal time series forecasting, including an LLM-based reasoner and a TSFM-based forecaster. KairosAgent unifies textual reasoning and numerical forecasting by dynamically invoking analytical tools to enhance the numerical understanding and semantic reasoning capabilities of LLMs. The reasoning results are subsequently fused into the TSFM pipeline, enabling more accurate and reliable future predictions. To further improve the reasoning, we curate a large-scale corpus of high-quality trajectories, alongside a reinforcement learning from forecasting paradigm with multi-turn refinement and turn-level credit assignment. Experiments demonstrate that KairosAgent achieves superior zero-shot forecasting performance while maximizing the utility of pretrained LLMs and TSFMs, presenting a promising direction for efficient and interpretable time series agents. The project page is at https://foundation-model-research.github.io/KairosAgent .

AI.tldr: KairosAgent是一个结合LLM推理器与TSFM预测器的智能体框架，通过动态调用分析工具、强化学习与多轮优化，实现跨模态时间序列的零样本预测，克服了纯TSFM缺乏语义理解与纯LLM数值预测不准的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态时间序列预测方法要么从头构建时间序列基础模型（TSFMs），要么利用预训练大语言模型（LLMs），但TSFMs缺乏语义理解与未来语义推理能力，LLMs则数值理解与精确量化预测能力不足。
AI.method: 提出KairosAgent智能体框架，包含LLM推理器与TSFM预测器：通过动态调用分析工具增强LLM的数值理解与语义推理，推理结果融合到TSFM管道中；构建大规模高质量轨迹语料库，采用基于强化学习的预测范式，支持多轮细化与回合级信用分配训练。
AI.result: 实验表明KairosAgent在零样本预测任务上表现优越，最大化利用了预训练LLM与TSFM的能力。
AI.conclusion: KairosAgent为高效、可解释的时间序列智能体提供了有前景的方向，统一了文本推理与数值预测。
idea_en: An agentic framework for multimodal time series forecasting that combines an LLM-based semantic reasoner with a TSFM-based numerical forecaster, integrating analytical tool invocation to enhance numerical comprehension and semantic reasoning.
A reinforcement learning from forecasting paradigm with multi-turn refinement and turn-level credit assignment for training time series forecasting agents using high-quality trajectory corpora.
A dynamic analytical tool invocation mechanism that bridges LLM textual reasoning with TSFM numerical prediction pipeline, enabling cross-domain semantic reasoning fused into numerical forecasting.
A method for curating large-scale high-quality reasoning trajectory corpora specifically designed for training multimodal time series forecasting agents with improved semantic-numerical alignment.
idea_ch: 一种结合LLM语义推理器与TSFM数值预测器的多模态时间序列预测智能体框架，通过动态调用分析工具增强数值理解与语义推理能力。
一种基于强化学习的预测范式，支持多轮细化与回合级信用分配，用于训练时间序列预测智能体。
一种动态分析工具调用机制，将LLM的文本推理与TSFM的数值预测管道桥梁式融合，实现跨域语义推理与数值预测的结合。
一种大规模高质量推理轨迹语料库的构建方法，专门用于训练多模态时间序列预测智能体，改善语义与数值的对齐能力。

title: From GPS Points to Travel Patterns: Flexible and Semantic Trajectory Generation with LLMs
comment: This paper is accepted by KDD2026 second round
summary: Urban trajectories play a crucial role in modeling urban dynamics and supporting various smart city applications. However, privacy concerns restrict access to large-scale and high-quality trajectory datasets. Trajectory generation provides a promising alternative by synthesizing realistic data to mitigate privacy risks. However, existing methods fail to explicitly capture travel patterns and can only generate fixed-length trajectories under a single condition. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{HTP}, which \textbf{H}ierarchically generates \textbf{T}ravel patterns first and then generates GPS \textbf{P}oints by using large language models (LLMs), rather than directly generating GPS points. We first design a trajectory-specific residual quantization variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) that quantizes micro-level GPS trajectories into compact, macro-level travel pattern tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner. These tokens capture rich segment spatial irregularities, such as point density variations caused by traffic conditions. Then, we extend the LLM vocabulary with travel pattern tokens to align trajectory representations with the LLM input, and apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to align the LLM with the trajectory generation task, enabling generation of travel pattern sequences under various conditions. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets show that HTP outperforms the strongest baseline by an average of 29.78\% in terms of generation quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/slzhou-xy/HTP.

AI.tldr: HTP是一种分层轨迹生成方法，先通过RQ-VAE将GPS轨迹量化为宏观出行模式令牌，再用大语言模型（LLM）生成这些模式令牌序列，最后解码为GPS点，解决了现有方法无法显式捕捉出行模式、只能生成固定长度单条件轨迹的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹生成方法无法显式捕捉出行模式（如点密度变化等空间不规则性），且只能生成固定长度、单一条件下的轨迹，缺乏灵活性和条件可控性。
AI.method: 1) 设计轨迹专用的残差量化变分自编码器（RQ-VAE），将微观GPS轨迹从粗到细量化为宏观出行模式令牌，捕获段级空间不规则性。2) 扩展LLM词汇表加入出行模式令牌，通过监督微调(SFT)使LLM对齐轨迹生成任务，实现多条件下的出行模式序列生成。
AI.result: 在两个真实数据集上，HTP在生成质量上比最强基线平均提升29.78%。
AI.conclusion: 分层生成出行模式再生成GPS点的范式，结合RQ-VAE量化与LLM微调，能显著提升轨迹生成的质量和条件可控性。
idea_en: Hierarchical trajectory generation method: first generate travel pattern tokens via RQ-VAE quantization, then decode to GPS points using LLM, enabling variable-length and multi-condition trajectory generation.

Trajectory-specific residual quantization variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) that quantizes micro-level GPS trajectories into compact macro-level travel pattern tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, capturing segment spatial irregularities like point density variations.

Extending LLM vocabulary with travel pattern tokens to align trajectory representations, combined with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for conditional trajectory pattern sequence generation under various conditions.
idea_ch: 分层轨迹生成方法：先通过RQ-VAE量化生成出行模式令牌，再利用大语言模型解码为GPS点，支持可变长度和多条件轨迹生成。
轨迹专用残差量化变分自编码器（RQ-VAE）：将微观GPS轨迹以从粗到细的方式量化为紧凑的宏观出行模式令牌，捕获段级空间不规则性（如交通状况引起的点密度变化）。
扩展大语言模型词汇表加入出行模式令牌，结合监督微调（SFT）使LLM对齐轨迹生成任务，实现多种条件下的出行模式序列生成。

title: RAISE: RAG Design as an Architecture Search Problem
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems expose numerous design choices spanning query rewriting, chunking, retrieval depth, reranking, and context compression. In practice, these choices are often configured through heuristics, hindering systematic evaluation and reproducibility across settings. We argue that this challenge is best formulated as RAG architecture search. To support controlled and reproducible study of this problem, we introduce the RAG Intelligence Search Engine (RAISE), a comprehensive framework and benchmark for RAG hyperparameter optimization, which evaluates optimization methods for RAG pipelines under standardized search spaces and budgets. RAISE implements 13 search algorithms and evaluates them across seven public text and multimodal datasets using three random seeds. Our experiments show that optimization performance is highly task-dependent: methods that perform strongly on one dataset may not generalize consistently across others, cautioning against interpreting aggregate rankings as evidence of universally superior strategies. RAISE provides a common experimental substrate for fair, reproducible, and systematic research on RAG hyperparameter optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RAG架构搜索问题，并构建了RAISE框架，用于系统评估RAG流水线中13种超参数优化算法在7个数据集上的表现，发现优化性能高度依赖于具体任务。
AI.motivation: RAG系统存在大量设计选择（查询重写、分块、检索深度、重排序、上下文压缩等），目前这些选择通常依赖启发式配置，阻碍了系统性评估和可复现性。
AI.method: 将RAG配置挑战形式化为架构搜索问题，构建RAISE框架，实现13种搜索算法，在7个文本和多模态数据集上、3个随机种子下进行标准化搜索空间和预算内的评估。
AI.result: 优化性能高度任务依赖：在某数据集上表现优异的方法不一定能泛化到其他数据集，提示不应将聚合排名视为通用策略的证据。
AI.conclusion: RAISE为公平、可复现、系统化的RAG超参数优化研究提供了通用实验基础。
idea_en: A systematic RAG architecture search framework that formalizes hyperparameter optimization as a search problem over query rewriting, chunking, retrieval depth, reranking, and context compression.
A standardized benchmark with 13 search algorithms evaluated across 7 diverse datasets (text and multimodal) for fair comparison of RAG pipeline optimization methods.
A method for identifying task-dependent optimization performance that prevents misleading aggregate rankings from being interpreted as universally superior strategies.
A reproducible experimental substrate with controlled search spaces and budgets for evaluating RAG hyperparameter optimization methods.
idea_ch: 一种系统化的RAG架构搜索框架，将超参数优化形式化为对查询重写、分块、检索深度、重排序和上下文压缩的搜索问题
一种标准化基准，包含13种搜索算法，在7个多样化数据集（文本和多模态）上评估，用于公平比较RAG流水线优化方法
一种识别任务依赖性优化性能的方法，防止将聚合排名误解为普遍优越策略
一种具有受控搜索空间和预算的可复现实验基底，用于评估RAG超参数优化方法

title: Teaching Values to Machines: Simulating Human-Like Behavior in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate a remarkable capacity to adopt different personas and roles; however, it remains unclear whether they can manifest behavior that adheres to a coherent, human-like value structure. In this work, we draw on established psychological value theory to induce human-like values in LLMs and assess their alignment with patterns observed in human studies. Using validated psychological questionnaires, we conduct large-scale experiments -- over 5 million questions -- to evaluate value structures and value-behavior relationships in leading LLMs and compare them to humans. Our findings reveal strong agreement between value-prompted LLMs and humans across both dimensions. Moreover, incorporating human value distributions enhances population-level simulations with value-induced LLMs. These findings highlight the potential of value-induced LLMs as effective, psychologically grounded tools for simulating human behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验（500万+问题）研究LLM能否通过价值诱导展现与人类一致的价值结构，发现价值提示的LLM在价值结构和价值-行为关系上与人类高度一致，且融入人类价值分布可增强群体模拟效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能扮演不同角色，但能否表现出连贯的、类似人类的价值结构尚不清楚，需要系统验证。
AI.method: 基于心理学价值理论，使用验证过的心理问卷，对主流LLM进行超过500万问题的大规模实验，评估价值结构和价值-行为关系，并与人类数据对比。
AI.result: 价值提示后的LLM在价值结构维度和价值-行为关系上与人类高度一致；融入人类价值分布可显著提升群体模拟效果。
AI.conclusion: 价值诱导的LLM可作为有效的、有心理学依据的人类行为模拟工具。
idea_en: A method for inducing human-like value structures in LLMs using established psychological value theory and validated questionnaires.
A system for population-level human behavior simulation using value-induced LLMs with integrated human value distribution data.
A technique for assessing value-behavior alignment in LLMs by comparing with human psychological survey patterns.
A framework for generating coherent persona-specific responses in LLMs based on psychological value dimensions.
idea_ch: 基于心理学价值理论对LLM进行人类价值结构诱导的方法，利用经过验证的心理问卷实现价值对齐。
融合人类价值分布数据的LLM群体行为模拟系统，用于人口级别的仿真分析。
通过对比人类心理调查模式来评估LLM价值-行为对齐程度的技术。
基于心理学价值维度在LLM中生成连贯且符合特定角色特征的回复框架。

title: Domain-Specific Data Synthesis for LLMs via Minimal Sufficient Representation Learning
summary: Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable progress in general-purpose capabilities and can achieve strong performance in specific domains through fine-tuning on domain-specific data. However, acquiring high-quality data for target domains remains a significant challenge. Existing data synthesis approaches follow a deductive paradigm, heavily relying on explicit domain descriptions expressed in natural language and careful prompt engineering, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where domains are difficult to describe or formally articulate. In this work, we tackle the underexplored problem of domain-specific data synthesis through an inductive paradigm, where the target domain is defined only through a set of reference examples, particularly when domain characteristics are difficult to articulate in natural language. We propose a novel framework, DOMINO, that learns a minimal sufficient domain representation from reference samples and leverages it to guide the generation of domain-aligned synthetic data. DOMINO integrates prompt tuning with a contrastive disentanglement objective to separate domain-level patterns from sample-specific noise, mitigating overfitting while preserving core domain characteristics. Theoretically, we prove that DOMINO expands the support of the synthetic data distribution, ensuring greater diversity. Empirically, on challenging coding benchmarks where domain definitions are implicit, fine-tuning on data synthesized by DOMINO improves Pass@1 accuracy by up to 4.63\% over strong, instruction-tuned backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness. This work establishes a new paradigm for domain-specific data synthesis, enabling practical and scalable domain adaptation without manual prompt design or natural language domain specifications.

AI.tldr: 提出了DOMINO框架，通过归纳范式从参考样本中学习领域表征，无需自然语言描述即可生成领域对齐的合成数据，显著提升代码生成任务的Pass@1准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有数据合成方法依赖自然语言描述的演绎范式，在难以用语言描述的真实领域场景中适用性有限。需要一种无需显式领域描述、仅通过参考示例就能生成高质量领域特定数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出DOMINO框架：1) 从参考样本中学习最小充分领域表征；2) 结合提示调优(prompt tuning)与对比解耦目标(contrastive disentanglement objective)；3) 分离领域级模式与样本特定噪声，防止过拟合同时保留核心领域特征。
AI.result: 在隐式领域定义的代码基准测试中，DOMINO合成数据微调后Pass@1准确率提升高达4.63%，超过了强大的指令微调基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 建立了领域特定数据合成的新范式，无需手动提示工程或自然语言领域规范即可实现实用且可扩展的领域自适应。
idea_en: A method for domain-specific data synthesis using an inductive paradigm where the target domain is defined solely through reference examples without requiring natural language descriptions.
A contrastive disentanglement objective for separating domain-level patterns from sample-specific noise in data synthesis.
A prompt tuning framework integrated with minimal sufficient domain representation learning for generating domain-aligned synthetic data.
A technique for expanding the support of synthetic data distribution to ensure greater diversity while preserving core domain characteristics.
A system for implicit domain adaptation in code generation tasks that improves Pass@1 accuracy without manual prompt engineering.
idea_ch: 一种基于归纳范式的领域特定数据合成方法，仅通过参考示例定义目标领域，无需自然语言描述。
一种对比解耦目标函数，用于在数据合成中分离领域级模式与样本特定噪声。
一种集成提示调优与最小充分领域表征学习的框架，用于生成领域对齐的合成数据。
一种扩展合成数据分布支撑集的技术，在保留核心领域特征的同时确保更高的多样性。
一种用于代码生成任务的隐式领域自适应系统，在无需手动提示工程的情况下提升Pass@1准确率。

title: Learning to Choose: An Empowerment-Guided Multi-Agent System with semantic communication for Adaptive Method Selection
summary: Automating scientific computing workflows requires more than generating executable code: autonomous systems must also select appropriate computational strategies, implement them faithfully, and ensure that the resulting outcomes remain causally attributable to the decisions that produced them. In multi-agent pipelines, this process is particularly fragile, as small inconsistencies between agent intentions and actions can lead to semantic drift, where the eventually executed procedure no longer reflects the originally selected strategy, thereby corrupting downstream evaluation and adaptation. In this work, motivated by the ATHENA framework (Toscano et al., 2025; Toscano et al., 2026) and the concept of empowerment (Yiu et al., 2025), we introduce a multi-agent framework that combines contextual bandits with structured inter-agent communication and, most importantly, semantic checkpoints that preserve action-outcome fidelity throughout the pipeline. The system integrates specialized large language model (LLM) agents, grounded code generation, and self-healing execution loops within an adaptive decision-making architecture. Interpreting the framework through the lens of empowerment, we show that reliable autonomous learning requires not only identifying high-quality actions, but also preserving the integrity of their propagation across agents. Using sensitivity analysis and uncertainty quantification workflows as representative case studies, we demonstrate that unchecked semantic drift degrades policy learning, whereas the proposed framework improves convergence, robustness, and adaptation to novel problem contexts. These results suggest a broader design principle for scientific multi-agent systems: adaptive decision-making must be coupled with explicit mechanisms that guarantee semantic consistency and reliable information flow across the computational pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体框架，结合上下文强化学习、结构化智能体间通信和语义检查点，以解决科学计算工作流中的语义漂移问题，确保决策-执行一致性，并通过敏感性分析与不确定性量化案例验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体科学计算管线中，智能体意图与执行动作之间的小不一致会累积为语义漂移，导致最终执行过程偏离原始选择的策略，进而破坏下游评估与自适应学习。现有方法缺乏保证跨智能体传播因果归因性和语义一致性的机制。
AI.method: 提出了一个集成框架：(1) 上下文强化学习用于自适应决策；(2) 结构化智能体间通信以对齐语义；(3) 语义检查点用于保存动作-结果忠实度；(4) 专用LLM智能体、接地代码生成和自我修复执行循环，形成自适应决策架构。
AI.result: 在敏感性分析和不确定性量化案例中，未受约束的语义漂移会恶化策略学习，而所提框架改善了收敛性、鲁棒性和对新型问题上下文的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应决策必须与保证语义一致性和可靠信息流的显式机制相结合，这是设计科学多智能体系统更广泛的设计原则。
idea_en: Semantic checkpoint mechanism: A technology that inserts semantic verification checkpoints between multi-agent pipeline stages to detect and correct semantic drift before it propagates downstream, preserving action-outcome fidelity.

Contextual bandit-driven adaptive decision architecture for scientific workflows: A decision-making system that uses contextual bandits to select computational strategies, combined with grounded code generation and self-healing execution loops to ensure faithful implementation.

Inter-agent structured communication protocol with semantic consistency guarantee: A communication framework between LLM agents that enforces structured message formats and semantic alignment to prevent intention-action inconsistencies.

Empowerment-based evaluation framework for multi-agent scientific pipelines: A method that interprets and measures multi-agent system reliability through the lens of empowerment theory, quantifying how well agent actions preserve causal influence over outcomes.

Self-healing execution loop with semantic drift detection: A feedback mechanism that monitors execution results, detects deviations from intended strategies using semantic analysis, and automatically triggers corrective actions.
idea_ch: 语义检查点机制：在多智能体管线阶段之间插入语义验证检查点，在语义漂移传播至下游之前检测并纠正，保持动作-结果忠实度。
基于上下文强化学习的科学工作流自适应决策架构：利用上下文强化学习选择计算策略，结合接地代码生成和自我修复执行循环，确保策略的忠实实现。
带语义一致性保证的智能体间结构化通信协议：一种在LLM智能体之间强制使用结构化消息格式和语义对齐的通信框架，防止意图-动作不一致。
基于赋能理论的多智能体科学管线评估框架：通过赋能理论视角解释和衡量多智能体系统可靠性，量化智能体动作对结果保持因果影响力的程度。
带语义漂移检测的自我修复执行循环：一种反馈机制，监控执行结果，利用语义分析检测与预期策略的偏差，并自动触发纠正措施。

title: Robust and Generalizable Safety Steering for Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers have become a powerful backbone for text-to-image generation, but their layered and cross-modal generation process makes safety control fundamentally different from prompt-level filtering or output-level detection. Harmful semantics may be weakly expressed in text representations, progressively bound to visual latents, and finally entangled with rendering dynamics. As a result, safety steering at a fixed layer can be unstable, and a steering mechanism learned from known risks may not transfer reliably to a shifted target risk domain. We propose SafeDIG, a safety steering framework that formulates DiT safety adaptation as position-aware sparse feature transfer. SafeDIG first constructs Sparse Autoencoders over functionally distinct DiT intervention positions and uses robustness-aware pre-training routing to prioritize intervention sites that are expected to remain stable under source-target risk shift. It then separates transferable safety features from domain-specific activation geometry by freezing the SAE encoder as a reusable sparse safety dictionary and adapting only the decoder to the target-domain activation manifold. During inference, SafeDIG combines Blend and Repel operations to steer unsafe activations toward transferred safety manifolds or away from harmful sparse directions. Experiments on FLUX.1 Dev and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large show that SafeDIG consistently reduces target-domain and overall unsafe generation rates while preserving source-domain safety and image quality.

AI.tldr: SafeDIG是一种针对扩散Transformer（DiT）文本到图像生成模型的安全导向框架，通过位置感知的稀疏特征迁移实现跨域安全控制，解决了固定层导向不稳定和已知风险知识难以迁移到新目标风险域的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer的分层跨模态生成过程中，有害语义可能在文本表示中弱表达、逐步绑定到视觉隐空间、最终与渲染动态纠缠，导致固定层的安全导向不稳定，且已知风险的导向机制难以可靠迁移到目标风险域。
AI.method: SafeDIG首先在功能不同的DiT干预位置构建稀疏自编码器（SAE），使用鲁棒性感知预训练路由优先选择源-目标风险偏移下保持稳定的干预点；然后冻结SAE编码器作为可重用的稀疏安全词典，仅适配解码器到目标域激活流形；推理时通过Blend（融合）和Repel（排斥）操作将不安全激活导向安全流形或远离有害稀疏方向。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1 Dev和Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large上的实验表明，SafeDIG能持续降低目标域和整体的不安全生成率，同时保持源域安全和图像质量。
AI.conclusion: SafeDIG通过位置感知稀疏特征迁移有效解决了DiT模型跨域安全控制的不稳定性问题，实现了可迁移的安全导向机制。
idea_en: Position-aware sparse feature transfer framework for safety steering in Diffusion Transformers, which constructs Sparse Autoencoders over functionally distinct intervention positions to enable position-specific safety control.
Robustness-aware pre-training routing that selects intervention sites expected to remain stable under source-target risk domain shift, improving cross-domain safety knowledge transfer.

Reusable sparse safety dictionary mechanism that freezes the SAE encoder as a fixed sparse feature extractor and only adapts the decoder to target-domain activation manifold, enabling parameter-efficient domain adaptation.

Blend and Repel inference-time operations that steer unsafe activations toward transferred safety manifolds (Blend) or away from harmful sparse directions (Repel), providing fine-grained safety control without retraining.
Cross-domain safety adaptation method for text-to-image Diffusion Transformers that separates transferable safety features from domain-specific activation geometry via sparse autoencoders.
idea_ch: 一种面向扩散Transformer的位置感知稀疏特征迁移安全导向框架，在不同功能的干预位置构建稀疏自编码器，实现位置特定的安全控制
鲁棒性感知预训练路由方法，优先选择在源-目标风险域偏移下保持稳定的干预点，提升安全知识跨域迁移的可靠性
可复用稀疏安全词典机制，冻结SAE编码器作为固定稀疏特征提取器，仅适配解码器到目标域激活流形，实现参数高效的域自适应
推理阶段的Blend（融合）与Repel（排斥）操作，将不安全激活导向安全流形或远离有害稀疏方向，无需重新训练即可实现细粒度安全控制
面向文本到图像扩散Transformer的跨域安全适应方法，通过稀疏自编码器将可迁移安全特征与域特定激活几何分离

title: Conformal Certification of Reasoning Trace Prefixes
summary: Language model reasoning traces are rarely all-or-nothing; they frequently contain valid intermediate steps before a critical error occurs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically certify final answers or entire responses, failing to provide statistical guarantees for the proportion of a sequential trace that can be safely retained. To address this, we introduce CROP (Conformal Reasoning Output Prefixes), a verifier-agnostic calibration procedure for clean-prefix certification. Given any step-level risk proxy, CROP selects a calibrated threshold and returns the longest contiguous prefix whose step risk proxies remain below it, routing the uncertified suffix for downstream review or repair. Assuming exchangeability, CROP rigorously controls the marginal probability that the returned prefix contains an annotated error. Across six process-labeled reasoning datasets, we demonstrate that standard step-level metrics such as AUROC do not fully capture prefix utility, suggesting verifiers should instead be evaluated by certified prefix length. Furthermore, CROP balances over- and under-withholding, improving downstream repair accuracy by preserving valid intermediate reasoning while discarding misleading suffixes. Ultimately, this work positions prefix certification as a rigorous, practical bridge between process supervision, abstention, and repair.

AI.tldr: 提出了CROP（保形推理输出前缀）方法，用于对语言模型推理轨迹的前缀进行统计认证，确保返回的连续前缀中不包含注释错误，同时将未认证的后缀交给下游修复。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法通常只认证最终答案或整个响应，无法为序列轨迹中可安全保留的比例提供统计保证，而语言模型推理轨迹中常包含有效的中间步骤后才出现关键错误。
AI.method: CROP是一种与验证器无关的校准过程，给定任意步骤级风险代理，选择校准阈值，返回步骤风险代理低于该阈值的最长连续前缀，将未认证的后缀交由下游审查或修复。基于可交换性假设，严格控制了返回前缀包含注释错误的边际概率。
AI.result: 在六个过程标注推理数据集上，标准步骤级指标（如AUROC）不能完全捕捉前缀效用；CROP平衡了过度保留与不足保留，通过保留有效中间推理并丢弃误导性后缀，提高了下游修复准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将前缀认证定位为过程监督、弃权和修复之间的严谨、实用桥梁。
idea_en: A conformal prediction-based method (CROP) for certifying clean prefixes of language model reasoning traces, providing statistical guarantees on the proportion of safe reasoning steps.
A step-level risk proxy calibration procedure that selects a threshold and returns the longest contiguous prefix with risk proxies below that threshold, enabling suffix routing for downstream repair.
A verifier-agnostic calibration framework that transforms any step-level risk proxy into a certified prefix length metric, balancing over- and under-withholding of reasoning steps.
A method for evaluating reasoning verifiers by certified prefix length rather than step-level AUROC, capturing prefix utility more accurately.
idea_ch: 一种基于保形预测的CROP方法，用于认证语言模型推理轨迹的清洁前缀，为安全推理步骤比例提供统计保证。
一种步骤级风险代理校准过程，选择阈值并返回风险代理低于该阈值的最长连续前缀，将未认证后缀路由至下游修复。
一种与验证器无关的校准框架，可将任意步骤级风险代理转化为认证前缀长度指标，平衡推理步骤的过度保留与不足保留。
一种通过认证前缀长度而非步骤级AUROC来评估推理验证器的方法，更准确捕捉前缀效用。

title: Selective QA over Conflicting Multi-Source Personal Memory: A Diagnostic Testbed and Method Comparison
summary: Emerging personal AI agents are moving toward persistent, multi-source memory. This creates an evaluation problem: systems must decide how to use conflicting or incomplete evidence; they cannot just retrieve facts from one clean history. Existing benchmarks rarely show whether an error came from the evidence given to a method or from the method's conflict-resolution step. We study this as selective QA over conflicting multi-source personal memory: systems answer based on conflicting, sometimes incomplete sources, or abstain when evidence is insufficient. We develop a benchmark containing 18 question templates across 8 reasoning types, 480 personas, 4 random seeds, and 34,560 instances, with controlled source distortions and deterministic ground truth. We evaluate the performance of baselines without access to any source, access to a single source, structured fusion methods, and frontier LLMs. The best trained fusion resolver reaches 80.3% accuracy, while the strongest prompt-only LLM baseline reaches 70.0%. With abstention, the same resolver reaches 85.3% selective accuracy at 78.3% coverage and the best LLM reaches 71.0% selective accuracy at 95.4% coverage. Different models have different strengths across reasoning types. We release the data, code, cached model outputs, and data-generating process for reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了个人AI代理中多源冲突记忆的选择性问答问题，构建了包含34,560个实例、18个问题模板、8种推理类型的大规模基准测试，发现最佳融合解析器达到80.3%准确率（含弃权时选择性准确率85.3%），而最优纯提示LLM基线仅70.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法区分错误来源于证据本身还是冲突解决步骤，缺乏对多源冲突、不完整证据下系统推理能力的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建了包含18个问题模板、8种推理类型、480个角色、4个随机种子、34,560个实例的基准测试，通过受控源失真和确定性真实标签，比较无源、单源、结构化融合方法和前沿LLM的性能。
AI.result: 最佳训练融合解析器准确率80.3%，选择性准确率85.3%（覆盖78.3%）；最优纯提示LLM准确率70.0%，选择性准确率71.0%（覆盖95.4%）；不同模型在不同推理类型上各有优势。
AI.conclusion: 多源冲突记忆的选择性问答是评估个人AI代理的关键维度，融合方法在准确率上优于纯提示方法，但LLM在覆盖度上表现更好。
idea_en: A method for selective question answering over conflicting multi-source personal memory, where the system determines whether to answer or abstain based on evidence sufficiency and conflict resolution.
A structured fusion resolver that combines multiple conflicting evidence sources to achieve higher accuracy than prompt-only methods in multi-source personal memory QA.
A benchmark generation process with controlled source distortions and deterministic ground truth for evaluating multi-source conflict resolution in personal AI agents.
A technique for separating evaluation errors into evidence-related errors and conflict-resolution errors in multi-source memory systems.
An abstention mechanism for personal AI agents that selectively answers questions only when evidence from multiple conflicting sources is sufficient.
idea_ch: 一种基于冲突多源个人记忆的选择性问答方法，系统根据证据充分性和冲突解决结果决定回答还是弃权。
一种结构化融合解析器，能够整合多个冲突证据源，在多源个人记忆问答中实现比纯提示方法更高的准确率。
一种带有受控源失真和确定性真实标签的基准测试生成过程，用于评估个人AI代理的多源冲突解决能力。
一种将多源记忆系统中的评估错误区分为证据相关错误和冲突解决错误的技术。
一种个人AI代理的弃权机制，仅在来自多个冲突源的信息充分时才选择性回答问题。

title: PokerSkill: LLMs Can Play Expert-Level Poker without Training or Solvers
summary: Poker is a landmark challenge for artificial intelligence. The dominant approach relies on equilibrium solvers built on counterfactual regret minimization, requiring millions of core-hours of training. Large Language Models (LLMs) possess extensive poker knowledge but perform far below solver-based agents when asked to play directly. Traditional rule-based poker agents are interpretable and training-free, but their strategic ceiling remains far below equilibrium play. We introduce \textbf{PokerSkill}, a training-free and solver-free framework that bridges this gap by using detailed rule-based poker skills as a structured action-grounding interface for LLMs. A deterministic context engine analyzes the current state and retrieves only the relevant fragments from a layered skill library, which is entirely designed by human poker experts, constraining the LLM's choice to reasonable actions. Against GTOWizard, a state-of-the-art GTO benchmark, GPT-5.5 XHigh with PokerSkill achieves $-57 \pm 21$ mbb/hand, Claude Opus 4.6 achieves $-80 \pm 29$ mbb/hand and Claude Opus 4.7 achieves $-87\pm 64$ mbb/hand, reducing losses by 49--61\% compared to default-prompt baselines and outperforming the strong bot Slumbot. Our key finding is that rule-based skills alone do not constitute a strong strategy, and LLMs alone cannot play well, but their combination yields an agent that requires neither training nor solver access yet competes with systems built on millions of core-hours of computation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an LLM achieving competitive performance in a complex imperfect-information game without game-specific training or solver queries. Code is available at https://github.com/lbn187/PokerSkill.

AI.tldr: PokerSkill是一个无需训练和求解器的框架，通过将基于规则的扑克技能作为结构化动作接口与LLM结合，使LLM在不经专门训练的情况下，在复杂的非完美信息博弈（德州扑克）中达到接近GTO求解器的竞技水平。GPT-5.5 XHigh+ PokerSkill在GTOWizard基准上达到-57±21 mbb/hand，相比默认提示基线降低49-61%的损失，且性能超过强机器人Slumbot。
AI.motivation: 现有扑克AI方案存在三个痛点：1) 基于反事实遗憾最小化的求解器需要数百万核时训练，计算成本极高；2) LLM虽具备大量扑克知识，但直接对战表现远不如求解器；3) 传统基于规则的智能体可解释且无需训练，但策略天花板远低于均衡玩法。作者试图寻找一种结合规则与LLM优势、无需训练和求解器的方案。
AI.method: PokerSkill框架包含三个关键组件：1) 确定性上下文引擎，分析当前牌局状态；2) 分层技能库（由人类扑克专家设计），根据上下文只检索相关规则片段；3) 将检索到的技能片段作为结构化动作约束接口，限制LLM选择合理动作。整个流程不涉及任何训练或求解器调用。
AI.result: 在GTOWizard基准上，GPT-5.5 XHigh+PokerSkill达到-57±21 mbb/hand，Claude Opus 4.6达到-80±29 mbb/hand，Claude Opus 4.7达到-87±64 mbb/hand，相比默认提示基线降低49-61%的损失，性能超过Slumbot。这是首个无需游戏特定训练或求解器查询，LLM就能在复杂非完美信息博弈中达到竞技水平的演示。
AI.conclusion: 核心发现：规则技能本身不够强，LLM单独无法打好，但两者的结合产生既不需要训练也不需要求解器的智能体，却能匹敌基于数百万核时计算构建的系统。该工作证明了知识注入（规则技能）作为结构化接口可以有效弥补LLM在复杂决策场景中的不足。
idea_en: Method and system for combining rule-based domain skill libraries with large language models as structured action-grounding interfaces for imperfect-information games
Deterministic context engine with layered skill retrieval that extracts only relevant rule fragments from a human-designed skill library to constrain LLM action selection
Training-free and solver-free framework achieving competitive performance in complex imperfect-information games by using structured rule skills to guide LLM decision-making
idea_ch: 一种将基于规则的领域技能库与大型语言模型结合作为结构化动作约束接口的方法，用于非完美信息博弈中的决策
确定性上下文引擎配合分层技能检索机制，从人类专家设计的技能库中提取相关规则片段，约束LLM的动作选择空间
无需训练且无需求解器的框架，通过结构化规则技能引导LLM决策，在复杂非完美信息博弈中达到竞技水平

title: VLA-Trace: Diagnosing Vision-Language-Action Models through Representation and Behavior Tracing
summary: Understanding how Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models transform multimodal knowledge into embodied control remains an open challenge. We present VLA-Trace, a progressive diagnostic framework that analyzes VLA models through a unified evidence chain from representation dynamics to causal control attribution and behavioral manifestation. It specifically combines cross-modal and checkpoint-drift centered kernel alignment (CKA) to trace representation evolution, attention knockout interventions to identify modality-specific control pathways, and rollout-level behavioral probes to examine grounding, shortcut dependence, and semantic following. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA reveal three key findings. First, the two models exhibit distinct modality-specific adaptation dynamics during VLA finetuning. Second, they rely on different multimodal routing strategies and layer-wise dependencies during action decoding. Third, although VLA policies excel at visually grounded trajectory generation, they remain limited in fine-grained semantic following. These findings highlight future directions for representation-preserving adaptation, causal VLA circuits, and compositional semantic control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLA-Trace诊断框架，通过统一证据链分析VLA模型如何将多模态知识转化为具身控制，揭示了π₀.₅和OpenVLA在模态适应、多模态路由和语义跟随方面的差异与局限。
AI.motivation: 理解VLA模型如何将多模态知识转化为具身控制仍是一个开放挑战，缺乏系统性的诊断框架来分析其内部机制。
AI.method: VLA-Trace框架结合三种技术：1) 跨模态和检查点漂移CKA追踪表示演化；2) 注意力消融干预识别模态特定控制通路；3) rollout级行为探针检测基础关联、捷径依赖和语义跟随能力。
AI.result: 实验发现：1) 两个模型在VLA微调期间展现不同的模态适应动态；2) 它们依赖不同的多模态路由策略和层依赖关系进行动作解码；3) VLA策略在视觉基础轨迹生成方面表现优异，但在细粒度语义跟随方面仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 指出了未来方向：表示保持的适应方法、因果VLA电路分析、以及组合语义控制。
idea_en: A progressive diagnostic framework (VLA-Trace) that combines cross-modal and checkpoint-drift centered kernel alignment (CKA) to trace representation evolution in VLA models during finetuning.
Attention knockout intervention method to identify modality-specific control pathways in VLA models by selectively removing attention heads.
Rollout-level behavioral probes for simultaneously examining visual grounding, shortcut dependence, and semantic following in VLA policies.
idea_ch: 一种渐进式诊断框架(VLA-Trace)，结合跨模态和检查点漂移中心核对齐(CKA)技术，追踪VLA模型在微调过程中的表示演化轨迹。
注意力消融干预方法，通过选择性移除注意力头来识别VLA模型中特定模态的控制通路。
Rollout级行为探针技术，可同时检测VLA策略的视觉基础关联、捷径依赖和语义跟随能力。

title: Enhancing Multi-Agent Communication through Attention Steering with Context Relevance
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex tasks through collaborative reasoning. However, these systems tend to rapidly accumulate extremely long conversation histories during interaction. As conversations lengthen, relevant information is increasingly diluted by irrelevant context, leading to degraded performance. In this work, we present Agent-Radar, a training-free context management method that dynamically steers each agent's attention toward relevant context with a novel temporal and spatial decay mechanism. Our experiments demonstrate that Agent-Radar outperforms state-of-the-art methods across five different benchmarks, yielding gains of up to 7.64 absolute points. Furthermore, our analysis shows that Agent-Radar remains effective and robust as the number of agents and interaction rounds increases. Finally, the ablation study shows that core components in Agent-Radar are crucial to performance and generalizable in different settings.

AI.tldr: Agent-Radar是一种无需训练的上下文管理方法，通过时空衰减机制动态引导多智能体系统关注相关上下文，有效解决长对话历史中的信息稀释问题，在多个基准测试中提升达7.64个百分点。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在协作推理中表现优异，但交互过程中对话历史快速累积，相关信息被无关上下文稀释，导致性能下降。现有方法缺乏有效的上下文管理机制。
AI.method: 提出Agent-Radar，一种无需训练的上下文管理方法，通过新颖的时间空间衰减（temporal and spatial decay）机制，动态引导每个智能体聚焦于相关上下文。
AI.result: 在五个不同基准测试中超越现有最优方法，性能提升最高达7.64个绝对百分点；随智能体数量和交互轮次增加仍保持有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Agent-Radar的核心组件对性能至关重要且在不同设置下具有可泛化性，为解决多智能体长对话上下文管理问题提供了有效方案。
idea_en: A training-free context management method for LLM-based multi-agent systems that dynamically directs each agent's attention using temporal and spatial decay mechanisms, preventing information dilution in long conversation histories.
A temporal decay mechanism that progressively reduces the influence of older conversational context relative to newer information in multi-agent interactions.
A spatial decay mechanism that attenuates the influence of context based on the conversational distance between agents in a multi-agent system.
A dynamic attention steering system for multi-agent architectures that selectively filters and prioritizes relevant context without requiring additional training or fine-tuning.
idea_ch: 一种免训练的上下文管理方法，通过时间和空间衰减机制动态引导每个智能体的注意力，防止长对话历史中信息被稀释。
一种时间衰减机制，在多智能体交互中渐进式降低较旧对话上下文相对于新信息的影响力。
一种空间衰减机制，基于多智能体系统中智能体之间的对话距离来衰减上下文影响力。
一种用于多智能体架构的动态注意力引导系统，无需额外训练或微调即可选择性过滤和优先处理相关上下文。

title: AgentSchool: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Simulation for Education
summary: Despite the rapid deployment of LLMs into classrooms, validating educational AI remains uniquely intractable: interventions act on developing learners whose cognitive and social trajectories are irreversibly shaped, while real-world trials are slow, ethically constrained, and institutionally locked. LLM-based educational simulators have emerged as a potential remedy, but many still collapse learning into persona-conditioned role-play and, when optimized only to reproduce existing classrooms, can structurally penalize the institutional novelty that pedagogical reform requires. In this work, we introduce AgentSchool, an LLM-driven multi-agent simulator that models learning as state transition rather than prompted behavior. AgentSchool couples cognitively growable student agents -- equipped with weighted subject knowledge graphs, thinking-workflow pools, and explicit misconceptions -- with adaptive teacher agents that plan, scaffold, and reflect along the Zone of Proximal Development, embedded in a configurable scenery generator that situates instruction within both formal and informal learning fields, and a multi-scale simulator that decouples interaction scale, temporal granularity, and simulation duration. Experiments show that structured student agents produce more differentiated mastery and misconception traces than a baseline simulator, while teacher-agent comparisons show backbone-dependent patterns consistent with ZPD-informed adaptation. Further, AgentSchool generates plausible traces of peripheral participation, clique formation, aggressor-induced cohesion, and opinion-leader emergence consistent with classroom social theories. Beyond its role as an educational research instrument, AgentSchool frames education as a socially meaningful testbed for long-horizon memory, multi-agent coordination, and future institutional reasoning under organizational pressure.

AI.tldr: AgentSchool是一个基于LLM的多智能体教育模拟器，将学习建模为状态转换而非提示行为，通过可成长的学生代理、自适应教师代理和可配置场景生成器来模拟正式和非正式教育环境中的学习与社交过程。
AI.motivation: 验证教育AI面临独特挑战：干预措施作用于发展中的学习者，真实世界试验缓慢且受伦理约束。现有LLM模拟器将学习简化为角色扮演，优化目标仅仅复制现有课堂，结构性地惩罚教学改革所需的制度创新。
AI.method: AgentSchool包含：(1) 认知可成长的学生代理——配备加权学科知识图谱、思维工作流池和显式错误概念；(2) 自适应教师代理——沿最近发展区规划、搭建脚手架并反思；(3) 可配置场景生成器——将教学置于正式和非正式学习情境中；(4) 多尺度模拟器——解耦交互规模、时间粒度和模拟持续时间。
AI.result: 结构化学生代理比基线模拟器产生更差异化的掌握度和错误概念轨迹；教师代理对比显示与最近发展区适应一致的主干依赖模式；模拟器生成了与课堂社会理论一致的边缘参与、小团体形成、攻击者引发的凝聚力和意见领袖涌现等可信轨迹。
AI.conclusion: AgentSchool不仅是教育研究工具，还将教育框架定位为长时记忆、多智能体协调和组织压力下的未来制度推理的社会意义测试平台。
idea_en: A multi-agent educational simulator with cognitively growable student agents using weighted subject knowledge graphs, thinking-workflow pools, and explicit misconception modeling for state-transition based learning simulation.
An adaptive teacher agent system that plans, scaffolds, and reflects along the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) within a multi-agent educational simulation environment.
A configurable scenery generator that situates instruction within both formal and informal learning fields for educational simulators.
A multi-scale simulation framework that decouples interaction scale, temporal granularity, and simulation duration for educational agent modeling.
A method for generating plausible traces of peripheral participation, clique formation, aggressor-induced cohesion, and opinion-leader emergence in simulated classroom environments.
idea_ch: 一种基于认知可成长学生代理的多智能体教育模拟器，采用加权学科知识图谱、思维工作流池和显式错误概念建模，实现基于状态转换的学习模拟。
一种沿最近发展区（ZPD）进行规划、搭建脚手架和反思的自适应教师代理系统，应用于多智能体教育模拟环境。
一种可配置的场景生成器，将教学置于正式和非正式学习领域中，用于教育模拟器。
一种解耦交互规模、时间粒度和模拟持续时间的多尺度模拟框架，用于教育代理建模。
一种在模拟课堂环境中生成边缘参与、小团体形成、攻击者引发的凝聚力和意见领袖涌现等可信社会轨迹的方法。

title: Anchorless Diversification for Parallel LLM Ideation
summary: LLMs are increasingly used to generate candidate-idea pools for creative tasks where broad exploration is valuable. Parallel inference can be attractive in this setting when it broadens the pool while retaining quality and cost efficiency. We study inference-time controls for candidate-pool diversification, asking whether anchorless methods can rival methods that depend on observed seed ideas. Across three creative task families, we compare independent generation and semantic direction stratification with self-, peer-, and representative-anchor baselines, under neutral and population-referential divergent instructions. Population-referential divergence is a strong low-cost baseline, increasing semantic diversity while preserving quality proxies. Semantic direction stratification is stronger: a single planning call organizes generations across broad semantic directions, yielding the best diversity--quality--compute frontier. Anchored regeneration can be strong in final-pool diversity, but its advantage shrinks under full-pipeline token accounting. These results establish practical anchorless baselines for open-ended LLM ideation.

AI.tldr: 研究如何在不依赖种子锚点的情况下，通过推理时控制策略提升LLM创意候选池的多样性，发现无锚方法（语义方向分层）在多样性-质量-计算效率上优于有锚方法。
AI.motivation: 探索在LLM用于创意生成时，如何通过推理时控制策略实现候选池的多样化，并比较有锚（依赖种子想法）与无锚方法的效果。
AI.method: 在三种创意任务上，对比独立生成、语义方向分层与自我锚定、同行锚定、代表性锚定基线，同时使用中性指令和人群参照发散指令。
AI.result: 人群参照发散指令是低成本强基线；语义方向分层（一次规划调用组织多个语义方向的生成）取得了最佳的多样性-质量-计算效率前沿；有锚方法在最终池多样性上强，但考虑完整token消耗后优势缩小。
AI.conclusion: 建立了面向开放式LLM创意思维的实用无锚基线，语义方向分层是高效方案。
idea_en: Semantic direction stratification method: a single planning call organizes LLM generations across broad semantic directions to diversify candidate pools without seed ideas.
Population-referential divergence prompting: using population-referential divergent instructions as a low-cost method to increase semantic diversity while preserving quality.
Anchorless inference-time control framework for open-ended LLM ideation that achieves better diversity-quality-compute frontier than anchored regeneration methods.
idea_ch: 语义方向分层方法：通过单次规划调用，将LLM生成组织到广泛的语义方向上，无需种子想法即可实现候选池多样化。
人群参照发散提示：使用人群参照发散指令作为一种低成本方法，在保持质量的同时提升语义多样性。
无锚推理时控制框架：面向开放式LLM创意思维，实现比有锚再生方法更好的多样性-质量-计算效率前沿。

title: Temporal Stability and Few-Shot Prompting in Math Task Assessment
summary: As AI tools become increasingly integrated into educational contexts, questions arise about both their stability over time and their responsiveness to prompt engineering techniques. This longitudinal study focused on different AI tools' ability to use the Task Analysis Guide (TAG; Stein \& Smith, 1998) to classify the cognitive demand of mathematics tasks. In particular, it examined whether this classification ability changed with (1) model version updates over time and (2) few-shot prompting using exemplar tasks. We tested a general-purpose AI tool (Gemini) and an education-specific AI tool (Coteach). The specific tools were selected because of their relatively high performance on relevant published benchmarks and prior task-specific tests. Models were tested at baseline, retested with model version updates, and then tested again using few-shot prompting (two exemplar tasks for each cognitive demand category). Results revealed that newer model versions alone produced mixed effects: Gemini's accuracy remained stable at 58\%, while Coteach's accuracy decreased from 75\% to 50\%. However, few-shot prompting improved both models' performance: Gemini increased to 67\% and Coteach recovered to 75\% accuracy. These findings demonstrate that prompt engineering techniques can have larger and more reliable effects than passive model improvements, and that version updates may not always improve performance on specialized educational tasks. The study has important implications for how educators and researchers should approach AI tool selection, evaluation, and implementation in educational contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究纵向考察了通用AI工具(Gemini)和教育专用AI工具(Coteach)使用任务分析指南(TAG)对数学任务认知需求进行分类的能力，发现模型版本更新效果不一（Gemini稳定58%，Coteach从75%降至50%），而少样本提示工程能稳定提升性能（Gemini升至67%，Coteach恢复至75%），提示工程技术的效果优于被动模型更新。
AI.motivation: 探究AI工具在教育场景中的长期稳定性以及对提示工程技术（尤其是少样本提示）的响应能力，特别是评估模型版本更新是否持续提升其在专业教育任务上的表现。
AI.method: 纵向研究方法，在基线阶段、模型版本更新后、以及使用少样本提示（每类认知需求提供两个示例任务）后，分别测试Gemini和Coteach使用TAG对数学任务认知需求进行分类的准确性。
AI.result: Gemini准确率稳定在58%，Coteach从75%降至50%；少样本提示后，Gemini提升至67%，Coteach恢复至75%。提示工程的效果大于且更稳定于被动模型版本更新。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程技术（如少样本提示）对AI工具在教育任务上的表现有更可靠且更大的提升效果，模型版本更新不一定带来专业教育任务的性能提升，对教育场景中AI工具的选择、评估和使用具有重要启示。
idea_en: A method for improving AI classification accuracy on educational task analysis using few-shot prompting with exemplar tasks from each cognitive demand category.
A system for longitudinal evaluation of AI tool stability in educational contexts, comparing baseline performance, post-version-update performance, and prompt-engineered performance.
An adaptive AI assessment framework that cross-validates general-purpose and education-specific AI tools using standardized educational taxonomies (e.g., Task Analysis Guide).

A prompt engineering technique specifically designed for mathematics task cognitive demand classification that leverages two exemplar tasks per category to stabilize and improve AI classification accuracy.
idea_ch: 一种利用少样本提示技术提升AI在教育任务分析中分类准确性的方法，通过为每个认知需求类别提供示例任务来引导模型输出。
一种纵向评估AI工具在教育场景中稳定性的系统，比较基线表现、版本更新后表现和提示工程后表现的三阶段评估框架。
一种自适应AI评估框架，使用标准化教育分类体系（如任务分析指南TAG）交叉验证通用型AI工具与教育专用型AI工具的表现。
一种专门针对数学任务认知需求分类的提示工程技术，每类认知需求使用两个示例任务进行少样本学习，以稳定和提升AI分类准确率。

title: Meta-Cognitive Memory Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents tackle complex long-horizon tasks by recursively summarizing interaction trajectories into compact memory. However, existing approaches typically train these memory policies using outcome-based reinforcement learning, failing to localize where intermediate memory quality degrades. As interactions unfold, ambiguous recursive summaries progressively discard task-relevant information and introduce semantic noise. This exacerbates belief deviation, obscuring the agent's estimate of the latent task state and ultimately derailing long-horizon reasoning. We therefore argue that memory optimization should focus not merely on trajectory-level success, but on the clarity of the belief induced by intermediate summaries. To this end, we introduce Belief Entropy, a self-supervised proxy that probes how uncertain the model remains about the latent task state given its current memory. Based on this proxy, we propose Metacognitive Memory Policy Optimization (MMPO). Instead of relying only on sparse outcome-based signals, MMPO provides fine-grained, memory-specific supervision via explicitly penalizing summaries that induce high epistemic uncertainty. Experiments show that MMPO consistently outperforms existing methods on diverse long-horizon tasks, maintaining 97.1% performance even when scaled to 1.75M-token contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出元认知记忆策略优化（MMPO），通过信念熵（Belief Entropy）自监督代理来评估中间记忆质量，对导致高认知不确定性的摘要进行细粒度惩罚，从而改进长程任务中记忆增强型LLM代理的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型LLM代理使用基于结果的强化学习训练记忆策略，但无法定位中间记忆质量下降的位置。随着交互展开，模糊的递归摘要逐渐丢弃任务相关信息并引入语义噪声，加剧信念偏差，最终导致长程推理失败。
AI.method: 提出信念熵（Belief Entropy）作为自监督代理，探测模型在当前记忆下对潜在任务状态的不确定性。基于此代理，提出元认知记忆策略优化（MMPO），通过显式惩罚导致高认知不确定性的摘要，提供细粒度的、记忆特定的监督信号，替代仅依赖稀疏结果信号的训练方式。
AI.result: MMPO在多种长程任务中持续优于现有方法，即使在扩展到175万token上下文的场景下，仍能保持97.1%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 记忆优化的重点不应仅仅是轨迹级别的成功，而应关注中间摘要所诱导的信念清晰度。信念熵和MMPO为长程推理中的记忆质量监控提供了一种新的自监督范式。
idea_en: Self-supervised belief entropy computation method for evaluating uncertainty of LLM agents about latent task state given current memory
Metacognitive Memory Policy Optimization (MMPO) framework that provides fine-grained, memory-specific supervision by penalizing summaries inducing high epistemic uncertainty
Recursive memory summarization with explicit uncertainty penalty mechanism for long-horizon tasks
Belief deviation monitoring system using entropy-based proxy signals to detect intermediate memory quality degradation in agent trajectories
idea_ch: 基于信念熵的自监督代理方法，用于评估LLM代理在当前记忆下对潜在任务状态的认知不确定性
元认知记忆策略优化框架，通过显式惩罚导致高认知不确定性的摘要，提供细粒度记忆特定监督信号
结合显式不确定性惩罚机制的递归记忆摘要方法，适用于超长序列任务
基于熵代理信号的信念偏差监控系统，用于检测代理轨迹中中间记忆质量退化

title: BioRefusalAudit: Auditing Biosecurity Refusal Depth Using General and Domain-Fine-Tuned Sparse Autoencoders
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Apart Research AIxBio Sprint hackathon paper, April 2026 (Track 3: AI Biosecurity Tools). Code, eval set, and SAEs: github.com/SolshineCode/Deleeuw-AI-x-Bio-hackathon. Reviewer feedback: apartresearch.com/project/biorefusalaudit-auditing-biosecurity-refusal-depth-using-general-and-domainfinetuned-sparse-autoencoders-1fyk
summary: Biosecurity evaluations of language models typically ask whether models produce hazardous output. This paper asks a complementary question: when a model refuses, is that refusal structurally sound, or does it disappear under modest changes to prompt framing, formatting, or output length? Across five architectures, no model cleanly discriminated benign from hazard. Gemma 2 2B-IT never genuinely refused across 75 prompts, hedging on every hazard-adjacent query. Gemma 4 E2B-IT refused 65/75 prompts with chat-template formatting and 0/75 without it. Both Gemma models collapsed to 0% under an 80-token cap. Qwen 2.5 1.5B and Phi-3-mini over-refused, flagging 83-87% of benign biology as hazardous. Llama 3.2 1B showed the only meaningful tier gradient (61-point spread). To probe what drives such over-refusal, we tested a panel of Schedule I but biologically non-toxic compounds (notably psilocybin cultivation, with FDA Breakthrough Therapy status). Some models refused these at rates exceeding genuinely hazardous biology, suggesting refusal tracks legality and cultural salience over CBRN hazard. To measure the internal side, we introduce a divergence score D comparing a model's surface response label to its internal sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature activations. Full D was computed on Gemma 2 2B-IT (Gemma Scope 1) and Gemma 4 E2B-IT (author-trained bio SAE). Two fine-tuned Gemma 2 domain SAEs were released. On Gemma 4, comply and refuse responses separated by a 0.647-point gap with zero overlap (n=75), though this is preliminary, with a narrow catalog, within-sample calibration, and Gemma-family-only SAE coverage. Built over one hackathon weekend on consumer hardware (GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q, plus Colab T4 for SAE training), this preliminary evidence suggests activation-level auditing may surface failure modes invisible to behavioral evaluation, with substantial variation across architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在生物安全评估中的拒绝行为结构稳健性，发现模型在不同提示框架、格式和输出长度限制下拒绝行为极不稳定；同时引入基于稀疏自编码器的发散分数D来检测模型内部激活层面的安全失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有生物安全评估仅关注模型是否产生有害输出，忽略了拒绝行为在提示框架、格式、输出长度等变化下的结构稳定性问题，以及过度拒绝问题背后的驱动因素。
AI.method: 对五种架构的模型进行系统测试，改变提示模板格式、输出长度上限；提出发散分数D，对比模型表层响应标签与内部稀疏自编码器(SAE)特征激活之间的差异；使用Schedule I类但生物无毒化合物测试过度拒绝的驱动因素。
AI.result: Gemma 4在带聊天模板格式下拒绝65/75提示，无模板时拒绝0/75；两个Gemma模型在80 token限制下拒绝率降至0%；Qwen和Phi-3-mini过度拒绝83-87%的良性生物学内容；Llama 3.2展示唯一有意义的梯度(61分差距)；Gemma 4的SAE分析显示拒绝与服从响应有0.647分差距且零重叠。
AI.conclusion: 模型拒绝行为高度脆弱且架构间差异巨大；拒绝倾向于追踪合法性和文化显著性而非真实CBRN危害；激活级审计可以揭示行为评估无法发现的失败模式。
idea_en: A method for evaluating the structural robustness of language model refusals by systematically varying prompt framing, formatting, and output length constraints to detect refusal collapse points.

A divergence score D that compares a language model's surface response label against its internal sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature activations to detect misalignment between internal representation and external behavior.
A system for training domain-specific sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on language model internal activations to audit biosecurity-related refusal failures invisible to behavioral evaluation.
A technique for detecting over-refusal in language models by testing with Schedule I but biologically non-toxic compounds to distinguish legality-driven refusal from genuine hazard assessment.
A methodology for within-sample calibration of SAE-based activation auditing that enables detection of refusal failure modes using consumer-grade hardware (GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q and Colab T4).
idea_ch: 一种通过系统性地改变提示框架、格式和输出长度约束来评估语言模型拒绝行为结构鲁棒性的方法，检测拒绝崩溃点。
一种发散分数D，通过比较语言模型的表层响应标签与其内部稀疏自编码器(SAE)特征激活之间的差异，检测内部表征与外部行为之间的不一致。
一种在语言模型内部激活上训练领域特定稀疏自编码器(SAE)的系统，用于审计行为评估无法发现的生物安全相关拒绝失败模式。
一种使用Schedule I类但生物无毒化合物测试语言模型过度拒绝行为的技术，用于区分基于合法性的拒绝与真实危害评估。
一种基于消费者级硬件(GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q和Colab T4)的SAE激活审计样本内校准方法，能够检测拒绝失败模式。

title: Modularizing Educational LLM-Agency for Fostering Responsible Learning Assistance
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures (+ 2 in appendix), accepted at AISoLA 2025 (Track: Responsible and Trusted AI: An Interdisciplinary Perspective)
summary: The widespread adoption of AI chatbots in education will drastically change learning, making responsible deployment a critical concern. While large language models (LLMs) might have access to sources discussing insights from educational sciences, they are not particularly inclined to adhere to pedagogical concepts, risking negative effects on the learning process, such as a loss of transfer capabilities, critical thinking, or creativity. In this paper, we introduce an agentic AI chatbot architecture assisting students with exercise solving, specifically designed to contribute to more responsible AI use in education. We base our conceptual development on the identification of several desiderata for responsible LLM-based educational systems, argue for the structural shortcomings inherent in monolithic, out-of-the-box solutions, and instead suggest modularizing the agentic architecture. We propose specific modules for different stages of exercise solving, enabling incorporation of targeted pedagogical advice, guiding students through the learning process in a more controllable, transparent, and overseeable manner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化的AI聊天机器人架构，用于教育场景中的习题解答，旨在促进AI在教育中的负责任使用。该架构通过模块化设计，将解答过程分解为不同阶段并嵌入针对性教学指导，克服了传统单体LLM解决方案在可控性、透明性和可监督性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人在教育中的广泛应用可能对学习过程产生负面影响（如迁移能力、批判性思维和创造力的丧失），而现有的LLM虽然能获取教育科学知识，但缺乏遵循教学理念的倾向。因此需要一种更负责任、可控且透明的AI教育系统。
AI.method: 作者首先识别了负责任LLM教育系统的若干需求（desiderata），指出单体式开箱即用解决方案的结构性缺陷，进而提出模块化智能体架构。该架构将习题解答过程分解为不同阶段，每个阶段配备特定模块，嵌入针对性教学指导，实现对学习过程的更可控、更透明和更可监督的引导。
AI.result: 提出了一个模块化的智能体AI聊天机器人架构，用于辅助学生进行习题解答，该架构能够促进AI在教育中的负责任使用。
AI.conclusion: 模块化智能体架构通过将习题解答过程分解并引入针对性教学指导，能够有效解决单体LLM在教育应用中缺乏可控性和透明性的问题，为负责任的AI教育应用提供了可行的设计方向。
idea_en: Modular agentic chatbot architecture for exercise solving: Decomposes the exercise-solving process into distinct stages, each governed by a dedicated pedagogical module, enabling stage-specific guidance and intervention.

Desiderata-driven design framework for responsible LLM-based educational systems: A systematic identification of requirements (e.g., controllability, transparency, oversight) that guide the architectural design of AI chatbots for education.

Pedagogically-guided exercise decomposition: A method of breaking down student exercise solving into modular stages (e.g., understanding, planning, execution, reflection) with targeted pedagogical advice embedded at each stage.

Transparent and overseeable AI tutoring architecture: A chatbot system structure that allows teachers and students to inspect and control the AI's behavior at each step of the learning process, rather than treating it as a monolithic black box.
idea_ch: 模块化智能体习题解答架构：将习题解答过程分解为不同阶段，每个阶段由专门的教学模块控制，实现分阶段指导和干预。
基于需求导向的负责任LLM教育系统设计框架：系统性地识别可控性、透明性、可监督性等需求，指导AI教育聊天机器人的架构设计。
教学引导的习题分解方法：将学生习题解答过程拆分为理解、规划、执行、反思等多个模块化阶段，每个阶段嵌入针对性教学建议。
透明可监督的AI辅导架构：一种允许教师和学生检查并控制AI在学习过程每一步行为的聊天机器人系统结构，避免将AI当作不透明的黑盒使用。

title: Double-Edged Sword or Sharp Tool? Designing and Evaluating Triadic LLM-Teacher Collaboration for K-12 Writing at Scale
summary: The double-edged sword of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) requires an effective triadic collaboration mechanism among LLMs, teachers and students, especially for K-12 education. By developing a triadic collaboration system to support K-12 writing learning, a multidimensional evaluation framework grounded in Systemic Functional Linguistics and the suggestion trajectory tracing pipeline, this paper contributes a large-scale empirical dataset involving $57,954$ essays from $10,195$ students across $120$ schools over two years. Our findings confirm the efficacy of this system in improving writing quality through a strategic labor division: the LLM serves as a generative engine to mitigate teacher burnout, and the teacher acts as a pedagogical gatekeeper and bridge to guarantee feedback quality. While both LLM and teacher are critical for skill improvement, we uncover a ceiling effect where excessive linguistic expansion yields diminishing marginal utility. These suggest a dynamically adaptive LLM-teacher collaboration as student proficiency increases.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)、教师和学生三方协作的K-12写作学习系统，通过57,954篇作文的大规模实证验证，发现LLM作为生成引擎减轻教师负担，教师作为教学把关人保障反馈质量，但存在语言过度扩展的边际效用递减问题，建议根据学生水平动态调整LLM-教师协作模式。
AI.motivation: 解决K-12教育中引入大语言模型所需的三方协作机制问题，尤其是在写作学习领域，需要平衡LLM、教师和学生之间的有效协作，避免教师倦怠同时保证反馈质量。
AI.method: 开发了三方协作系统，基于系统功能语言学构建多维评估框架，设计了建议轨迹追踪流水线，收集了来自120所学校10,195名学生的57,954篇作文进行两年期大规模实证研究。
AI.result: 验证了该系统的有效性：LLM作为生成引擎减轻教师倦怠，教师作为教学把关人和桥梁保障反馈质量；发现过度语言扩展存在边际效用递减的"天花板效应"；LLM和教师对技能提升都至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 建议构建动态自适应的LLM-教师协作模式，随着学生能力提升调整协作策略，以实现最优写作学习效果。
idea_en: A triadic collaboration system for K-12 writing education integrating LLM, teacher, and student with strategic labor division where LLM serves as generative engine and teacher as pedagogical gatekeeper.
A multidimensional evaluation framework grounded in Systemic Functional Linguistics for assessing writing quality in human-AI collaborative educational settings.
A suggestion trajectory tracing pipeline that tracks and analyzes feedback suggestions throughout the writing learning process from multiple sources.
A dynamically adaptive LLM-teacher collaboration mechanism that adjusts based on student proficiency levels to avoid diminishing marginal utility from excessive linguistic expansion.
A method for detecting ceiling effects in LLM-generated linguistic expansion and triggering adaptive reduction of AI assistance as student skills improve.
idea_ch: 一种用于K-12写作教育的三方协作系统，将大语言模型、教师和学生整合在一起，通过战略分工让LLM作为生成引擎、教师作为教学把关人。
基于系统功能语言学构建的多维评估框架，用于评估人机协作教育环境中的写作质量。
一种建议轨迹追踪流水线，能够在写作学习过程中追踪和分析来自多个来源的反馈建议。
一种动态自适应的LLM-教师协作机制，根据学生能力水平自动调整协作策略，避免过度语言扩展带来的边际效用递减。
一种检测LLM生成语言扩展中天花板效应的方法，当学生技能提升时触发AI辅助的适应性减少。

title: Persona Conditioning of Brand Recommendations in Retrieval-Augmented Commercial Chat: A Prominence-Stratified Cross-Provider Audit
summary: The same prompt -- "best CRM software" -- reaches AI assistants from buyers in widely different contexts: a solo founder, an enterprise VP, a UK SMB owner. We audit how strongly that contextual variation reshapes which brands the model recommends. The audit samples 2,000 runs over a design space of 10 personas x 8 prompts x 3 model configurations x N=10 reps, with the two OpenAI cells at full 8-prompt coverage and the Anthropic sonnet-4.6 / low cell at 4-prompt coverage. Prefixing the user message with a persona drops the recommendation-set similarity (Jaccard) by Delta = -0.12 to -0.20 relative to a same-persona baseline (clustered 95% CIs exclude zero on all three measured cells; the sonnet cell's CI rests on only 4 prompt clusters and is correspondingly wider). The effect is sharply prominence-stratified: category leaders are persona-resistant (~80% same-brand consistency across personas), but mid-market brands swap up to 75% of the recommendation set as the persona changes. The Anthropic model shows a larger point-estimate effect than the OpenAI configurations, though clustered CIs overlap for the closer contrast (sonnet vs. OpenAI/high); the asymmetry is consistent with Anthropic's more retrieval-unattributed generation route (43-52% recommendations without observed retrieval-layer evidence, vs OpenAI's 8-29%, documented in Jack 2026). Any measurement of AI brand perception must condition on the buyer persona supplying the query: the same prompt produces materially different recommendation sets depending on who the model thinks is asking, and a measurement protocol that aggregates across personas systematically obscures that variation. The effect concentrates at mid-market and is largest on the most priors-reliant generation route in our audit, consistent with persona responsiveness growing as models lean more on training-data priors and richer context integration.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了AI助手在回答"最佳CRM软件"时，不同用户画像（如创始人、VP、SMB老板）如何显著影响模型推荐结果。基于2000次运行（10种画像×8个提示×3种模型配置），发现添加画像描述使推荐集相似度下降0.12-0.20，头部品牌受影响小，而腰部品牌推荐集变化高达75%。Anthropic模型比OpenAI更受画像影响。
AI.motivation: 当前AI助手被广泛应用于产品推荐场景，但相同的查询可能因用户画像不同而产生差异化的推荐结果。这种偏差可能导致推荐不公平或测量失真，因此需要系统审计提示中隐含的用户背景如何影响模型输出。
AI.method: 使用2000次运行，覆盖10种用户画像×8个提示×3种模型配置（OpenAI两种配置+Anthropic Sonnet-4.6），每次运行重复N=10次。通过Jaccard相似度衡量推荐集变化，分析品牌在头部、腰部不同位置的受影响程度，并对比不同模型架构（检索归因vs.依赖先验）的差异。
AI.result: 添加画像描述后推荐集Jaccard相似度下降0.12-0.20；头部品牌跨画像一致性约80%，腰部品牌推荐集变化高达75%；Anthropic模型画像效应大于OpenAI模型。
AI.conclusion: 任何AI品牌感知测量必须根据查询的买家画像进行条件化处理，聚合不同画像的测量会系统性掩盖偏差。偏差集中在腰部品牌，且在更依赖训练数据先验的模型上表现更显著。
idea_en: System and method for persona-conditioned AI recommendation auditing: A framework that systematically varies user personas in prompts to audit and quantify recommendation bias across different user demographics in AI assistants.

Persona-resistant brand scoring method: A technique to identify which brands/products are robust against persona-induced recommendation variation by measuring consistency across different user contexts.

Retrieval attribution-aware recommendation method: A system that compares model-generated recommendations with observed retrieval-layer evidence to quantify how much a model relies on training data priors vs. retrieved context, and uses this metric to calibrate persona responsiveness.

Cross-model persona effect benchmarking protocol: A standardized methodology for measuring and comparing how different AI models (e.g., retrieval-attributed vs. prior-reliant) respond to persona variations in product recommendation tasks.

Persona-stratified recommendation calibration: Method for adjusting AI recommendations by brand market position tier (leader vs. mid-market) to compensate for persona-induced variation, ensuring fairer recommendations across user contexts.

Context-aware prompt anonymization system: Technique to strip or standardize implicit persona signals from user queries before processing by AI recommendation systems, to reduce unwanted persona-induced variation.
idea_ch: 基于用户画像条件化的AI推荐审计系统与方法：一种系统性地变化提示中的用户画像，审计和量化AI助手在不同用户背景下推荐偏差的框架。
画像抗性品牌评分技术：通过测量品牌在不同用户上下文下的一致性，识别哪些品牌/产品对画像导致的推荐变化具有鲁棒性的方法。
检索归因感知的推荐方法：一种将模型生成的推荐与观察到的检索层证据进行比较，量化模型依赖训练数据先验与检索上下文程度，并据此校准画像响应性的系统。
跨模型画像效应基准测试协议：用于测量和比较不同AI模型（如检索归因型vs.先验依赖型）在产品推荐任务中对画像变化响应的标准化方法。
画像分层推荐校准方法：根据品牌市场地位层级（头部vs.腰部）调整AI推荐以补偿画像引起的变化，确保跨用户背景的更公平推荐。
上下文感知的提示匿名化系统：在AI推荐系统处理用户查询之前，剥离或标准化隐式画像信号的技术，以减少不必要的画像诱导变化。

title: When Should Models Change Their Minds? Contextual Belief Management in Large Language Models
summary: Long-horizon interactions require language models to manage accumulating information: when to update their state, when to preserve their state, and what to ignore. We study this challenge as \textbf{Contextual Belief Management (CBM)}: maintaining a predicted belief state aligned with formal evidence while isolating task-irrelevant noise. To make CBM measurable, we introduce BeliefTrack, a closed-world benchmark spanning Rule Discovery and Circuit Diagnosis, where a finite belief space and symbolic verifiers enable exact turn-level evaluation. BeliefTrack diagnoses three failures: Failed Stay, Failed Update, and Failed Isolation. Across multiple LLMs, vanilla models exhibit severe CBM failures, while explicit belief-tracking prompts provide limited gains. In contrast, reinforcement learning with belief-state rewards reduces failure rates by 70.9\% on average. Further probing reveals latent belief-state dynamics behind these failures, and representation-level steering reduces failure rates by 46.1\% across two tasks\footnote{Code is coming soon at https://github.com/zjunlp/CBM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文信念管理（CBM）概念，研究语言模型在长程交互中如何管理累积信息。设计BeliefTrack基准（包括规则发现和电路诊断任务），发现标准LLM存在三种信念管理失败。通过信念状态奖励的强化学习平均降低70.9%失败率，表示级引导降低46.1%失败率。
AI.motivation: 长程交互中语言模型需要管理累积信息，但现有研究缺乏对信念状态更新、保持和忽略能力的系统性评估与改进方法。
AI.method: 提出上下文信念管理（CBM）框架；构建BeliefTrack基准（含规则发现和电路诊断两个封闭世界任务，具有有限信念空间和符号验证器）；采用信念状态奖励的强化学习；探索表示级引导方法。
AI.result: 标准LLM在CBM任务中表现严重失败；显式信念追踪提示改进有限；强化学习平均降低70.9%失败率；表示级引导降低46.1%失败率。
AI.conclusion: 信念状态奖励的强化学习和表示级引导能有效改善语言模型的上下文信念管理能力，为长程交互中的信息管理提供了新方法。
idea_en: A contextual belief management (CBM) framework with formal belief states and symbolic verifiers for closed-world tasks.
BeliefTrack benchmark for evaluating turn-level belief state maintenance in long-horizon language model interactions.
Reinforcement learning method using belief-state rewards to train language models for accurate belief updates in long contexts.
Representation-level steering technique to reduce belief management failures in language models.
Taxonomy of three belief management failures: Failed Stay, Failed Update, and Failed Isolation.
idea_ch: 一种基于形式化信念状态和符号验证器的上下文信念管理（CBM）框架，用于封闭世界任务中的信念跟踪。
BeliefTrack基准测试集，用于评估长程交互中语言模型在逐轮对话中的信念状态维持能力。
基于信念状态奖励的强化学习方法，训练语言模型在长上下文中进行准确的信念更新。
表示级引导技术，用于减少语言模型中的信念管理失败。
三类信念管理失败的分类体系：保持失败（Failed Stay）、更新失败（Failed Update）和隔离失败（Failed Isolation）。

title: mcp-proto-okn: Natural-language access to open scientific knowledge graphs through the Model Context Protocol
summary:
MCP Server Proto-OKN (mcp-proto-okn) is a Python-based Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants to discover, inspect, query and integrate scientific knowledge graphs through natural language. The server provides graph routing, schema inspection, SPARQL execution, ontology expansion, multi-graph querying, and transcript generation, lowering the barrier to cross-domain knowledge graph analysis for biomedical and scientific users.
  mcp-proto-okn is implemented in Python using the FastMCP framework and is available at https://github.com/sbl-sdsc/mcp-proto-okn. Documentation, client configuration instructions, and example analysis transcripts are provided in the GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: MCP Server Proto-OKN是一个基于Python的模型上下文协议服务器，允许AI助手通过自然语言发现、查询和集成科学知识图谱，降低生物医学和科学用户跨域知识图谱分析的门槛。
AI.motivation: 降低生物医学和科学用户跨域知识图谱分析的门槛，使AI助手能通过自然语言与多个科学知识图谱交互，无需掌握SPARQL等复杂查询语言。
AI.method: 基于Python的FastMCP框架实现，提供图路由、模式检查、SPARQL执行、本体扩展、多图查询和转录生成功能，通过Model Context Protocol标准协议与AI助手通信。
AI.result: 实现了AI助手通过自然语言发现、检查、查询和集成科学知识图谱的功能，代码开源在GitHub并提供文档和示例。
AI.conclusion: MCP Server Proto-OKN成功降低了科学知识图谱的访问门槛，为AI助手与跨域知识图谱的交互提供了标准化解决方案。
idea_en: A Model Context Protocol server for scientific knowledge graph routing and querying via natural language
A multi-graph querying system that automatically routes natural language queries to relevant scientific knowledge graphs
An ontology expansion mechanism that enriches SPARQL query results with related ontological terms from knowledge graphs
A transcript generation system that records and structures AI assistant interactions with multiple knowledge graphs for reproducibility
idea_ch: 一种基于模型上下文协议的科学知识图谱路由与自然语言查询服务器
一种自动将自然语言查询路由到相关科学知识图谱的多图查询系统
一种本体扩展机制，能从知识图谱中提取相关本体术语丰富SPARQL查询结果
一种记录AI助手与多个知识图谱交互过程并结构化生成的转录系统，用于结果可重复性

title: ProjectionBench: Evaluating Scientific Hypothesis Generation in LLMs Under Progressive Information Disclosure
summary: Scientific discovery is an inherently creative and uncertain process, requiring reasoning beyond the recall of known knowledge. While many benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate large language model (LLM) performance on deep research tasks via multi-hop retrieval, their innovative reasoning abilities essential for true scientific discovery remain largely untested. We introduce a benchmark framework for evaluating model performance in scientific discovery and reasoning, building up from a raw problem to the classical null hypothesis test. In our framework, models initially receive only the topic and research question from a recent paper, with technical details progressively revealed. At each stage of information disclosure, the model is tasked with generating hypotheses that address the research question, which is compared with the conclusions from the original paper and evaluated via automated semantic similarity of constituent atomic claims. This progressive evaluation of semantic divergence from ground-truth conclusions enables assessment of a model's innovativeness (under minimal information) to grounded reasoning capabilities (under full experimental details), both critical for using LLMs for scientific discovery purposes. Our framework provides a foundation for systematically evaluating scientific reasoning and discovery capabilities in LLMs, crucial for advancing the development of next-generation AI scientist/co-scientist systems. Specifically, here we evaluate GPT-5, GPT-5.4, Gemini 2.5 pro, and Gemini 3.1 pro preview across 45 papers spanning bioactive materials, mechanical materials, and nanomaterials. We find that GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 pro outperform their previous generation counterparts as expected, and GPT-5.4 in particular maintains 0.7 F1 score alignment with ground truth conclusions even under minimal context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种渐进式信息揭示的科学发现推理基准框架，通过从原始问题到完整实验细节的多阶段评估，衡量大模型在科学发现中的创新性和推理能力。在45篇论文上评估了GPT-5、GPT-5.4、Gemini 2.5 pro和Gemini 3.1 pro，发现GPT-5.4在最小上下文下仍能保持0.7 F1分数与真实结论的对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估大模型在多跳检索方面的深度研究能力，但对其在真实科学发现中所需的创新性推理能力缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建渐进式信息揭示框架：模型仅从研究主题和研究问题开始，逐步获得更多技术细节。每个阶段模型需生成假设，通过与原始论文结论进行原子声明级别的语义相似度比较来评估，从而衡量从创新性到严谨推理的连续能力。
AI.result: GPT-5.4和Gemini 3.1 pro优于前代；GPT-5.4即使在最小上下文条件下，与真实结论的F1对齐分数仍保持0.7。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为系统性评估大模型的科学推理和发现能力奠定了基础，对开发下一代AI科学家/协同科学家系统至关重要。
idea_en: A progressive information disclosure framework for evaluating LLM scientific reasoning, where models generate hypotheses at each stage of information revelation and compare against ground-truth conclusions via atomic claim semantic similarity.
A method for quantifying model innovativeness versus grounded reasoning by measuring semantic divergence from ground-truth conclusions under varying levels of experimental detail disclosure.
An automated evaluation system using atomic claim decomposition and semantic similarity alignment to assess hypothesis quality without requiring human expert annotation.
idea_ch: 一种渐进式信息揭示的大模型科学推理评估框架，模型在信息逐步公开的各阶段生成假设，并通过原子声明级别的语义相似度与真实结论进行比较。
一种通过测量在实验细节逐步披露下的语义偏离度，量化模型创新性与严谨推理能力的评估方法。
一种基于原子声明分解和语义相似度对齐的自动化假设质量评估系统，无需人工专家标注即可评判模型生成假设与真实结论的一致性。

title: MIRA: Mid-training Rubric Anchoring for Source-Aware Data Selection
summary: Mid-training has become an important stage in modern LLM development, using large-scale curated mixtures to strengthen capabilities before final post-training. Its data selection problem is distinct: the data are optimized under a pretraining-style objective at near-pretraining scale, but are curated toward downstream capabilities and drawn from heterogeneous sources with different formats and training roles. As a result, effective selection requires both scalability and source-adaptive semantic criteria. Existing model-based methods scale well, but provide only implicit quality signals. Semantic selection methods offer stronger judgments, but usually assume fixed rubrics or standardized data formats. To address this mismatch, we propose MIRA, a source-aware filtering framework based on self-anchored rubric discovery. The key idea is to make rubric construction part of data selection: MIRA first discovers what should be evaluated for each source group, then distills those judgments into scalable student scorers for full-corpus filtering. On code-oriented mid-training with 21 sources and 5 source groups, MIRA outperforms selection baselines across nine code benchmarks and matches the full-corpus run while using only half the tokens.

AI.tldr: MIRA是一个基于自锚定规则发现的源感知过滤框架，用于LLM中期训练的数据选择，通过为每个数据源组自动发现评估规则并蒸馏到可扩展的学生评分器中，在仅使用一半token的情况下匹配全语料库性能。
AI.motivation: 现有中期训练数据选择方法存在矛盾：基于模型的方法可扩展但缺乏语义判断，而语义选择方法判断力强但假设固定规则或标准化数据格式，无法适应异构多源数据场景。
AI.method: MIRA框架包含两阶段：1) 规则发现阶段，对每个源组使用自锚定机制自动生成评估规则；2) 规则蒸馏阶段，将这些语义判断蒸馏到轻量级学生评分器中，用于全语料库的高效过滤。
AI.result: 在包含21个数据源、5个源组的代码导向中期训练中，MIRA在9个代码基准测试中优于所有选择基线，使用一半tokens即可达到全语料库训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将规则构建纳入数据选择流程本身是有效的，源感知的语义过滤方法能够兼顾可扩展性和判断质量。
idea_en: Self-anchored rubric discovery for automated evaluation criteria generation per data source group in LLM mid-training
