Source-aware data filtering framework with scalable student scorers distilled from discovered rubrics
Two-stage mid-training data selection pipeline combining rubric discovery and judgment distillation
idea_ch: 基于自锚定规则发现的LLM中期训练数据自动评估方法，针对不同数据源组自动生成评价标准
源感知的两阶段数据过滤框架，先发现规则再蒸馏到可扩展学生评分器
将规则构建纳入数据选择流程本身的创新方法，实现异构多源数据的语义级过滤

title: Demystifying Data Organization for Enhanced LLM Training
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized various fields, yet their training efficiency is heavily reliant on effective data curation. While data selection has been widely studied, the strategic data organization for enhanced training remains an underexplored area, particularly since current LLMs are often trained for only one or a few epochs. This paper systematically explores the influence of data organization on LLM training by reusing pre-computed sample-level scores originally generated for data efficiency, thereby incurring minimal additional computational overhead. We identify and formalize four key guidelines for optimizing data organization: Boundary Sharpening, Cyclic Scheduling, Curriculum Continuity, and Local Diversity. Guided by them, we introduce two novel data ordering methods termed STR and SAW. Extensive experiments across different model scales and data sizes, encompassing both pre-training and SFT stages, validate the effectiveness of our summarized guidelines. They also demonstrate the robustness of our proposed data ordering methods in enhancing the stability and performance of LLM training. Github Link: https://github.com/microsoft/data-efficacy/

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了数据组织方式对LLM训练的影响，提出了四条优化准则（边界锐化、循环调度、课程连续性和局部多样性），并基于这些准则设计了两种数据排序方法STR和SAW，实验证明可提升训练稳定性和性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM训练的数据选择已被广泛研究，但数据组织（如排序方式）对训练效率的影响尚未被充分探索，尤其是在仅训练1-3个epoch的场景下。
AI.method: 利用已有数据效率研究中预计算的样本级分数，定义四条准则：边界锐化（使训练数据间难度边界清晰）、循环调度（难度循环变化）、课程连续性（相邻样本难度平滑过渡）、局部多样性（局部区域内样本多样化）。基于这些准则提出STR和SAW两种数据排序方法。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模、数据大小、预训练和SFT阶段，所提出的数据排序方法均能提升训练稳定性和模型性能，验证了四条准则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 数据组织对LLM训练有显著影响，通过合理排序数据可低成本提升训练效率，STR和SAW是有效的通用数据排序方法。
idea_en: A data ordering method for LLM training that reuses pre-computed sample-level scores (originally for data efficiency) to strategically organize training data sequences with minimal additional computation.

A training data organization framework with four formalized guidelines: Boundary Sharpening, Cyclic Scheduling, Curriculum Continuity, and Local Diversity, optimizing LLM training in few-epoch settings.

STR (Structured Training Regimen): a data ordering method that organizes training samples based on sharpened difficulty boundaries and cyclic difficulty scheduling for enhanced LLM training stability.
SAW (Smooth Adaptive Walk): a data ordering method that ensures curriculum continuity and local diversity simultaneously in the training data sequence.

A method to improve LLM training efficiency by ordering data according to sample-level difficulty scores rather than random shuffling, applicable to both pre-training and supervised fine-tuning stages.
idea_ch: 一种复用预计算样本级分数的LLM训练数据排序方法，以极低额外计算成本策略性地组织训练数据序列
包含四条正式化准则（边界锐化、循环调度、课程连续性、局部多样性）的训练数据组织框架，优化少epoch场景下的LLM训练
STR（结构化训练方案）：基于锐化的难度边界和循环调度策略对训练样本进行排序，提升LLM训练稳定性
SAW（平滑自适应行走）：一种同时保证课程连续性和局部多样性的训练数据排序方法
利用样本级难度分数替代随机打乱来排序数据，提升LLM训练效率的方法，适用于预训练和监督微调阶段

title: Locally Coherent, Globally Incoherent: Bounding Compositional Incoherence in Multi-Component LLM Agents
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 24 tables. Preliminary versions to appear at the ICML 2026 Workshops on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB), Statistical Frameworks for Uncertainty in Agentic Systems (AgenticUQ), and Failure Modes of Agentic AI (FAGEN)
summary: Multi-component LLM agents assemble probabilistic claims from components that each see only part of a joint problem; the composition can violate basic probability axioms even when every component is locally coherent. We formalise this locally coherent, globally incoherent failure via the compositional residual eps*, the L2 distance from the composed quote to the joint coherent polytope, computable at runtime from system output and the declared cross-component coupling constraints. A product-structure dichotomy characterises when local coherence suffices, and a Rayleigh-quotient prediction matches the observed residual within 7% on three of four relation classes. A hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra projection repairs the composition deterministically; an anytime-valid e-process gives sequential coherence monitoring. Across 1,876 ensemble cliques on a four-LLM mid-tier panel (frontier-panel rerun in Section 5.5), eps* > 0 on 33-94% of cliques, translating to +0.115 nats per bet of regret on 1,770 resolved bets under the proportional allocation rule (the gain collapses to +0.006 under bettors that themselves coherentise). Three intuitive LLM-side mitigations(retrieval, partition-aware prompting, aggregator-LLM) each fail or regress.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多组件LLM智能体在组合时会产生全局概率不一致（局部相干但全局不相干），定义了残差eps*来量化该问题，并提出修复与监测方法。
AI.motivation: 多组件LLM智能体各自只看到问题的部分信息，组合后的概率断言违反基本概率公理，即使每个组件内部是自洽的。这一失败在现有系统中未被形式化理解和量化。
AI.method: 形式化定义 compositional residual eps*（组合输出到联合相干多面体的L2距离），提出产品结构二分法判断局部相干是否足够，用Rayleigh商预测残差，用Boyle-Dykstra投影进行确定性修复，用anytime-valid e-process进行序列相干性监控。
AI.result: 在1,876个ensemble cliques上eps*>0的比例为33-94%，转化为1,770个已结算赌注上+0.115 nats/赌的后悔收益（在相干化后降为+0.006）。Rayleigh商预测在4个关系类中的3个上误差在7%以内。
AI.conclusion: 多组件LLM系统的全局概率不一致是普遍且严重的问题，现有直观缓解措施（检索、分区感知提示、聚合LLM）均失败或倒退，需要根本性的形式化解决方案。
idea_en: A method for computing compositional residual eps* as L2 distance from multi-component LLM ensemble output to joint coherent probability polytope, enabling runtime detection of global probabilistic incoherence.
A Rayleigh-quotient based predictor for estimating compositional probability residual without full coherence verification, achieving within 7% accuracy on multiple relation classes.
A hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra projection algorithm for deterministically repairing globally incoherent probability compositions from locally coherent LLM components.
An anytime-valid e-process for sequential monitoring of probabilistic coherence in multi-component LLM agent systems during operation.
A product-structure dichotomy criterion for determining whether local coherence of individual LLM components is sufficient to guarantee global joint coherence.
idea_ch: 一种计算组合残差eps*的方法，通过L2距离度量多组件LLM集成输出与联合相干概率多面体之间的偏差，实现运行时全局概率不一致性的检测。
一种基于Rayleigh商的预测器，无需完整相干性验证即可估计组合概率残差，在多个关系类别上达到7%以内的预测精度。
一种层次化Boyle-Dykstra投影算法，用于确定性修复来自局部相干LLM组件的全局不一致概率组合。
一种随时有效e-process方法，用于多组件LLM智能体系统运行过程中概率相干性的顺序监控。
一种产品结构二分法判据，用于判断单个LLM组件的局部相干性是否足以保证全局联合相干性。

title: Tiny but Trusted: Efficient Vision-Language Reasoning for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across many tasks, yet prior studies report unsatisfactory performance when applying large language or multimodal models to finding abnormal patterns in sequential data. Public anomaly detection benchmarks typically provide interval annotations but not natural-language rationales, making it difficult to fine-tune VLMs to produce grounded, interpretable decisions. To address this gap, we construct VisAnomBench, a curated benchmark built from public time-series datasets and augmented with high-quality anomaly explanations selected from multiple large VLMs using fine-grained, task-specific rewards. Through fine-tuning on this benchmark, we develop VisAnomReasoner, a parameter-efficient VLM for time-series anomaly detection. Experimental results on VisAnomBench show that VisAnomReasoner achieves more accurate anomaly localization and consistently outperforms all baselines, with improvements of at least 21.23 and 23.87 percentage points in precision and F1, respectively. Additional experiments on the TSB-AD-U benchmark demonstrate strong cross-benchmark generalization, with VisAnomReasoner improving precision and F1 by 9.57 and 13.39 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了VisAnomBench基准数据集，并开发了VisAnomReasoner模型，通过微调视觉语言模型实现时间序列异常检测的可解释决策，在多个基准测试上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在时序异常检测中表现不佳，公共异常检测基准只提供区间标注而不提供自然语言解释，难以微调VLM生成可解释的决策。
AI.method: 1) 构建VisAnomBench基准，从公开时间序列数据集构建，并用多个大VLM生成的高质量异常解释进行增强（通过细粒度任务特定奖励选择）；2) 在该基准上微调，开发VisAnomReasoner——参数高效的VLM用于时序异常检测。
AI.result: VisAnomReasoner在VisAnomBench上精准度和F1分别提升至少21.23和23.87个百分点；在TSB-AD-U基准上精准度和F1分别提升9.57和13.39个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建带自然语言解释的异常检测基准并微调VLM，能够显著提升时序异常检测的准确性和可解释性，并具有良好的跨基准泛化能力。
idea_en: A method for constructing a time-series anomaly detection benchmark (VisAnomBench) with natural-language anomaly explanations, where high-quality explanations are selected from multiple large VLMs using fine-grained, task-specific rewards.
A parameter-efficient Vision-Language Model (VisAnomReasoner) fine-tuned on the curated benchmark for time-series anomaly detection, achieving superior anomaly localization performance.
A reward-based selection mechanism for filtering anomaly explanations generated by VLMs, using fine-grained task-specific criteria to ensure explanation quality.
A cross-benchmark generalization framework where a VLM fine-tuned on one anomaly detection benchmark (VisAnomBench) demonstrates strong transferability to another benchmark (TSB-AD-U).
idea_ch: 一种构建带自然语言异常解释的时间序列异常检测基准数据集的方法，利用细粒度任务特定奖励从多个大VLM中筛选高质量解释。
一种参数高效的视觉语言模型VisAnomReasoner，通过在该基准上微调实现时间序列异常检测，显著提升异常定位精度。
一种基于奖励的VLM异常解释筛选机制，通过任务特定的细粒度评分标准确保解释质量。
一种跨基准泛化的时间序列异常检测框架，在一个基准上微调的VLM可迁移至其他基准并保持高性能。

title: SchGen: PCB Schematic Generation with Semantic-Grounded Code Representations
summary: Printed circuit board (PCB) schematic design defines nearly all electronic hardware, but it remains manual and expertise-intensive. While generative AI has advanced digital and analog IC design, PCB schematic generation from natural-language intent is largely unexplored. This paper presents SchGen, the first large language model that generates editable PCB schematics from natural-language requests. The key challenge lies in the lack of an LLM-suited representation and a large-scale dataset. Current schematic formats are dominated by verbose, tool-specific syntax and geometry-heavy descriptions, making them difficult to generate reliably. We introduce a semantically grounded code representation that encodes schematic editing primitives with relative placement and pin-name-based wiring, transforming a geometry-driven generation problem into a semantics-driven matching task amenable to LLMs. We further construct a large-scale dataset of PCB schematics paired with user prompts via a human-agent collaborative pipeline that converts open-source hardware designs into our representation. Experiments show that SchGen significantly outperforms alternative representations and even larger general-purpose LLMs on wire connectivity accuracy and functional correctness. Our results highlight the critical role of representation design in enabling generative models for complex hardware design tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SchGen，首个从自然语言请求生成可编辑PCB原理图的大语言模型，通过语义化代码表示和大规模数据集解决了PCB原理图自动生成难题。
AI.motivation: PCB原理图设计是电子硬件的基础，但目前仍依赖人工和专业知识。虽然生成式AI在数字/模拟IC设计领域取得进展，但从自然语言到PCB原理图的自动生成尚未被探索。现有原理图格式冗长、工具特定、几何描述复杂，难以被LLM可靠生成。
AI.method: 1) 提出语义化代码表示：将几何驱动的生成问题转化为语义驱动的匹配问题，编码原理图编辑原语（相对布局、基于引脚名的布线）。2) 构建大规模数据集：通过人机协作流水线将开源硬件设计转换为该表示，并配对用户提示。3) 训练SchGen大语言模型。
AI.result: SchGen在线路连接准确性和功能正确性上显著优于替代表示方法和更大规模的通用大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 表示设计在使生成式模型胜任复杂硬件设计任务中起到关键作用。
idea_en: Semantic code representation for PCB schematic generation: A method that encodes schematic editing primitives with relative placement and pin-name-based wiring, transforming geometry-driven generation into semantics-driven matching task.
Human-agent collaborative pipeline for large-scale PCB schematic dataset construction: Converting open-source hardware designs into LLM-friendly representations paired with natural-language prompts.
SchGen model: A specialized LLM that generates editable PCB schematics from natural-language requests, trained on the semantic code representation and large-scale dataset.
Pin-name-based automatic wiring method: replacing geometry-based wire routing with semantic matching based on component pin names for more reliable schematic generation.
Relative placement encoding for PCB components: representing component positions relative to each other rather than absolute coordinates to simplify the generative task.
idea_ch: 语义化代码表示方法：将PCB原理图编辑原语编码为相对布局和基于引脚名的布线信息，将几何驱动的生成问题转化为语义驱动的匹配任务。
人机协作数据构建流水线：将开源硬件设计自动转换为适合大语言模型训练的语义表示格式，并配对自然语言提示。
基于引脚名的自动布线方法：用引脚名称语义匹配替代传统几何坐标布线，提高原理图生成的可靠性。
面向PCB原理图的专用大语言模型SchGen：从自然语言请求直接生成可编辑PCB原理图。
相对布局编码方法：用元件间相对位置关系替代绝对坐标描述，降低LLM生成原理图的难度。

title: Physics Is All You Need? A Case Study in Physicist-Supervised AI Development of Scientific Software
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, 1 physicist and a few AI agents. Accepted by ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop. Code and development log are available at this repo: https://github.com/MinhMPA/clax-pt
summary:
Are AI agents tools, co-authors, or researchers? We present a quantified case study ($N=1$): a physicist supervising an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Sonnet and Opus models) over 12 work days and 57 sessions to build CLAX-PT, a differentiable one-loop perturbation theory module in JAX. We documented and classified 15 supervision events by intervention level.
  The agent resolved ten autonomously by iterating against oracle tests. Two more by the physicist's domain knowledge. The three it could not -- all evaded oracle detection -- share a common property: the agent treated symptom reduction as root-cause resolution. It spent 33 of the 57 sessions adjusting coefficients within a code architecture that could not represent the target physics, and could not re-evaluate its CLASS-PT branch choice even when prompted to reconsider; only an injected physics concept (anisotropic BAO damping) triggered the redesign. Separately, the agent committed a calibrated correction that passed all oracle tests but corresponded to no quantity in the theory, predicting wrong values at any other cosmology.
  The fudge factor was caught and replaced within the same session. Three supervision practices proved critical for catching what oracle tests missed: testing at diverse parameter points beyond the fiducial calibration; shared changelogs that surfaced stalled exploration across sessions; and an explicit rule against unphysical numerical patches. In this case, supervision design, not model capability, determined whether the agent's output was trustworthy. Closing the gap would require agents that propose architectural alternatives rather than optimize within a given structure, and distinguish predictive adequacy from explanatory correctness -- capabilities not exhibited here, not obviously addressed by scaling alone. [Abridged.]

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个物理学家监督AI编码助手（Claude Code）在12天内构建物理模拟模块的案例，系统记录了15次监督干预事件，发现AI代理无法识别根本性问题（如错误的基础架构选择），而是倾向于局部优化和症状缓解。研究指出，监督设计比模型能力更能决定输出可信度。
AI.motivation: 探究AI编码代理在复杂科学计算任务中的自主性和局限性，特别是当标准测试（oracle tests）无法捕获深层次错误时，人类监督的关键作用。
AI.method: 单案例量化研究（N=1）：一位物理学家监督Claude Code在12个工作日、57个会话中构建JAX微分扰动理论模块（CLAX-PT），记录并分类15次监督干预事件。
AI.result: AI代理自主解决了10个问题（通过oracle测试迭代），2个需要物理学家领域知识，3个无法解决——均因代理将症状缓解当作根本原因解决。代理在无法表达目标物理的代码架构中花了33/57会话调整系数，且即使被提示也无法重新评估架构选择。代理还引入了通过所有oracle测试但物理上无意义的校准修正（fudge factor）。
AI.conclusion: 监督设计比模型能力更决定输出可信度。需让代理能提议架构替代方案而非仅在给定结构内优化，并能区分预测充分性与解释正确性——这些能力当前未展现，且不能仅靠扩展模型规模解决。
idea_en: A system for automated detection of 'fudge factors' in scientific code by cross-validation at diverse parameter points beyond fiducial calibration, to identify numerical patches that pass standard tests but are physically invalid.

A method for AI coding agents to automatically detect and escape local optimization loops where symptom reduction substitutes for root-cause resolution, by analyzing changelog patterns and code architecture exploration history.

A supervision protocol for human-AI collaborative scientific computing that combines shared changelogs across sessions, diverse parameter testing regimes, and explicit rules against unphysical numerical patches.

An architecture-aware AI agent that can propose alternative code structures when the current architecture is fundamentally incapable of representing target physics, rather than optimizing within a flawed framework.
A system for distinguishing predictive adequacy from explanatory correctness in AI-generated scientific code, using cross-cosmology validation to detect physically meaningless corrections.
idea_ch: 基于多参数点交叉验证的自动检测方法，用于识别科学计算代码中通过标准测试但物理无效的'校准修正'（fudge factor）。
通过分析变更日志模式和代码架构探索历史，自动检测AI编码代理陷入'以症状缓解替代根本解决'的局部优化循环的方法。
人机协作科学计算监督协议，包括跨会话共享变更日志、多样化参数测试机制和禁止非物理数值补丁的显式规则。
架构感知型AI代理，能在当前架构无法表达目标物理时主动提议替代方案，而非在错误框架内持续优化。
区分AI生成科学代码中预测充分性与解释正确性的系统，通过跨宇宙学交叉验证检测物理意义上无意义的修正。
